criterion.title: 使用更清洁的能源
criterion.title_en: Use of cleaner sources of energy
criterion.definition: 评估公司通过使用更清洁的能源（如太阳能、风能、地热能、热电联产或天然气替代石油或煤炭）来减排其碳排放的积极程度。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions through the use of cleaner sources of energy such as solar, wind, geothermal, co-generation, or natural gas in place of oil or coal.

criterion.title: 捕获温室气体排放的举措
criterion.title_en: Efforts to capture GHG emissions
criterion.definition: 评估公司对运营排放采用温室气体（GHG）捕集与封存/固存的积极程度。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the aggressiveness of a company’s efforts to use greenhouse gas (GHG) capture and storage/sequestration of its operational emissions.

criterion.title: 能源消耗管理与运营效率
criterion.title_en: Energy Consumption Management & Operational Efficiency
criterion.definition: 该数据点反映我们对公司通过管理能源消耗和提高运营能效来减排其碳排放的积极程度的评估。可能取值为：'积极举措'（最佳）；'部分举措'；'有限举措/信息'；'无举措'（最差）
criterion.definition_en: This data point indicates our assessment of how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its carbon emissions by managing energy consumption and improving the energy efficiency of its operations. Possible values are: 'Aggressive efforts' (best); 'Some efforts'; 'Limited efforts/information'; 'No efforts' (worst)

criterion.title: 减少客户能源消耗的举措（需求侧管理）
criterion.title_en: Efforts to reduce customer energy consumption (demand-side management)
criterion.definition: 反映 MSCI ESG Research 对公司通过能效或需求响应方案来减少未来能源消耗的积极程度的评估。该指标与能源公司和公用事业尤为相关。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates MSCI ESG Research's assessment of the aggressiveness of a company's efforts to reduce future energy consumption through energy efficiency or demand response programs. This indicator is specifically relevant for energy companies and utilities.

criterion.title: 其他减少碳排放的举措
criterion.title_en: Other efforts to reduce carbon emissions
criterion.definition: 评估公司通过其他举措（包括购买碳抵消，但不包括能效、清洁能源使用、碳捕集或需求侧管理）来减排其运营和/或价值链碳排放的积极程度。评估基于行业特定标准。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses how aggressively the company has sought to mitigate its operational and/or value chain carbon emissions through other efforts (including purchasing carbon offsets, but excluding energy efficiency, clean energy use, carbon capture or demand-side management). The assessment is based on industry-specific criteria.

criterion.title: 碳排放目标的全面性
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
criterion.definition: 评估公司所建立的定量气候目标在范围上的全面性和覆盖上的完整性。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示目标全面。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets.

criterion.title: 碳减排目标排放足迹覆盖率（%）
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%)
criterion.definition: 评估企业减排目标覆盖其报告排放总量的程度。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示目标全面覆盖所有相关排放。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的全面性

criterion.title: 碳减排目标相关排放范围得分
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target relevant scope score
criterion.definition: 评估企业减排目标是否包括所有具有财务重要性的排放范围。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示全面覆盖具有财务重要性的排放范围。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的全面性

criterion.title: 碳排放目标的进展
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target progress
criterion.definition: 评估公司在现行环境目标上的进展，以及其在实现此前所设定目标方面的历史记录。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示目标进展强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets

criterion.title: 正在执行的碳减排目标进展
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions ongoing target progress
criterion.definition: 根据当前绩效评估企业实现减排目标的进度。以 0–10 分表示；原文对 10 分的表述为所有目标均按计划朝既定目标推进。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的进展

criterion.title: 碳减排目标历史实现记录
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target track record
criterion.definition: 评估企业实现或维持可持续发展或环境目标的历史表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的进展

criterion.title: 碳排放目标的核验
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target verification
criterion.definition: 评估公司所披露的目标在适用情况下是否得到科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）的支持。以 NULL 或 10 分表示，10 分表示存在核验。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification.

criterion.title: SBTi 长期目标状态
criterion.title_en: SBTi long-term target status
criterion.definition: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）长期目标的状态，该目标与净零或长期脱碳目标相一致。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的核验

criterion.title: SBTi 近期目标状态
criterion.title_en: SBTi near-term target status
criterion.definition: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）近期目标的状态，该目标与短期至中期减排目标相一致。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short-to medium-term emissions reduction goals.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的核验

criterion.title: 碳排放绩效的相对同业表现
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司在温室气体[GHG]排放强度（按销售额或产量单位标准化）及 GHG 排放强度趋势方面相对于同业的表现。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示表现强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in GHG emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: 碳排放强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业温室气体（GHG）排放强度的表现；强度以销售额或产量为分母。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 碳排放绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title: 三年平均碳排放强度（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业在规定期间内每单位销售额温室气体排放的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit of sales over the defined period.
criterion.parent: 碳排放强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 三年平均碳排放强度（按产量）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average carbon emissions intensity (production based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业单位产量温室气体排放的三年平均值；分母视行业采用发电兆瓦时、每吨水泥或收入客运公里。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average greenhouse-gas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer, based on industry).
criterion.parent: 碳排放强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 碳排放强度行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions intensity industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业碳排放强度同比变化趋势的三年平均表现；强度以销售额或产量为分母。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year carbon-emissions intensity trend (normalized by sales or by units of production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 碳排放绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title: 三年平均碳排放强度同比趋势（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额温室气体排放同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year greenhouse-gas emissions (per unit of sales) trend.
criterion.parent: 碳排放强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 三年平均碳排放强度同比趋势（按产量）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year carbon emissions intensity trend (production based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业单位产量温室气体排放同比变化趋势的三年平均值；分母视行业采用发电兆瓦时、每吨水泥或收入客运公里。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average year-over-year greenhouse-gas emissions per unit production (megawatt-hour generated, or ton cement produced or revenue passenger kilometer based on industry) trend.
criterion.parent: 碳排放强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 认识到气候变化的物理风险可能增加承保风险
criterion.title_en: Recognition that physical risk of climate change may increase underwriting risks
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否认识到气候变化的物理风险可能增加承保风险。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company recognizes that the physical risk of climate change may increase underwriting risks.

criterion.title: 量化物理风险对保险承保影响的研究或分析
criterion.title_en: Research or exercise to quantify the impact of physical risk on insurance underwriting
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否开展研究或分析以量化物理风险对保险承保的影响，方式可以是直接开展（通过一手研究）或间接开展（通过行业联盟）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company conducts research or exercises to quantify the impact of physical risk on insurance underwriting, either directly (via primary research) or indirectly (through an industry consortium).

criterion.title: 使用气候变化模型的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of using climate change models
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否使用气候变化模型为承保决策提供依据。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company uses climate change models to inform underwriting decisions.

criterion.title: 基于综合成本率的承保绩效
criterion.title_en: Underwriting performance based on combined ratio
criterion.definition: 根据公司三年平均综合成本率评估其承保绩效。综合成本率通过比较总赔款及费用与已赚保费，衡量保险公司的承保盈利能力。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's underwriting performance, based on its three-year average combined ratio. The combined ratio measures an insurer’s underwriting profitability by comparing total claims and expenses to earned premiums.

criterion.title: 用于评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的正式管理体系
criterion.title_en: Formal management systems to assess ESG risks in financing activities
criterion.definition: 描述公司评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的管理体系。最佳实践包括将 ESG 因素系统性地嵌入信贷评估，并由一套记录的、端到端的框架予以支持，该框架明确了风险管理流程。
criterion.definition_en: Describes the company's management system to assess ESG risks in financing activities. Best practice includes ESG factors systematically embedded in credit assessment, supported by a documented, end-to-end framework that sets out the risk management process.

criterion.title: 评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的管理体系覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of management system to assess ESG risks in financing activities
criterion.definition: 公司评估融资活动中 ESG 风险的正式管理体系的覆盖范围。最佳实践是将所有信贷和投资银行业务纳入其中。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of a company’s formal management systems to assess ESG risks in financing activities. Best practice is to include all credit and investment banking operations.

criterion.title: 集团信用风险部门参与 ESG 尽职调查的程度
criterion.title_en: Involvement of group credit risk in ESG due diligence
criterion.definition: 负责信用风险管理的集团直接参与 ESG 尽职调查的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the group responsible for credit risk management is directly involved in ESG due diligence.

criterion.title: ESG 尽职调查触发条件与风险升级流程的明确定义情况
criterion.title_en: ESG due diligence triggers and risk-escalation process clearly defined
criterion.definition: 围绕基于 ESG 风险触发信贷评估的升级流程所提供信息的透明程度。最佳实践是明确定义 ESG 风险升级流程、提供触发升级的阈值细节，并在必要时提供额外尽职调查的示例。
criterion.definition_en: The level of transparency provided around the escalation process for triggering credit evaluations based on ESG risks. Best practices are to clearly define the ESG risk escalation process, provide details on thresholds for triggering escalation, and provide examples of extra due diligence where necessary.

criterion.title: 对融资活动中 ESG 风险管理的监督
criterion.title_en: Oversight of ESG risk management in financing activities
criterion.definition: 对在融资和投资活动中整合 ESG 考量承担最终责任的集团或个人。
criterion.definition_en: The group or individual that has ultimate responsibility over the integration of ESG considerations in financing and investment activities.

criterion.title: 开展气候相关风险分析
criterion.title_en: Conducts climate-related risk analysis
criterion.definition: 公司评估与气候变化相关业务风险的举措。最佳实践是将气候变化风险分析纳入融资决策。
criterion.definition_en: The company’s initiatives to assess the business risks associated with climate change. Best practice is to integrate climate change risk analysis in financing decisions.

criterion.title: 环境信贷政策评分
criterion.title_en: Environmental credit policy score
criterion.definition: 评估金融机构在五个行业和主题——农业、电力公用事业、采矿、石油天然气、生物多样性——实施环境信贷政策的范围和力度。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示在全部五个行业和主题均应用具有约束力的环境信贷政策。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the scope and strength of a financial institution implementing environmental credit policy across five sectors and themes: agriculture, power utilities, mining, oil & gas, biodiversity. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates binding environmental credit policies applied across all five sectors and themes.

criterion.title: 农业相关信贷政策
criterion.title_en: Credit policy related to agriculture
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否针对农业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to agriculture industry financing.
criterion.parent: 环境信贷政策评分

criterion.title: 电力公用事业相关信贷政策
criterion.title_en: Credit policy related to power utilities
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否针对电力行业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to power industry financing.
criterion.parent: 环境信贷政策评分

criterion.title: 采矿相关信贷政策
criterion.title_en: Credit policy related to mining
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否针对采矿业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to mining industry financing.
criterion.parent: 环境信贷政策评分

criterion.title: 油气相关信贷政策
criterion.title_en: Credit policy related to oil and gas
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否针对油气行业融资制定了具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to oil and gas industry financing.
criterion.parent: 环境信贷政策评分

criterion.title: 生物多样性相关信贷政策
criterion.title_en: Credit policy related to biodiversity
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否制定了与生物多样性相关、具有约束力或不具有约束力的环境信贷政策，或采用了自愿性标准。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has developed binding or non-binding environmental credit policies, or has adopted voluntary standards, related to biodiversity.
criterion.parent: 环境信贷政策评分

criterion.title: 参与绿色融资和绿色证券的程度
criterion.title_en: Involvement in green financing and securities
criterion.definition: 公司投资绿色证券或参与绿色融资结构设计的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which a company invests in green securities or is involved in the structuring of green financing.

criterion.title: 可持续相关金融产品开发
criterion.title_en: Sustainability-related financial product development
criterion.definition: 公司将可持续因素通过定价机制或其他相关绿色融资方式纳入其金融产品的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which a company has integrated sustainability factors into its financial products, either through pricing mechanisms or other related green financing methods.

criterion.title: 担保债券发行人的融资环境影响实践评分
criterion.title_en: Financing environmental impact practices score for covered bonds issuers
criterion.definition: 表示影响担保资产池中资产的 ESG 风险管理实践的力度，以注册国贷款发放机构的平均实践作为代理指标。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示实践力度强。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the strength of ESG risk management practices affecting the assets in the cover pool, proxied by the average practices of loan originators in the country of domicile. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong practices.

criteria.component: 担保债券发行人专用评分

criterion.title: 对供应商能耗和/或碳排放的评估
criterion.title_en: Assessment of energy consumption and/or carbon emissions of suppliers
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否评估其供应商的碳排放和/或能耗。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions and/or energy consumption of its suppliers.

criterion.title: 产品碳足迹评估的范围
criterion.title_en: Extent of product carbon footprint assessments
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否评估其产品和服务在下游的碳排放。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company assesses the downstream carbon emissions of its products and services.

criterion.title: 减少Scope 3上游碳排放的目标
criterion.title_en: Targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions
criterion.definition: 表明是否有证据显示公司设有量化且有时限的减少Scope 3上游碳排放的目标。这可能包括与公司供应链相关的目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence the company has quantitative and time-bound targets to reduce Scope 3 upstream carbon emissions. This may include targets regarding the company’s supply chain.

criterion.title: 对分销和门店运营的能耗或碳排放评估
criterion.title_en: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of distribution and store operations
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否评估其配送中心和门店运营的碳排放或能耗。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its distribution centers and store operations.

criterion.title: 对生产运营（含供应商）的能耗或碳排放评估
criterion.title_en: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of manufacturing operations (including suppliers)
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否评估其生产运营（包括供应商的运营）的碳排放或能耗。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations.

criterion.title: 对原材料采购的能耗或碳排放评估
criterion.title_en: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of raw materials sourcing
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否评估原材料生产过程中涉及的上游碳排放或能耗。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company assesses the upstream carbon emissions or energy consumption involved in the production of raw materials.

criterion.title: 对运输和物流的能耗或碳排放评估
criterion.title_en: Energy consumption or carbon emissions assessment of transportation and logistics
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否评估其运输和物流运营的碳排放或能耗。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company assesses the carbon emissions or energy consumption of its transportation and logistics operations.

criterion.title: 分销中心或门店运营能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in distribution centers or store operations
criterion.definition: 公司在配送中心或门店运营中的碳排放或节能方案的范围。最佳实践包括覆盖所有配送中心或门店运营的方案。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its distribution centers or store operations. Best practice includes programs in all distribution centers or store operations.

criterion.title: 生产运营（含供应商）能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in manufacturing operations (including suppliers)
criterion.definition: 公司在生产运营（包括供应商的运营）中的碳排放或节能方案的范围。最佳实践包括覆盖所有核心生产设施的方案。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in its manufacturing operations, including suppliers’ operations. Best practice includes programs covering all core production facilities.

criterion.title: 原材料采购能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in raw materials sourcing
criterion.definition: 公司在原材料采购（包括供应商采购的原材料）中的碳排放或节能方案的范围。最佳实践包括覆盖所有核心产品的方案。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the sourcing of raw materials, including those sourced by suppliers. Best practice includes programs covering all core products.

criterion.title: 运输与物流能耗或碳排放减排方案覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of energy consumption or carbon emissions reduction programs in transportation and logistics
criterion.definition: 公司在运输与物流阶段开展碳排放或能源减量方案的程度。最佳实践包括提升车队效率，并改进载荷／包装优化。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s carbon emissions or energy reduction programs in the transportation and logistics stages. Best practice includes improvements in fleet efficiency combined with improvements in load/packaging optimization.

criterion.title: 相对于同业组的尾气车队排放绩效
criterion.title_en: Tailpipe fleet emission performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对于行业同业组的估计全球销量加权尾气车队排放绩效。以0-10分表示，10分表示相对于同业组车队排放最低。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission performance in comparison to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating lowest fleet emissions, relative to peers.

criterion.title: 产品碳足迹行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业估计的全球销量加权车队尾气排放表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示相对于同业车队排放最低。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates lowest fleet emissions relative to peers.
criterion.parent: 相对于同业组的尾气车队排放绩效

criterion.title: 产品碳足迹行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Product Carbon Footprint industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业估计的全球销量加权车队尾气排放同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示相对于同业车队排放降幅最大。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year estimated global volume-weighted tailpipe fleet emission trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates highest decline in fleet emissions, relative to peers.
criterion.parent: 相对于同业组的尾气车队排放绩效

criterion.title: 碳排放目标的全面性
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target comprehensiveness
criterion.definition: 评估公司建立的定量气候目标在范围上的全面性和覆盖上的完整性。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示目标全面。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company has established quantitative climate targets that are comprehensive in scope and complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating comprehensive targets.

criterion.title: 碳减排目标排放足迹覆盖率（%）
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target footprint coverage (%)
criterion.definition: 评估企业减排目标覆盖其报告排放总量的程度。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示目标全面覆盖所有相关排放。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company’s emission reduction targets cover its total reported emissions. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates that the targets comprehensively cover all relevant emissions.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的全面性

criterion.title: 碳减排目标相关排放范围得分
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target relevant scope score
criterion.definition: 评估企业减排目标是否包括所有具有财务重要性的排放范围。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示全面覆盖具有财务重要性的排放范围。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses whether the company’s emission reduction targets include all financially material scopes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates full coverage of financially material emission scopes.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标的全面性

criterion.title: 碳排放目标进展
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target progress
criterion.definition: 评估公司在现行环境目标方面的进展，以及其在实现此前既定目标方面的历史记录。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示在实现既定目标方面进展强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s progress toward active environmental targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong progress towards targets

criterion.title: 正在执行的碳减排目标进展
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions ongoing target progress
criterion.definition: 根据当前绩效评估企业实现减排目标的进度。以 0–10 分表示；原文对 10 分的表述为所有目标均按计划朝既定目标推进。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s progress toward achieving its emission reduction targets based on current performance. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 all its targets are on track to meet stated targets.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标进展

criterion.title: 碳减排目标历史实现记录
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target track record
criterion.definition: 评估企业实现或维持可持续发展或环境目标的历史表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s historical performance in achieving or maintaining sustainability or environmental targets. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标进展

criterion.title: 碳排放目标核验
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions target verification
criterion.definition: 评估公司所披露的目标是否（在适用情况下）获得科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）的支持。以NULL或10分表示，10分表示存在核验。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses whether the company’s disclosed targets are supported by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), where applicable. Expressed as either NULL or 10 score, with 10 indicating presence of verification.

criterion.title: SBTi 长期目标状态
criterion.title_en: SBTi long-term target status
criterion.definition: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）长期目标的状态，该目标与净零或长期脱碳目标相一致。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) long-term target, aligned with net-zero or long-term decarbonization goals.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标核验

criterion.title: SBTi 近期目标状态
criterion.title_en: SBTi near-term target status
criterion.definition: 说明企业科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）近期目标的状态，该目标与短期至中期减排目标相一致。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the status of the company’s Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) near-term target, aligned with short-to medium-term emissions reduction goals.
criterion.parent: 碳排放目标核验

criterion.title: 增加清洁技术投资的目标
criterion.title_en: Targets to increase investment in clean tech
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否披露了增加清洁技术投资的定量目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has disclosed quantitative targets to increase investment in clean technology.

criterion.title: 对清洁技术开发的战略重点
criterion.title_en: Strategic focus on clean technology development
criterion.definition: 评估公司将清洁技术作为其核心业务重点和增长计划一部分的战略承诺。最高绩效反映清洁技术是核心业务线或是未来研发与创新的首要重点。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s strategic commitment to clean technology as part of its core business focus and growth plans. Highest performance reflects clean technology being a core business line or a primary focus for future R&D and innovation. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）得分
criterion.title_en: Research and development intensity (as percentage of sales) score
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对于同业组在研发强度指标（包括以销售额标准化的研发强度，以及研发强度趋势）上的绩效。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on R&D intensity metrics (including R&D intensity normalized by sales, and trend in R&D intensity) relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: R&D intensity(% of sales) industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）得分

criterion.title: 三年平均研发强度（占销售额百分比）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average R&D intensity(% of sales)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales).
criterion.parent: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对得分

criterion.title: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: R&D intensity (% of sales) industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s three-year average of year-over-year R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）得分

criterion.title: 三年平均研发强度趋势（占销售额百分比）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average R&D intensity trend (% of sales)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业研发强度（占销售额百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) trend.
criterion.parent: 研发强度（占销售额百分比）行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 清洁技术收入得分
criterion.title_en: Clean tech revenue score
criterion.definition: 公司来自清洁技术活动的收入百分比。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示公司超过 50% 的收入来自清洁技术产品与服务。
criterion.definition_en: The percentage of the company's revenue from clean tech activities. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates that the company derives more than 50% of its revenue from clean technology products and services.

criterion.title: 投资组合或开发项目中绿色建筑认证承诺的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of green building certification commitments in portfolio or development pipeline
criterion.definition: 公司投资组合或开发项目中受其绿色建筑承诺覆盖的部分。仅适用于房地产公司。
criterion.definition_en: The portion of the company’s portfolio or development projects that are covered by its green building commitments. Applies to real estate companies only.

criterion.title: 改善或维持物业环境绩效的商业安排程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of commercial arrangements to improve or maintain property environmental performance
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否提供证据，证明其已实施商业协议以激励租户和物业管理方改善物业环境绩效。仅适用于房地产公司。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of implementing commercial agreements to incentivize tenants and property managers to improve property environmental performance. Applies to real estate companies only.

criterion.title: 绿色租赁或三重净租赁的使用
criterion.title_en: Use of green or triple-net leases
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否提供证据，证明其租赁业务中实施了绿色租赁或三重净租赁。仅适用于房地产公司。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of implementing green leases or triple-net leases in its tenancies. Applies to real estate companies only.

criterion.title: 与绿地开发相关的绿色认证承诺
criterion.title_en: Green certification commitments related to greenfield developments
criterion.definition: 公司针对绿地的绿色建筑战略，包括是否明确声明避免绿地开发、公司仅在绿地开发中建设获得绿色认证的物业，或我们未发现绿地开发获得绿色认证的证据。仅适用于房地产公司。
criterion.definition_en: The company’s green building strategy for greenfield sites, including whether there is a clear statement on avoiding greenfield sites, the company only develops green-certified properties on greenfield developments, or we found no evidence of green certification for greenfield developments. Applies to real estate companies only.

criterion.title: 投资组合中灵活用途或混合用途物业的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of flexible or mixed-use properties in portfolio
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否提供证据，证明其物业投资组合中存在灵活用途或混合用途物业。仅适用于房地产公司。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of flexible or mixed-use properties in its property portfolio. Applies to real estate companies only.

criterion.title: 城市更新开发的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of urban revitalization developments
criterion.definition: 公司开展的城市再开发程度。最佳实践为城市更新。仅适用于房地产公司。
criterion.definition_en: The level of urban redevelopment that the company undertakes. Best practice is urban revitalization. Applies to real estate companies only.

criterion.title: 绿色建筑承诺延伸至投资组合中的既有建筑（除新建建筑外）
criterion.title_en: Green building commitment extends to existing buildings in portfolio (in addition to new buildings)
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否通过绿色建筑举措或绿色建筑认证对其既有物业进行翻新或再开发。仅适用于房地产公司。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company renovates or redevelops its existing properties with either green building initiatives or green building certifications. Applies to real estate companies only.

criterion.title: 绿色建筑认证得分
criterion.title_en: Green building certification score
criterion.definition: 评估在选定绿色建筑标准下获得认证的空间或建筑的程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示投资组合中认证覆盖率最高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent of certified spaces or buildings under selected green building standards. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating highest level of certification coverage across the portfolio.

criterion.title: 绿色认证建筑数量占比得分
criterion.title_en: Score of green certified buildings as % of total
criterion.definition: 评估企业房地产组合中绿色认证建筑的占比，按获得认可绿色建筑认证的建筑数量占全部建筑数量的百分比计算。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the share of green-certified buildings within its real estate portfolio, calculated as the percentage of total buildings that hold recognized green building certifications. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
criterion.parent: 绿色建筑认证得分

criterion.title: 绿色认证建筑面积占比得分
criterion.title_en: Score of green certified space as % of total
criterion.definition: 评估企业房地产组合中绿色认证面积的占比，按获得认可绿色建筑认证的建筑面积占总建筑面积的百分比计算。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the share of green-certified space within its real estate portfolio, calculated as the percentage of total floor area that holds recognized green building certifications. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
criterion.parent: 绿色建筑认证得分

criterion.title: 房地产组合中绿色认证建筑的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of green certified buildings in real estate portfolio
criterion.definition: 根据认证记录、第三方名录等支持文件的可获得性与质量，评估企业提供房地产组合中绿色认证建筑可核实证据的程度。原文写为 0–5 分，同时称 10 表示证据全面且可核实；两者存在冲突，需核对原文。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company provides verifiable evidence of green-certified buildings within its real estate portfolio, based on the availability and quality of supporting documentation such as certification records or third-party registries. Expressed as a 0–5 score, where 10 indicates comprehensive and verifiable evidence.
criterion.parent: 绿色建筑认证得分

criterion.title: 相对同业组的碳排放绩效
criterion.title_en: Carbon emissions performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对同业组的温室气体[GHG]排放强度（按销售额或产量单位标准化）绩效及温室气体排放强度趋势。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on greenhouse gas [GHG] emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in GHG emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 提高可再生能源装机容量的目标
criterion.title_en: Targets to increase renewable capacity
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否披露了提高可再生能源装机容量的定量目标。仅包括针对自有装机容量的目标，即不包括购电协议。仅适用于拥有发电业务的公司。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has disclosed quantitative targets to increase renewable energy capacity. Includes targets referring to owned capacity only, i.e., excluding purchasing agreements. Applies to companies with an electricity generation business only.

criterion.title: 发展可再生能源装机容量的内部架构
criterion.title_en: Internal structures to develop renewable capacity
criterion.definition: 评估公司与发展可再生能源装机容量相关的既定内部架构。最佳实践是设有专门的可再生能源子公司或完全从事可再生能源业务。仅适用于拥有发电业务的公司。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s established internal structures related to developing renewable capacity. Best practice is to have a dedicated renewable energy subsidiary or be wholly involved in renewables. Applies to companies with an electricity generation business only.

criterion.title: 增加可再生电力并网的投资
criterion.title_en: Investments to increase connection of renewable power to electric grid
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否进行了与增加可再生电力并网相关的投资。仅适用于拥有输电或配电业务的公司。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has made investments related to the increased connection of renewable power to the electric grid. Applies to companies with an electricity transmission or distribution business only.

criterion.title: 计划新增可再生能源发电量相对当前总量的得分
criterion.title_en: Score of planned additional renewable electricity generation relative to current total capacity
criterion.definition: 评估公司在计划新增可再生能源发电量与当前总装机容量之比方面的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示表现最高。当前总装机容量（MW）
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on ratio of planned additional renewable electricity generation to current total capacity. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 当前总装机容量（MW）
criterion.title_en: Current Total Installed Capacity (MW)
criterion.definition: 当前发电装机容量，以兆瓦（MW）计。
criterion.definition_en: The current amount of installed capacity for power generation in megawatts (MW).
criterion.parent: 计划新增可再生能源发电量相对当前总量的得分

criterion.title: 新增可再生能源装机容量（MW）
criterion.title_en: Additional renewable capacity (MW)
criterion.definition: 发行人已披露计划新增、且属于可再生能源的装机容量，以兆瓦（MW）计。
criterion.definition_en: The amount of capacity in megawatts (MW) that an issuer has disclosed as planned additions which are renewables.
criterion.parent: 计划新增可再生能源发电量相对当前总量的得分

criterion.title: 商业化可再生电力设备
criterion.title_en: Commercializes renewable power equipment
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否实施涉及安装可再生能源发电所用设备的方案。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company implements programs that involve the installation of equipment used in renewable energy generation.

criterion.title: 为客户提供绿色电力选项
criterion.title_en: Offers customers a green power option
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否为客户提供从可再生能源发电来源购电的选项。仅适用于拥有供电业务的公司。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company offers its customers the option to purchase power from renewable generation sources. Applies to companies with an electricity supply business only.

criterion.title: 可再生电力装机容量绩效的相对同业表现
criterion.title_en: Renewable power capacity performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司在可再生能源总装机容量（占总装机容量的百分比）及可再生能源装机容量趋势方面相对于同业的表现。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示表现最高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on total renewable energy power capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity), and trend in renewable energy power capacity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比得分
criterion.title_en: Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) score
criterion.definition: 评估企业已安装可再生能源装机容量占总装机容量百分比的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on installed renewable power capacity expressed (as a percentage of total installed capacity). Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 可再生电力装机容量绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title: 三年平均可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比
criterion.title_en: Three-year average renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业已安装可再生能源装机容量占总装机容量百分比的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average installed renewable capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity).
criterion.parent: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比得分

criterion.title: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Renewable power capacity (% of total installed capacity) industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业已安装可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s three-year average of year-over-year installed renewable power capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 可再生电力装机容量绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title: 三年平均可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比趋势
criterion.title_en: Three-year average renewable power capacity trend (% of total installed capacity)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业已安装可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year installed renewable capacity (as a percentage of total installed capacity) trend.
criterion.parent: 可再生能源装机占总装机容量百分比行业相对趋势得分

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 与外部利益相关方团体合作以应对其生物多样性影响
criterion.title_en: Involvement with external stakeholder groups to address the biodiversity impacts of its operations
criterion.definition: 表明是否存在与公司合作以应对其运营生物多样性影响的外部利益相关方团体。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there are external stakeholder groups that work with the company to address the biodiversity impacts of its operations.

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 应对生物多样性影响的第三方参与或标准的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of third-party engagement or standard to address the biodiversity impacts of operations
criterion.definition: 获得外部利益相关方团体认证或鉴证的生态系统保护项目所覆盖的运营估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of operations with ecosystem protection programs certified or assured by an external stakeholder group.

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 尽量减少对生物多样性干扰的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitment to minimize disturbances on biodiversity
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否披露了尽量减少对生物多样性干扰的明确承诺，例如遵循“避免、减少、恢复和补偿”的减缓层级。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an explicit commitment to minimize disturbances on biodiversity, for example following the mitigation hierarchy of “avoid, minimize, restore and offset.”

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 复垦受干扰土地栖息地的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitment to reclaim habitat on disturbed land
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否披露了最终复垦所有受干扰土地栖息地的明确政策。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an explicit policy to eventually reclaim the habitat of all disturbed land.

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 生物多样性与土地复垦政策的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of biodiversity and land reclamation policy
criterion.definition: 公司所披露的生物多样性与土地复垦政策所覆盖的运营范围（如适用），即包括供应链在内的所有运营、所有直接运营或部分运营。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of operations covered by the company’s disclosed biodiversity and land reclamation policy, where applicable (i.e., all operations including its supply chain, all direct operations, or partial operations).

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 生态系统保护方案的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to protect ecosystems
criterion.definition: 评估公司保护生态系统措施的全面性，例如公司是建立生态系统保护区还是仅采取保护单一物种的孤立举措，以及此类实践适用于所有主要场所还是仅适用于部分运营。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the comprehensiveness of the company’s steps to protect ecosystems, for example, whether the company creates ecosystem reserves vs. isolated initiatives to protect single species, and whether such practices apply to all major sites or only selected operations.

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 开展生物多样性影响评估
criterion.title_en: Conducts biodiversity impact assessments
criterion.definition: 表明公司在进入新区域之前是否开展生物多样性影响评估。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company conducts biodiversity impact assessments prior to settling in new areas.

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 相对同业组的溢油绩效
criterion.title_en: Oil spills performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对同业组的溢油强度（按销售额标准化）绩效及溢油强度趋势。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on oil spills intensity (normalized by sales), and trend in oil spills intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 溢油强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Oil spill intensity industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估企业溢油强度指标（溢油总量除以销售额）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on oil spill intensity metrics (total volume of oil spilled normalized by sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的溢油绩效

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 三年平均溢油强度（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average oil spill intensity (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业溢油总量除以每单位销售额所得溢油强度的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average oil spill intensity, calculated as total oil spill volume per unit of sales.
criterion.parent: 溢油强度行业相对得分

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 溢油强度行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Oil spill intensity industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估企业溢油强度的三年趋势，即以销售额为分母的溢油量同比变化。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year trend in oil spill intensity (year-over-year change in oil spill volume normalized by sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的溢油绩效

criterion.issue: 生物多样性与土地利用
criterion.title: 三年平均溢油强度同比趋势（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year oil spill intensity trend (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业溢油强度的三年趋势。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year trend in oil spill intensity.
criterion.parent: 溢油强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 负责任牛肉及乳制品采购承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitments towards responsible beef and/or dairy sourcing
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否具有明确的牛肉及乳制品可持续采购政策（例如牛肉零毁林政策），或加入了具有此类政策的行业组织（例如全球可持续牛肉圆桌组织）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source beef and/or dairy (e.g., zero-deforestation beef policy) or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., the Global Roundtable on Responsible Beef).

criterion.title: 牛肉和/或乳制品获第三方环境可持续认证的比例
criterion.title_en: Percentage of beef and/or dairy third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard
criterion.definition: 牛肉和/或乳制品经外部可持续标准（如有机认证）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of beef and/or dairy externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., organic certification).

criterion.title: 牛肉和/或乳制品按最严格可持续标准认证的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of beef and/or dairy certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria
criterion.definition: 公司牛肉和/或乳制品供应经外部最严格可持续标准（如 Rainforest Alliance）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of the company’s supply of beef and/or dairy externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Rainforest Alliance).

criterion.title: 牛肉和/或乳制品追溯至原产地的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of beef and/or dairy traceability to place of origin
criterion.definition: 牛肉和/或乳制品追溯至种植园/农场层级的估计程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated level of traceability of beef and/or dairy up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.

criterion.title: 应对牛肉和/或乳制品生产影响的供应链举措程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of beef and/or dairy production
criterion.definition: 公司在牛肉和/或乳制品供应链内发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如可持续土地管理方案、甲烷减排方案、对供应商实施特定可持续要求并核查合规情况。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its beef and/or dairy supply chain, e.g., sustainable land management program, methane reduction program, implementation of specific sustainable requirements for suppliers and verification of compliance.

criterion.title: 牛肉和/或乳制品采购的未来目标
criterion.title_en: Future targets for beef and/or dairy sourcing
criterion.definition: 公司就牛肉和/或乳制品来源的认证或追溯设定清晰、可衡量目标的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of beef and/or dairy.

criterion.title: 负责任棉花采购承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitments towards responsible cotton sourcing
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否具有明确的棉花可持续采购政策，或加入了具有此类政策的行业组织（例如 Textile Exchange 或 Better Cotton Initiative）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source cotton or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., Textile Exchange or Better Cotton Initiative).

criterion.title: 棉花获第三方环境标准认证的比例
criterion.title_en: Percentage of cotton third-party certified to an environmental standard
criterion.definition: 棉花经外部可持续标准（如 Better Cotton Initiative）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of cotton externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., Better Cotton Initiative).

criterion.title: 棉花追溯至原产地的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of cotton traceability to place of origin
criterion.definition: 棉花追溯至种植园/农场层级的估计程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated level of traceability of cotton up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.

criterion.title: 应对棉花生产影响的供应链举措程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of cotton production
criterion.definition: 公司在棉花供应链内发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如节水和减少农药方案、为获得可持续认证提供技术援助。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its cotton supply chain, e.g., water and pesticide reduction programs, technical assistance to obtain sustainable certification.

criterion.title: 棉花采购的未来目标
criterion.title_en: Future targets for cotton sourcing
criterion.definition: 公司就棉花来源的认证或追溯设定清晰、可衡量目标的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of cotton.

criterion.title: 负责任皮革采购的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitments towards responsible leather sourcing
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有明确的可持续采购皮革政策（如应对森林砍伐），或是否属于制定此类政策的行业组织（如 Leather Working Group）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source leather (e.g., addressing deforestation) or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., Leather Working Group).

criterion.title: 皮革获第三方环境可持续标准认证的比例
criterion.title_en: Percentage of leather third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard
criterion.definition: 皮革经外部可持续标准（如 Leather Working Group）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of leather externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., Leather Working Group).

criterion.title: 皮革按最严格可持续标准认证的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of leather certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria
criterion.definition: 公司皮革供应经外部最严格可持续标准（如 Recycled）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of the company’s supply of leather externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Recycled).

criterion.title: 皮革追溯至原产地的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of leather traceability to place of origin
criterion.definition: 皮革追溯至种植园/农场层级的估计程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated level of traceability of leather up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.

criterion.title: 应对皮革生产影响的供应链举措程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of leather production
criterion.definition: 公司在皮革供应链内发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如为获得可持续认证提供技术援助、减少染色和鞣制过程中的化学品使用。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its leather supply chain, e.g., technical assistance to obtain sustainable certification, reduction of chemical use in the dyeing and tanning process.

criterion.title: 皮革采购的未来目标
criterion.title_en: Future targets for leather sourcing
criterion.definition: 公司就皮革来源的认证或追溯设定清晰、可衡量目标的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of leather.

criterion.title: 负责任棕榈油采购的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitments towards responsible palm oil sourcing
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有明确的可持续采购棕榈油政策（如无森林砍伐、无泥炭、无剥削政策），或是否属于制定此类政策的行业组织（如 the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source palm oil (e.g., no deforestation, no peat, no exploitation policy) or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., the Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil).

criterion.title: 棕榈油获第三方环境可持续标准认证的比例
criterion.title_en: Percentage of palm oil third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard
criterion.definition: 棕榈油经外部可持续标准（如 Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of palm oil externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil).

criterion.title: 棕榈油按最严格可持续标准认证的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of palm oil certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria
criterion.definition: 公司棕榈油供应经外部最严格可持续标准（如 Segregated 或 Identity Preserved Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of the company’s supply of palm oil externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Segregated or Identity Preserved Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil).

criterion.title: 棕榈油追溯至原产地的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of palm oil traceability to place of origin
criterion.definition: 棕榈油追溯至种植园/农场层级的估计程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated level of traceability of palm oil up to the plantation/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.

criterion.title: 应对棕榈油生产影响的供应链举措程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of palm oil production
criterion.definition: 公司在棕榈油供应链内发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如为获得可持续认证提供技术援助、对供应商实施特定可持续要求并核查合规情况。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its palm oil supply chain, e.g., technical assistance to obtain sustainable certification, implementation of specific sustainable requirements for suppliers and verification of compliance.

criterion.title: 棕榈油采购的未来目标
criterion.title_en: Future targets for palm oil sourcing
criterion.definition: 公司就棕榈油来源的认证或追溯设定清晰、可衡量目标的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of palm oil.

criterion.title: 负责任海产品采购的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitments towards responsible seafood sourcing
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有明确的可持续采购海产品政策（如禁止销售濒危物种、规定可接受的捕捞方式），或是否属于制定此类政策的行业组织（如 Marine Stewardship Council）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source seafood (e.g., banning the sale of endangered species, specifying acceptable fishing methods) or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., Marine Stewardship Council).

criterion.title: 海产品获第三方环境可持续标准认证的比例
criterion.title_en: Percentage of seafood third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard
criterion.definition: 海产品经外部可持续标准（如 Global Aquaculture Alliance's Best Aquaculture Practices）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of seafood externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., Global Aquaculture Alliance’s Best Aquaculture Practices).

criterion.title: 海产品按最严格可持续标准认证的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of seafood certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria
criterion.definition: 公司海产品供应经外部最严格可持续标准（如 Marine Stewardship Council、Aquaculture Stewardship Council）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of the company’s supply of seafood externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Marine Stewardship Council, Aquaculture Stewardship Council).

criterion.title: 海产品追溯至原产地的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of seafood traceability to place of origin
criterion.definition: 海产品追溯至捕捞地点/养殖场层级的估计程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated level of traceability of seafood up to the fishing location/farm level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.

criterion.title: 应对海产品生产影响的供应链举措程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of seafood production
criterion.definition: 公司在海产品供应链内发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如为获得可持续认证提供技术援助、参与渔业改进项目。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its seafood supply chain, e.g., technical assistance to obtain sustainable certification, involvement in Fisheries Improvement Projects.

criterion.title: 海产品采购的未来目标
criterion.title_en: Future targets for seafood sourcing
criterion.definition: 公司就海产品来源的认证或追溯设定清晰、可衡量目标的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of seafood.

criterion.title: 负责任木材和/或纸张采购的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitments towards responsible timber and/or paper sourcing
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有明确的可持续采购木材政策，或是否属于制定此类政策的行业组织（如 Forest Stewardship Council）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an explicit policy to sustainably source timber or whether it belongs to an industry group with such a policy (e.g., Forest Stewardship Council).

criterion.title: 木材或纸张获第三方环境可持续认证的比例
criterion.title_en: Percentage of timber or paper third-party certified to an environmental sustainability standard
criterion.definition: 木材或纸张经外部可持续标准（如 Programme for the Endorsement of Forest Certification）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of timber or paper externally certified to sustainable standards (e.g., Programme for the Endorsement of Forest Certification).

criterion.title: 木材按最严格可持续标准认证的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of timber certification against the most stringent sustainable criteria
criterion.definition: 公司木材供应经外部最严格可持续标准（如 Forest Stewardship Council）认证的估计比例。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of the company’s supply of timber externally certified to the most stringent sustainable standards (e.g., Forest Stewardship Council).

criterion.title: 木材和/或纸张追溯至原产地的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of timber and/or paper traceability to place of origin
criterion.definition: 木材和/或纸张追溯至种植园或森林层级的估计程度。最佳实践是所有产品均可追溯。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated level of traceability of timber and/or paper up to the plantation or forest level. Best practice is for all products to be traceable.

criterion.title: 应对木材和/或纸张生产影响的供应链举措程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of supply chain initiatives to address impacts of timber and/or paper production
criterion.definition: 公司在木材和/或纸张供应链内发展可持续实践的举措程度，例如为获得可持续认证提供技术援助、对供应商实施特定可持续要求并核查合规情况。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s initiatives to develop sustainable practices within its timber and/or paper supply chain, e.g., technical assistance to obtain sustainable certification, implementation of specific sustainable requirements for suppliers and verification of compliance.

criterion.title: 木材和/或纸张采购的未来目标
criterion.title_en: Future targets for timber and/or paper sourcing
criterion.definition: 公司是否为木材和／或纸张来源的认证或追溯设定明确、可衡量的目标。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the company has clear, measurable targets for certifying or tracing its sources of timber and/or paper.

criterion.title: 替代水源的使用
criterion.title_en: Use of alternative water
criterion.definition: 评估公司对非淡水来源水的使用。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示非淡水来源使用比例更高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's use of water from non-freshwater sources. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating higher usage from non-freshwater sources.

criterion.title: 使用替代水源的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of using alternative water sources
criterion.definition: 说明是否有证据表明企业使用部分替代水源，但未提供百分比。替代水源包括海水、半咸水、灰水和雨水。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company uses some alternative water sources, but a percentage is not available. Alternative water sources include seawater, brackish water, gray water and rainwater.
criterion.parent: 替代水源的使用

criterion.title: 替代水源用水占比
criterion.title_en: Percentage of water use from alternative water sources
criterion.definition: 企业从替代水源取得的水量。替代水源包括海水、半咸水、灰水和雨水。
criterion.definition_en: The amount of water that the company obtains from alternative sources. Alternative water sources include seawater, brackish water, gray water, and rainwater.
criterion.parent: 替代水源的使用

criterion.title: 自有运营中节水方案的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of water reduction programs at own operations
criterion.definition: 评估公司在直接运营中实施节水措施的程度。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company has implemented water reduction measures at its direct operations.

criterion.title: 减少价值链用水量的方案
criterion.title_en: Programs to reduce water use in value chains
criterion.definition: 评估公司实施或支持旨在减少其价值链用水量的运营方案的程度。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company has implemented or supported operational programs aimed at reducing water use in its value chain.

criterion.title: 水回收利用率得分
criterion.title_en: Water recycling rate score
criterion.definition: 根据公司报告数值评估其水回收利用率。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示回收利用率更高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's water recycling rate based on the company's reported value. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a higher recycling rate.

criterion.title: 水循环利用率
criterion.title_en: Water recycling rate
criterion.definition: 循环利用或回用水量占总用水量的百分比。
criterion.definition_en: The percentage of recycled or recirculated water of total water usage.
criterion.parent: 水回收利用率得分

criterion.title: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构
criterion.title_en: Executive body responsible for water management strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 评估负责水战略与绩效监督的专职人员或委员会的治理层级。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示首席执行官或董事会层面的监督。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the governing level of water strategy and performance oversight assigned to dedicated individuals or a committee. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating CEO or board-level oversight.

criterion.title: CEO 负责水管理战略与绩效
criterion.title_en: CEO is responsible for water management strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 说明 CEO 是否负责水管理战略与绩效。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the CEO is responsible for water management strategy and performance.
criterion.parent: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

criterion.title: 企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会负责水管理战略与绩效
criterion.title_en: CSR or sustainability committee is responsible for water management strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 说明企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会是否负责水管理战略与绩效。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether corporate social responsibility or sustainability committees are responsible for water management strategy and performance.
criterion.parent: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

criterion.title: 非执行人员或非委员会层级工作组负责水管理战略与绩效
criterion.title_en: Non-executive- or non-committee-level task force is responsible for water management strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 说明水管理战略与绩效是否由非执行人员或非委员会层级工作组或风险负责人负责。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether responsibility for water management strategy and performance is with a nonexecutive-or non-committee-level task force or risk officer.
criterion.parent: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

criterion.title: 高级管理人员或执行委员会负责水管理战略与绩效
criterion.title_en: Senior executive or executive committee is responsible for water management strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 说明高级管理人员或执行委员会是否负责水管理战略与绩效。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a senior executive or executive committee are responsible for water management strategy and performance.
criterion.parent: 负责水管理战略与绩效的执行机构

criterion.title: 水资源压力目标的全面性
criterion.title_en: Water stress target comprehensiveness
criterion.definition: 评估公司建立的可衡量水资源相关目标在运营范围上的全面程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示覆盖所有相关业务板块的定量目标。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which a company has established measurable water-related targets that are comprehensive in operational scope. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a quantitative target that covers all relevant segments.

criterion.title: 正在执行的水资源压力目标的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of ongoing Water Stress target
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否披露了正在执行、针对水资源压力或水资源管理的目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has disclosed an ongoing target addressing water stress or water resource management.
criterion.parent: 水资源压力目标的全面性

criterion.title: 正在执行的水资源压力目标覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of ongoing Water Stress target
criterion.definition: 描述企业正在执行的水资源压力管理目标的范围和覆盖程度。
criterion.definition_en: Describes the scope and coverage of the company’s ongoing target related to water stress management.
criterion.parent: 水资源压力目标的全面性

criterion.title: 水资源压力目标进展
criterion.title_en: Water stress target progress
criterion.definition: 评估公司在任何正在进行的节水目标上的进展，或实现历史目标的过往记录。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示目标进展更高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s progress toward any ongoing water reduction targets or track record of progress toward historical targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating higher progress towards targets.

criterion.title: 正在执行的水资源压力目标状态
criterion.title_en: Status of ongoing Water Stress target
criterion.definition: 衡量企业正在执行的水资源压力管理或降低目标目前的实施状态。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the current implementation status of the company’s ongoing target related to water stress management or reduction.
criterion.parent: 水资源压力目标进展

criterion.title: 历史水资源压力目标状态
criterion.title_en: Status of historical Water Stress target
criterion.definition: 衡量企业历史水资源压力管理或降低目标的实现或完成状态。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the achievement or completion status of the company’s historical target related to water stress management or reduction.
criterion.parent: 水资源压力目标进展

criterion.title: 相对同业组的淡水消耗绩效
criterion.title_en: Freshwater consumption performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对同业组的淡水消耗强度（按销售额和/或产品标准化）绩效及淡水消耗强度趋势。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on freshwater consumption intensity (normalized by sales and/or product), and trend in freshwater consumption intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: 淡水消耗强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Freshwater consumption intensity industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业淡水消耗强度（每单位销售额或产出）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on freshwater consumption intensity (per unit of sales or output), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的淡水消耗绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均淡水消耗强度（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average freshwater consumption intensity (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额淡水消耗强度的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average freshwater consumption intensity (per unit of sales).
criterion.parent: 淡水消耗强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 三年平均产品水消耗强度（按产品）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average product water-consumption intensity (product based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位产品产出水消耗强度的三年平均值。仅适用于 GICS 啤酒子行业发行人。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average product water consumption intensity (per unit of product output). Applicable to Brewers GICS Sub-industry issuers only.
criterion.parent: 淡水消耗强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 淡水消耗强度行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Freshwater consumption intensity industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业淡水消耗强度（每单位销售额或产出）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on three-year average of year-over-year freshwater consumption intensity (per unit of sales or output) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的淡水消耗绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均淡水消耗强度同比趋势（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year freshwater consumption intensity trend (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额淡水消耗强度同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year freshwater consumption intensity (per unit of sales) trend.
criterion.parent: 淡水消耗强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 三年平均淡水消耗强度同比趋势（按产品）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year freshwater water-consumption intensity trend (product based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位产品产出水消耗强度同比变化趋势的三年平均值。仅适用于 GICS 啤酒子行业发行人。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year product water-consumption intensity (per unit of product output) trend. Applicable to Brewers GICS Sub-industry issuers only.
criterion.parent: 淡水消耗强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 相对同业组的淡水取水绩效
criterion.title_en: Freshwater withdrawal performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对同业组的淡水取水强度（按销售额或产量单位标准化）绩效及淡水取水强度趋势。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on freshwater withdrawal intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in freshwater withdrawal intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: 淡水取水强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Freshwater withdrawal intensity industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业淡水取水强度（每单位销售额或产出）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on freshwater withdrawal intensity (per unit of sales or output), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的淡水取水绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均淡水取水强度（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average freshwater withdrawal intensity (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额淡水取水强度的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average freshwater withdrawal intensity (per unit of sales).
criterion.parent: 淡水取水强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 三年平均淡水取水强度（按产品）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average freshwater withdrawal intensity (product based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位产品产出淡水取水强度的三年平均值。仅适用于具有发电业务的发行人。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average freshwater withdrawal intensity (per unit of product output). Applicable to issuers with power generation only.
criterion.parent: 淡水取水强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 淡水取水强度行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Freshwater withdrawal intensity industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业淡水取水强度（每单位销售额或产出）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on three-year average of year-over-year freshwater withdrawal intensity (per unit of sales or output) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的淡水取水绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均淡水取水强度同比趋势（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year freshwater withdrawal intensity trend (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额淡水取水强度同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year freshwater withdrawal intensity (per unit of sales) trend.
criterion.parent: 淡水取水强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 三年平均淡水取水强度同比趋势（按产品）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year freshwater withdrawal intensity trend (product based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位产品产出淡水取水强度同比变化趋势的三年平均值。仅适用于具有发电业务的发行人。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year freshwater withdrawal intensity (per unit of product output) trend. Applicable to issuers with power generation only.
criterion.parent: 淡水取水强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 相对同业组的漏水绩效
criterion.title_en: Water leakage performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对行业同业组的漏水率绩效及漏水率趋势。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。仅适用于供水公用事业发行人。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on leakage rates, and trend in leakage rates, relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. Applicable to water utility issuers only.

criterion.title: 漏水率行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Water leakage industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业漏水率的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on water leakage rate, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的漏水绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均漏水率
criterion.title_en: Three-year average water-leakage rate
criterion.definition: 衡量企业漏水率的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average water leakage rate.
criterion.parent: 漏水率行业相对得分

criterion.title: 漏水率行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Water leakage industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业漏水率同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year water leakage rate trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的漏水绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均漏水率同比趋势
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year water leakage rate trend
criterion.definition: 衡量企业漏水率同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year water leakage rate trend.
criterion.parent: 漏水率行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 按产品类型划分的电子废弃物回收计划范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of the electronic waste take-back program by product type
criterion.definition: 在公司电子废弃物产品回收计划下，符合收集和回收条件的产品范围。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of products that are eligible for collection and recycling under the company’s electronic waste product recycling program.

criterion.title: 按地点划分的电子废弃物回收计划范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of the electronic waste take-back program by location
criterion.definition: 公司产品收集和电子废弃物回收计划的地理范围。
criterion.definition_en: The geographic scope of the company’s product collection and electronic waste recycling program.

criterion.title: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of electronic waste take-back programs
criterion.definition: 评估公司针对报废产品的回收渠道——投放点、邮寄回收和上门取件。以0-10分表示，10分表示举措有力。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s return channels for end-of-life products - drop-off, mail-in, and pick-up. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 电子废弃物回收计划包括终寿产品送交渠道
criterion.title_en: Electronic waste take-back programs include drop-off of end-of-life products
criterion.definition: 说明消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的渠道是否包括送交方式（门店或指定交回地点）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include drop-off options (at a store or designated drop-off locations).
criterion.parent: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

criterion.title: 电子废弃物回收计划包括终寿产品邮寄渠道
criterion.title_en: Electronic waste take-back programs include mail-in of end-of-life products
criterion.definition: 说明消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的可用渠道是否包括邮寄方式。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether available channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include mail-in options.
criterion.parent: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

criterion.title: 电子废弃物回收计划包括终寿产品上门收取渠道
criterion.title_en: Electronic waste take-back programs include pick-up of end-of-life products
criterion.definition: 说明消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的可用渠道是否包括上门收取方式。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether available channels for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company include pick-up options.
criterion.parent: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

criterion.title: 存在电子废弃物回收计划但未提供详情
criterion.title_en: Electronic waste take-back program exists but no details given
criterion.definition: 说明是否存在消费者将终寿电子产品退回企业的渠道，但未提供具体信息。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether channels exist for consumers to return end-of-life electronics to the company, but details are not provided.
criterion.parent: 电子废弃物回收计划的范围

criterion.title: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施
criterion.title_en: Facilities that handle recycling of collected electronics
criterion.definition: 评估公司通过回收管理电子废弃物的努力。以0-10分表示，10分表示举措有力。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses company efforts in managing electronic waste through recycling. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 企业自营电子废弃物回收设施
criterion.title_en: Company-operated electronic waste recycling facilities
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否运营自有电子废弃物回收设施。企业也可能使用服务商或参加回收管理组织进行电子废弃物回收。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company operates its own electronic waste recycling facilities. The company may also use vendors or participate in recycling management organizations for electronic waste recycling.
criterion.parent: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

criterion.title: 参加电子废弃物回收计划
criterion.title_en: Participation in electronic waste recycling programs
criterion.definition: 说明企业参加支持或运营回收设施的电子废弃物回收管理组织、联合体或网络。企业也可能运营自有设施或使用服务商回收电子废弃物。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates that the company participates in electronic waste (e-waste) recycling management organizations (or recycling consortia/network) that support or operate recycling facilities. The company may also operate its own facilities or use vendors for e-waste recycling.
criterion.parent: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

criterion.title: 服务商运营的电子废弃物回收设施
criterion.title_en: Vendor-operated electronic waste recycling facilities
criterion.definition: 说明企业使用指定服务商运营的电子废弃物回收设施。企业也可能运营自有设施或参加电子废弃物回收管理组织。此外，说明这些服务商是否接受企业或第三方审计项目的审计或认证，包括但不限于 R2、e-stewards 和 WEEELABEX。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates that the company uses designated vendors that operate electronic waste (e-waste) recycling facilities. The company may also operate its own facilities or participate in recycling management organizations for e-waste recycling. Moreover, indicates whether these vendors audited or certified by the company or third-party audit programs (including but not limited to R2, e-stewards and WEEELABEX).
criterion.parent: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

criterion.title: 未具体说明的电子废弃物回收活动
criterion.title_en: Unspecified electronic waste recycling activities
criterion.definition: 说明企业对电子废弃物回收有一般性声明，但未进一步说明负责所收集电子废弃物回收的设施、服务商或组织。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates that the company has a general statement on recycling electronic waste (e-waste) with no further details regarding the facilities, vendors or organizations that handle recycling of collected e-waste.
criterion.parent: 处理所收集电子产品回收的设施

criterion.title: 明确禁止向非OECD国家出口电子废弃物
criterion.title_en: Explicit ban on electronic waste exports to non-OECD countries
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否依据《巴塞尔公约》的《巴塞尔禁令修正案》，明确禁止将电子废弃物从OECD成员国出口至非OECD成员国进行处置和回收。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company explicitly bans electronic waste exports from OECD member countries to non-OECD member countries for disposal and recovery, in accordance with the Basel Ban Amendment to the Basel Convention.

criterion.title: 报废电子废弃物回收
criterion.title_en: End of life electronic waste recycling
criterion.definition: 评估公司在被其回收并随后进行再生利用的电子废弃物占比方面的绩效。以0-10分表示，10分表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on the share of electronic waste that is recovered and subsequently recycled by the company. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong performance.

criterion.title: 电子废弃物回收比例（已报告）
criterion.title_en: Percentage of electronic waste recycled – Reported
criterion.definition: 说明所收集终寿电子废弃物中成功回收并再利用的部分，占全部回收终寿产品和电子废弃物的比例。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the proportion of collected end-of-life electronic waste that is successfully recycled and repurposed relative to the total end-of-life products and e-waste recovered.
criterion.parent: 报废电子废弃物回收

criterion.title: 包装材料构成的披露
criterion.title_en: Disclosure of packaging material mix
criterion.definition: 公司在包装所用材料类型方面的透明度。最佳实践是完整披露。
criterion.definition_en: How transparent the company is about the type of materials used in its packaging. Best practice is full disclosure.

criterion.title: 减少废弃物的消费者方案的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of consumer programs to reduce waste
criterion.definition: 公司关于回收的消费者教育方案（如回收点）或回收指引的覆盖范围。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of the company’s consumer education programs on recycling (e.g., take-back locations) or recycling instructions.

criterion.title: 法律未强制要求的回收方案的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of recycling programs where not mandated by law
criterion.definition: 公司在法律未强制要求包装废弃物回收的地区或情形下参与包装材料回收或再生利用的程度。最佳实践是制定一项总体性的包装废弃物战略。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s involvement in recycling or recovery of packaging materials in locations or circumstances where packaging waste recycling is not mandated by law. Best practice is to have an overarching packaging waste strategy.

criterion.title: 降低包装环境影响的战略
criterion.title_en: Strategy to reduce the environmental impact of packaging
criterion.definition: 公司降低其包装环境影响的战略的全面性，例如通过减少废弃物、重新设计包装以及与供应商或客户互动。最佳实践是制定减少包装环境影响的具体举措。
criterion.definition_en: The comprehensiveness of the company’s strategy to reduce the environmental impact of its packaging, such as through waste elimination, packaging redesign, and engagement with suppliers or customers.
