Best practice is to have specific initiatives that reduce the environmental impact of packaging.

criterion.title: 与包装成分相关的目标
criterion.title_en: Targets related to packaging content
criterion.definition: 评估公司针对包装再生材料成分的目标及其范围。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's targets and their scope focused on recycled material content of packaging. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 提高包装再生材料含量目标的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of targets to increase recycled material content of packaging
criterion.definition: 说明企业在包装中使用消费后再生材料目标的覆盖范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the scope of a company's target to incorporate postconsumer recycled materials into its packaging.
criterion.parent: 与包装成分相关的目标

criterion.title: 提高包装再生或可再生材料含量的目标
criterion.title_en: Targets to increase recycled or renewable material content of packaging
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否设有改善包装成分的具体目标，例如增加再生材料或可再生材料含量，或去除有问题、难回收的塑料成分。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has specific targets for improving packaging content, such as increasing recycled content, renewable content, or eliminating problematic or hard-to-recycle plastic content.
criterion.parent: 与包装成分相关的目标

criterion.title: 与包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物相关的目标
criterion.title_en: Targets related to packaging material circularity or waste elimination
criterion.definition: 评估公司针对包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物的目标及其范围。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's targets and their scope focused on packaging material circularity or waste elimination. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 包装材料循环性或消除废弃物目标的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of targets for packaging material circularity or waste elimination
criterion.definition: 说明包装中与材料回收或消除废弃物相关的环境目标的覆盖范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the scope of environmental targets related to material recovery or waste elimination in packaging.
criterion.parent: 与包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物相关的目标

criterion.title: 包装材料循环性或消除废弃物目标
criterion.title_en: Targets for packaging material circularity or waste elimination
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否设有通过包装改善产品回收的具体目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has specific targets related to improving product recovery through packaging.
criterion.parent: 与包装材料循环利用或减少废弃物相关的目标

criterion.title: 包装环境改善措施的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of environmental improvements in packaging
criterion.definition: 评估公司在包装成分方面（如轻量化、再生材料含量）的成果。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's achievements on packaging content (e.g. light-weighted, recycled content).

criterion.title: 产品或包装回收的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of product or packaging recovery
criterion.definition: 评估公司在产品或包装回收方面的成果。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's achievements on product or packaging recovery.

criterion.title: 环境影响审核的范围与频率
criterion.title_en: Scope and frequency of environmental impact audits
criterion.definition: 评估公司是否开展定期审核以评估和管理环境风险与影响。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示举措有力。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses whether the company conducts regular audits to assess and manage environmental risks and impacts. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 环境影响审计的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of environmental impact audits
criterion.definition: 说明是否有证据表明企业对相关运营开展内部及外部环境审计。例如，获得 ISO 14001 或类似框架认证的环境管理体系（EMS）要求定期审计。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company conducts internal and/or external environmental audits of its relevant operations. This could include, for example, an EMS certified to ISO 14001 or a similar framework, which requires regular audits.
criterion.parent: 环境影响审核的范围与频率

criterion.title: 所有运营地点审计的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of audits across all locations of operations
criterion.definition: 说明是否有证据表明环境审计覆盖所有运营地点。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence of environmental audits across all locations of operations.
criterion.parent: 环境影响审核的范围与频率

criterion.title: 每年环境影响审计的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of annual environmental impact audits
criterion.definition: 说明是否有证据表明企业每年开展环境影响审计。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company carries out annual environmental impact audits.
criterion.parent: 环境影响审核的范围与频率

criterion.title: 环境管理体系的存在
criterion.title_en: Existence of environmental management system
criterion.definition: 表明是否有证据显示公司在全部或选定的相关运营中建立了环境管理体系（EMS）。例如，可能包括通过 ISO 14001 认证的环境管理体系、在 EMAS 下的注册，或类似的框架。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company has an Environmental Management System (EMS) in place across all or selected relevant operations. This could include, for example, an EMS certified to ISO 14001, registration under EMAS, or a similar framework.

criterion.title: 减少供应链有毒排放的方案覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to reduce toxic emissions of supply chain
criterion.definition: 表明公司在多大程度上建立了减少其供应链内有毒排放的方案。最佳实践是供应商的环境管理接受筛查和审核。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the extent to which the company has established programs to reduce toxic emissions within its supply chain. Best practice is for suppliers’ environmental management to be subject to screening and audits.

criterion.title: 应对环境影响的政策范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of policies to address environmental impacts
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否制定了正式政策以应对诸如大气排放、废水排放和废弃物等环境影响。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has formal policies in place to address environmental impacts such as air emissions, water discharges, and waste.

criterion.title: 认证环境体系得分
criterion.title_en: Certified environmental system score
criterion.definition: 评估公司有多少场所拥有通过 ISO 14001 或类似标准认证的环境管理体系。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示认证程度最高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent of the company's sites with an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 or similar. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating the highest degree of certification.

criterion.title: 环境管理体系获得 ISO 14001 或 HAZWOPER 认证的运营占比
criterion.title_en: Percentage of operations with an environmental management system certified to ISO 14001 or HAZWOPER
criterion.definition: 具有危险废弃物管理指引、并遵循 ISO 14001 或 HAZWOPER 废弃物管理认证的场所占比。
criterion.definition_en: The percentage of sites with hazardous waste guidance that follow ISO 14001 or HAZWOPER certification for waste management.
criterion.parent: 认证环境体系得分

criterion.title: 有毒排放与废弃物目标的全面性
criterion.title_en: Toxic emissions & waste target comprehensiveness
criterion.definition: 评估公司在多大程度上建立了具有可衡量减排范围且覆盖完整的有毒废物减排目标。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示覆盖所有业务板块的定量目标。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which a company has established toxic waste reduction targets that have a measurable reduction scope and are complete in coverage. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating a quantitative target that covers all segments.

criterion.title: 正在执行的有毒排放与废弃物目标的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否具有正在执行的有毒排放或废弃物减少目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an ongoing toxic emissions and/or waste reduction target.
criterion.parent: 有毒排放与废弃物目标的全面性

criterion.title: 正在执行的有毒排放与废弃物目标覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
criterion.definition: 评估正在执行的有毒排放或废弃物目标的覆盖范围。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示目标涵盖企业运营的所有相关部分。
criterion.definition_en: Assess the scope of coverage of the ongoing toxic emissions and/or waste target. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates that the target covers all relevant segments of the company's operations.
criterion.parent: 有毒排放与废弃物目标的全面性

criterion.title: 有毒排放与废弃物目标进展
criterion.title_en: Toxic emissions & waste target progress
criterion.definition: 评估公司当前有毒排放与废弃物目标的迄今进展，以及其在实现此前公布目标方面的历史记录。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示已实现公布的目标。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s to-date progress on active toxic emissions & waste targets, as well as its historical track record in meeting previously stated targets. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating achievement of stated target.

criterion.title: 正在执行的有毒排放与废弃物目标状态
criterion.title_en: Status of ongoing Toxic Emissions & Waste target
criterion.definition: 通过评估相对于目标的当前进展，衡量企业正在执行的有毒排放或废弃物管理目标目前的实施状态。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the current implementation status of the company’s ongoing target on toxic emissions and/or waste management, by assessing the current progress against the target.
criterion.parent: 有毒排放与废弃物目标进展

criterion.title: 历史有毒排放与废弃物目标状态
criterion.title_en: Status of historical Toxic Emissions & Waste target
criterion.definition: 通过评估既定目标是否实现，衡量企业历史有毒排放或废弃物管理目标的实现或完成状态。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the achievement or completion status of the company’s historical target on toxic emissions and/or waste management, by assessing whether the stated target was achieved or not.
criterion.parent: 有毒排放与废弃物目标进展

criterion.title: 相对同业的氮氧化物排放绩效
criterion.title_en: NOx emissions performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对于同业组在氮氧化物（NOx）排放强度（以销售额或产量单位标准化）以及 NOx 排放强度趋势上的绩效。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on nitrogen oxides (NOx) emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in NOx emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: NOx 排放强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: NOx emissions intensity industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业氮氧化物（NOx）排放强度（每单位销售额或产量排放量）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions intensity (emissions per unit of sales or production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业的氮氧化物排放绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额 NOx 排放量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average NOx emissions (per unit of sales).
criterion.parent: NOx 排放强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度（按产量）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity (production based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每发电兆瓦时 NOx 排放量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average NOx emissions (per megawatt-hour generated).
criterion.parent: NOx 排放强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: NOx 排放强度行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: NOx emissions intensity industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业 NOx 排放量（每单位销售额或产量）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year NOx emissions (per unit of sales or production) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业的氮氧化物排放绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度趋势（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity trend (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额 NOx 排放量同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year NOx emissions (per unit of sales) trend.
criterion.parent: NOx 排放强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 三年平均 NOx 排放强度趋势（按产量）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average NOx emissions intensity trend (production based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每发电兆瓦时 NOx 排放量同比变化趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year NOx emissions (per megawatt-hour generated) trend.
criterion.parent: NOx 排放强度行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 相对同业的硫氧化物排放绩效
criterion.title_en: SOx emissions performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对于同业组在硫氧化物（SOx）排放强度（以销售额或产量单位标准化）以及 SOx 排放强度趋势上的绩效。以 0-10 分表示，其中 10 表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on sulfur oxides (SOx) emissions intensity (normalized by sales or by units of production), and trend in SOx emissions intensity, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: SOx 排放强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: SOx emissions intensity industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业硫氧化物（SOx）排放强度（每单位销售额或产量排放量）的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on sulfur oxide (SOx) emissions intensity emissions (per unit of sales or production), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业的硫氧化物排放绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均 SOx 排放强度（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average SOx emissions intensity (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每单位销售额 SOx 排放量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average SOx emissions (per unit of sales).
criterion.parent: SOx 排放强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 三年平均 SOx 排放强度（按产量）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average SOx emissions intensity (production based)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业每发电兆瓦时 SOx 排放量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average SOx emissions (per megawatt-hour generated).
criterion.parent: SOx 排放强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 健康与安全政策的适用范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of health and safety policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司的健康与安全政策适用于所有运营还是部分运营。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s health and safety policy applies to all operations or select operations.

criterion.title: 健康与安全政策对承包商的适用性
criterion.title_en: Applicability of health and safety policy to contractors
criterion.definition: 表明承包商是否须遵守与员工相同的健康与安全政策。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether contractors are held to the same health and safety policies as employees.

criterion.title: 健康与安全政策及实践经过审计
criterion.title_en: Health and safety policy and practices are audited
criterion.definition: 表明是否有证据显示公司对其健康与安全政策及实践进行内部和/或外部审计。这可能包括例如获得 ISO 45001 或类似框架的认证，此类认证要求定期审计。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence that the company conducts internal and/or external audits of its health & safety policy and practices. This could include, for example, certification to ISO 45001 or a similar framework, which requires regular audits.

criterion.title: 健康与安全绩效是 CEO 薪酬的考量因素
criterion.title_en: Health and safety performance is a factor in CEO compensation
criterion.definition: 表明 CEO 薪酬是否与健康与安全绩效挂钩。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether CEO compensation is linked to health and safety performance.

criterion.title: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构
criterion.title_en: Body responsible for health & safety strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 评估健康与安全战略及绩效监督是否分配给专门的个人、团队或委员会。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示 CEO 负责这些实践。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses whether the health & safety strategy and performance oversight is assigned to a dedicated individual, team, or committee. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating that the CEO is responsible for these practices.

criterion.title: CEO 负责健康与安全战略
criterion.title_en: CEO is responsible for health and safety strategy
criterion.definition: 说明企业 CEO 是否明确负责监督企业健康与安全战略及绩效。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s CEO has explicit responsibility for oversight of the company’s health and safety strategy and performance.
criterion.parent: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构

criterion.title: 高级管理人员或执行委员会负责健康与安全战略
criterion.title_en: Senior executive or executive committee are responsible for health and safety strategy
criterion.definition: 说明是否有高级管理人员或执行委员会明确负责监督企业健康与安全战略及绩效。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is a senior executive or executive committee with explicit responsibility for oversight of the company’s health and safety strategy and performance.
criterion.parent: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构

criterion.title: 企业社会责任或可持续发展委员会负责健康与安全战略及绩效
criterion.title_en: CSR or sustainability committees are responsible for health and safety strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 说明是否有企业社会责任（CSR）或可持续发展委员会明确负责监督企业健康与安全战略及绩效。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is a CSR or sustainability committee with explicit responsibility for oversight of the company’s health and safety strategy and performance.
criterion.parent: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构

criterion.title: 非执行人员或非委员会层级工作组负责健康与安全战略及绩效
criterion.title_en: Non-executive or non-committee level task force is responsible for health and safety strategy and performance
criterion.definition: 说明是否有非执行人员或非委员会机构明确负责监督企业健康与安全战略及绩效，例如负责此类实践的非执行风险负责人。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is a non-executive person or non-committee with explicit responsibility for oversight of the company’s health and safety strategy and performance. An example of this would be a non-executive risk officer that is responsible for these practices.
criterion.parent: 负责健康与安全战略与绩效的机构

criterion.title: 健康与安全认证的评估
criterion.title_en: Evaluation of health & safety certification
criterion.definition: 评估公司获得公认健康与安全认证（如 ISO 45001）的程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示认证程度最高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company has obtained recognized health and safety certifications (e.g., ISO 45001). Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating the highest degree of certification.

criterion.title: 健康与安全管理体系获得认可标准认证的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of health and safety management system certified to recognized standard
criterion.definition: 说明是否有证据表明企业部分运营的健康与安全管理体系获得 ISO 45001 或 GB/T 45001-2020 标准认证。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence that some portion of the company’s operations have a health and safety management system certified to the ISO 45001 standard, or GB/T 45001-2020 standard.
criterion.parent: 健康与安全认证的评估

criterion.title: 健康与安全管理体系获得认可标准认证的运营占比
criterion.title_en: Percentage of operations having health and safety management systems certified to recognized standard
criterion.definition: 健康与安全管理体系获得 ISO 45001 或 GB/T 45001-2020 标准认证的运营占比。
criterion.definition_en: The percentage of operations that have a health and safety management system certified to the ISO 45001, or GB/T 45001 -2020 standard.
criterion.parent: 健康与安全认证的评估

criterion.title: 披露的健康与安全指标中包含承包商
criterion.title_en: Contractors included in disclosed health and safety metrics
criterion.definition: 表明承包商的健康与安全绩效是否以与员工相同或类似的方式进行衡量和披露。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether contractor health and safety performance is measured and disclosed in the same or similar manner as employees.

criterion.title: 改善健康与安全绩效的目标
criterion.title_en: Target to improve health and safety performance
criterion.definition: 公司为减少员工事故和死亡而设定的目标类型。最佳实践是设定包含承包商和员工的、可量化（非零）的事故减少目标。
criterion.definition_en: The type of target set by the company to reduce employee accidents and fatalities. Best practice is to set a quantifiable (non-zero) accident reduction target that includes contractors and employees.

criterion.title: 误工事故率绩效的相对同业表现
criterion.title_en: Lost time incident rate performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司在报告的误工事故率[LTIR]（每百万工时）及 LTIR 趋势方面相对于同业的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示表现最高。误工事故率（每百万工时）
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on reported lost time incidents rate [LTIR] (per million hours worked), and trend in LTIR, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 损失工时事故率（每百万工时）行业相对得分

criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估企业损失工时事故率，即每百万工时导致损失工作时间的事故数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on Lost Time Incident Rate (number of incidents resulting in lost work time per million hours worked) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 误工事故率绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title_en: Three-year average Lost time incident rate (per million hours worked)

criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average Lost Time Incident Rate (per million hours worked).

criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year Lost Time Incident Rate (per million hours worked) trend.

criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on reported total recordable injury rate [TRIR] (per million hours worked), and trend in TRIR, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估企业总可记录伤害率，即每百万工时可记录伤害数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on Total Recordable Injury Rate (number of recordable injuries per million hours worked), relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 总可记录伤害率绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title: 三年平均总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年平均总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）。总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average Total Recordable Injury Rate (per million hours worked).
criterion.parent: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对得分

criterion.title: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year Total Recordable Injury Rate (per million hours worked) trend, relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 总可记录伤害率绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title: 三年平均总可记录伤害率趋势（每百万工时）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average Total recordable injury rate trend (per million hours worked)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）同比趋势的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year Total recordable injury rate (per million hours worked) trend.
criterion.parent: 总可记录伤害率（每百万工时）行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 死亡强度绩效的相对同业表现
criterion.title_en: Fatality intensity performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司在死亡强度（按员工人数和/或销售额标准化）方面相对于行业同业的表现。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示零死亡。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on fatalities intensity (normalized by number of employees and/or by sales), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating zero fatalities.

criterion.title: 死亡事故行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Fatalities industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估以每 100,000 名员工或销售额为分母的死亡人数表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on fatalities normalized per 100,000 employees and/or sales, relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 死亡强度绩效的相对同业表现

criterion.title: 三年平均死亡人数（每 100,000 名员工）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average fatalities (per 100,000 employees)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司每 100,000 名员工的三年平均死亡人数。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average fatalities per 100,000 employees.
criterion.parent: 死亡事故行业相对得分

criterion.title: 每百万美元销售额的三年平均死亡人数
criterion.title_en: Three-year average fatalities per million USD in sales
criterion.definition: 衡量公司每百万美元销售额的三年平均死亡人数。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average fatalities per million USD in sales.
criterion.parent: 死亡事故行业相对得分

criterion.title: 与人力资源相关的申诉报告或上报程序的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of human resource-related grievance reporting or escalation procedures
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否有内部报告渠道或上报程序，供员工报告与人力资源相关的申诉。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an internal reporting channel or escalation procedures for employees to report human resource-related grievances.

criterion.title: 员工满意度调查频率
criterion.title_en: Employee satisfaction survey frequency
criterion.definition: 员工满意度调查的频率。最佳实践是至少每年一次。
criterion.definition_en: The frequency of employee satisfaction surveys. Best practice is at least annually.

criterion.title: 正式的人才梯队培养战略
criterion.title_en: Formal talent pipeline development strategy
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否制定了正式的人才梯队培养战略，其证据包括结构化的招聘项目（如毕业生培训计划、实习或学徒制）以及将人才梯队培养与公司长期业务或劳动力战略相联系的明确表述。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a company has a formal talent pipeline development strategy in place, evidenced through structured recruitment programs (such as graduate traineeships, internships, or apprenticeships) and explicit statements linking talent pipeline development to the company’s long-term business or workforce strategy.

criterion.title: 员工股权方案
criterion.title_en: Employee equity programs
criterion.definition: 员工持股计划和/或员工购股计划的资格覆盖程度。最佳实践是所有正式员工均可参与此类方案。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of eligibility for an employee stock ownership plan and/or an employee stock purchase plan. Best practice is for all permanent employees to have access to such programs to participate.

criterion.title: 薪酬中基于绩效的可变部分
criterion.title_en: Variable performance-based component to pay
criterion.definition: 说明非管理人员和非销售员工是否有资格获得基于绩效的可变薪酬，如奖金。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether non-officer and non-sales staff are eligible for variable performance-based pay, such as bonuses.

criterion.title: 有资格享受带薪育儿假政策的员工范围
criterion.title_en: Workforce eligible for paid parental leave policy
criterion.definition: 评估公司员工有资格享受实质性非现金福利的程度，通过公司的带薪育儿假政策进行评估，同时考虑带薪假的时长和员工覆盖范围（基于公开可得信息）。行业领先实践是公司的带薪育儿假政策覆盖其全球业务中的所有员工。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company’s workforce is eligible for material non-pay benefits, evaluated through the company’s paid parental leave policies, considering both the duration of paid leave and the scope of employee coverage based on publicly available information. The industry-leading practice is when a company’s paid parental leave policies cover all employees across its global operations.

criterion.title: 定期的绩效评估和反馈流程
criterion.title_en: Regular performance appraisals and feedback processes
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否开展以及开展程度如何的员工职业发展项目，如绩效评估、目标设定与回顾等。最佳实践是此类项目提供给所有正式员工。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether and to what extent the company undertakes programs for employee professional development, such as performance reviews, goal setting and review, or similar. Best practice is for such programs to be provided to all permanent employees.

criterion.title: 技能与知识发展培训
criterion.title_en: Skills and knowledge development training
criterion.definition: 管理/领导力发展培训的程度。最佳实践是全体员工参与培训项目。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of managerial/leadership development training. Best practice is a training program in which all employees participate.

criterion.title: 相对于同业组的员工流动率绩效
criterion.title_en: Employee turnover rate performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司在所报告的员工流动率以及员工流动率趋势方面相对于同业组的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示绩效强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on reported employee turnover rate, and trend in employee turnover rate, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: 员工流失率行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Employee turnover rate industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业员工流失率的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on employee turnover rate relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对于同业组的员工流动率绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均员工流动率
criterion.title_en: Three-year average employee turnover rate
criterion.definition: 衡量公司的三年平均员工流动率。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average employee turnover rate.
criterion.parent: 员工流失率行业相对得分

criterion.title: 员工流失率行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Employee turnover rate industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业员工流失率同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year trend in employee turnover rate, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对于同业组的员工流动率绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均员工流动率趋势
criterion.title_en: Three-year average employee turnover rate trend
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年平均的同比员工流动率趋势。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year employee turnover rate trend.
criterion.parent: 员工流失率行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 作为理想雇主的外部认可（最近三年）
criterion.title_en: External recognition as employer of choice (last three years)
criterion.definition: 说明公司在最近三年是否获得作为理想雇主的外部认可。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company received external recognition as an employer of choice in the last three years.

criterion.title: 员工股权方案
criterion.title_en: Employee equity programs
criterion.definition: 员工持股计划和/或员工购股计划的适用资格范围。最佳实践是让所有正式员工都能参与此类方案。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of eligibility for an employee stock ownership plan and/or an employee stock purchase plan. Best practice is for all permanent employees to have access to such programs to participate.

criterion.title: 符合带薪育儿假政策资格的员工
criterion.title_en: Workforce eligible for paid parental leave policy
criterion.definition: 评估公司员工符合实质性非薪酬福利资格的程度，通过公司的带薪育儿假政策进行评估，同时考虑带薪假期时长和基于公开信息可得的员工覆盖范围。行业领先实践是公司的带薪育儿假政策覆盖其全球运营中的所有员工。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent to which the company’s workforce is eligible for material non-pay benefits, evaluated through the company’s paid parental leave policies, considering both the duration of paid leave and the scope of employee coverage based on publicly available information. The industry-leading practice is when a company’s paid parental leave policies cover all employees across its global operations.

criterion.title: 浮动绩效薪酬组件适用的员工范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of workforce eligibility for variable performance-based component to pay
criterion.definition: 表明非高管员工是否有资格获得浮动绩效薪酬（如奖金），并考虑符合绩效薪酬资格的员工范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether non-officer staff are eligible for variable performance-based pay, such as bonuses, and considers the scope of employees eligible for performance-based pay.

criterion.title: 员工满意度调查频率
criterion.title_en: Employee satisfaction survey frequency
criterion.definition: 员工满意度调查的频率。最佳实践是至少每年一次。
criterion.definition_en: The frequency of employee satisfaction surveys. Best practice is at least annually.

criterion.title: 重组政策与方案
criterion.title_en: Restructuring policies and programs
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否在重组或裁员后为员工制定了明确的政策，例如提供遣散费或再就业安置、重新就业或再培训方面的协助。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has established clear policies for employees following a restructuring or layoff, such as offering severance pay or assistance with outplacement, reemployment or retraining.

criterion.title: 技能与知识发展培训
criterion.title_en: Skills and knowledge development training
criterion.definition: 管理/领导力发展培训的范围。最佳实践是所有员工都参与的培训计划。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of managerial/leadership development training. Best practice is a training program in which all employees participate.

criterion.title: 对员工学位项目或认证的支持
criterion.title_en: Support for degree programs or certifications for employees
criterion.definition: 公司员工有资格通过学费或费用报销等方式获得攻读学位项目或获取新认证支持的范围。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of the company's workforce eligible for support in pursuing degree programs or new certifications through tuition or fees reimbursement, etc.

criterion.title: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of supplier code of conduct
criterion.definition: 评估供应商行为准则中对关键劳工标准的纳入情况，如工资、工作时间和劳动者保护。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses inclusion of key labor standards in supplier code of conduct such as wages, working hours and worker protections. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖反歧视
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers anti-discrimination
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否规定了禁止供应商歧视其员工的要求。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements forbidding suppliers from engaging in discrimination regarding their employees.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖童工
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers child labor
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否禁止供应商使用未成年劳工。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct forbids suppliers to use underage labor.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖强迫劳动
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers forced labor
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否禁止供应商使用强迫劳动。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct forbids suppliers to use forced labor.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖结社自由
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers freedom of association
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否要求供应商尊重结社自由，并允许有意愿的工人加入工会。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements that suppliers respect freedom of association and allow workers to unionize if desired.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖健康与安全
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers health and safety
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否对供应商工厂的健康与安全工作条件作出要求。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements regarding health and safety working conditions at supplier factories.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖最低工资
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers minimum wage
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否对供应商必须支付给员工的最低工资作出要求。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements regarding the minimum wages that suppliers must pay their employees.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖加班报酬
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers paid overtime
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否要求供应商在员工必须加班时支付加班工资。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements that suppliers pay overtime wages when employees must work overtime hours.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 供应链行为准则涵盖工作时间
criterion.title_en: Supply chain code of conduct covers working hours
criterion.definition: 说明企业供应链行为准则是否限制供应商每日或每周可要求员工工作的时数。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s supply chain code of conduct sets forth requirements limiting the amount of hours suppliers’ employees may be required to work in a day or a week.
criterion.parent: 供应商行为准则的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 就劳工相关社会议题培训供应商
criterion.title_en: Trains suppliers on labor related social issues
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否有针对其供应商行为准则或特定劳工相关议题的具体培训项目。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has specific training programs in place with its suppliers on its supplier code of conduct or specific labor-related issues.

criterion.title: 基于劳工管理绩效的供应商选择
criterion.title_en: Supplier selection based on labor management performance
criterion.definition: 说明公司在分配或续签合同，和/或下达进一步订单时是否考虑供应商的绩效。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company considers suppliers’ performance in allocating or renewing contracts, and/or placing further orders.

criterion.title: 供应商审计的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of supplier audits
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否在其供应链中开展内部和/或外部审计。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company conducts internal and/or external audits across its supply chain.

criterion.title: 针对供应商不当行为采取的行动
criterion.title_en: Action taken to address supplier misconduct
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否提供证据，表明在发现违反其行为准则的事件时会制定整改行动计划。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company provides evidence of developing a remediation action plan when incidents of noncompliance with its code of conduct are found.

criterion.title: 对供应商不当行为事件的披露程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of disclosure on instances of supplier misconduct
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否披露在其供应链中发现的不合规事件的频率和类型。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company discloses the frequency and type of noncompliance incidents found in its supply chain.

criterion.title: 供应商审计的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of supplier audits
criterion.definition: 评估公司供应链中开展的审计程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 分表示举措强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the extent of audits conducted across the company's supply chains. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 一级供应商审计（直接供应商）
criterion.title_en: Tier 1 supplier audits (direct suppliers)
criterion.definition: 说明企业社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部一级供应商（即直接供应商）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether some or all Tier 1 suppliers (i.e., direct suppliers) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
criterion.parent: 供应商审计的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 二级供应商审计（零部件）
criterion.title_en: Tier 2 suppliers audits (components)
criterion.definition: 说明企业社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部二级供应商（即零部件供应商）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether some or all Tier 2 suppliers (i.e., components) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
criterion.parent: 供应商审计的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 三级供应商审计（原材料）
criterion.title_en: Tier 3 suppliers audits (raw materials)
criterion.definition: 说明企业社会审计计划是否覆盖部分或全部三级供应商（即原材料供应商）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether some or all Tier 3 suppliers (i.e., raw materials) are covered by the social audit program of the company.
criterion.parent: 供应商审计的覆盖范围

criterion.title: 申诉机制的有效性
criterion.title_en: Effectiveness of grievance mechanisms
criterion.definition: 评估供应链工人申诉机制的有效性。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the effectiveness of grievance mechanisms for supply chain workers.

criterion.title: 为供应链工人支付生活工资的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitment to pay living wage for workers in supply chains
criterion.definition: 评估公司向供应链工人支付生活工资的承诺。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's commitment to pay a living wage to its supply chain workers.

criterion.title: 化学品淘汰计划的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of chemical phase-out plan
criterion.definition: 公司计划淘汰的关注产品或关注化学品的范围。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of products or chemicals of concern that the company is targeting to phase out.

criterion.title: 识别监管风险物质的工作力度
criterion.title_en: Level of efforts to identify substances for regulatory risk
criterion.definition: 对公司产品中受监管或有可能受监管的化学品的识别程度。最佳实践是识别所有化学品。
criterion.definition_en: The level of identification of chemicals that are regulated or have the potential to be regulated in the company’s products. Best practice is to identify all chemicals.

criterion.title: 受监管物质注册与使用情况的披露范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of disclosure of registration and use of regulated substances
criterion.definition: 对属于法规注册要求的物质的披露程度。最佳实践是披露所有法规注册和使用情况。
criterion.definition_en: The level of disclosure around substances that fall within regulatory registration requirements. Best practice is to disclose all regulatory registrations and use.

criterion.title: 新产品设计中的环境和健康标准
criterion.title_en: Environmental and health standards in new product design
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有正式流程在新产品设计中应用环境和健康标准。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a formal process to apply environmental and health standards in new product design.

criterion.title: 减少对关注物质依赖的既往实绩
criterion.title_en: Demonstrated track record of reducing reliance on substances of concern
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有引入高关注物质可行替代品的既往实绩。专门适用于化学品生产商。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has demonstrated a track record of introducing viable alternatives to high-concern substances. Applies specifically to chemical producers.

criterion.title: 逐步淘汰和／或重新配制含受关注化学品产品的既往实绩
criterion.title_en: Demonstrated track record of phasing out and/or reformulating products with chemicals of concern
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有引入高关注物质可行替代品的既往实绩。专门适用于化学品生产商以外的产品制造商。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has demonstrated a track record of introducing viable alternatives to high-concern substances. Applies specifically to product manufacturers other than chemical producers.

criterion.title: 提升消费者对产品化学成分认知的举措
criterion.title_en: Initiatives to improve consumer awareness on product chemical content
criterion.definition: 通过消费者易于获取的渠道提升其对产品化学成分认知的举措力度。最佳实践是向消费者提供有关产品化学成分和使用的信息。专门适用于产品制造商。
criterion.definition_en: The level of initiatives to improve consumer awareness on product chemical content through channels that are easy for consumers to access. Best practice is to provide information regarding product chemical content and usage to consumers. Applies specifically to product manufacturers.

criterion.title: 公司开展危害评估的物质或产品范围
criterion.title_en: Extent of substances or products that a company conducts hazard assessments
criterion.definition: 描述公司开展化学品安全危害评估的物质或产品范围。专门适用于化学品生产商。
criterion.definition_en: Describes the extent of substances or products on which the company conducts a chemical safety hazard assessment. Applies specifically to chemical producers.

criterion.title: 债务催收政策
criterion.title_en: Debt collection policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否制定了正式的债务催收政策，并以对相关员工的培训为支持。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a formal debt collection policy supported by training of relevant employees.

criterion.title: 消费者金融保护方面的员工培训
criterion.title_en: Employee training on consumer financial protection
criterion.definition: 与消费者金融保护相关的员工培训方案的范围，包括金融素养和合乎道德的销售实践。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of employee training programs related to consumer financial protection, including financial literacy and ethical selling practices.

criterion.title: 公平广告政策
criterion.title_en: Fair advertising policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否制定了关于公平营销实践的政策，并以监督委员会或对相关员工的培训为支持。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a policy on fair marketing practices supported by an oversight committee or training of relevant employees.

criterion.title: 金融教育举措与利益相关方沟通
criterion.title_en: Financial education initiatives and stakeholder outreach
criterion.definition: 提升金融素养的方案覆盖程度，方式包括与金融教育组织建立正式合作、针对特定人群的定向举措或一般性沟通方案。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of programs to improve financial literacy, either through formal partnerships with financial education organizations, targeted initiatives for specific demographics or general outreach programs.

criterion.title: 公司提供贷款重组选项
criterion.title_en: Company offers loan modification options
criterion.definition: 表明是否向零售客户提供贷款重组选项，包括基于收入的还款计划和升级选项的获取途径。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether loan modification options are available to retail customers, including income-based repayment plans and access to escalation options.

criterion.title: 投诉解决流程的监督
criterion.title_en: Oversight of complaint resolution process
criterion.definition: 表明是否存在针对客户投诉的董事会层面监督、管理层委员会监督或正式监督小组。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is board-level oversight, management-level committee oversight, or a formal monitoring group for customer complaints.

criterion.title: 金融产品投诉处理流程
criterion.title_en: Financial product complaint handling process
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否通过客户申诉专员、内部投诉审查机构或投诉热线建立了处理客户投诉的正式流程。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a formal process to handle customer complaints through a customer ombudsman, an internal complaint review body or a complaint hotline.

criterion.title: 金融产品或服务审查的监督
criterion.title_en: Oversight of financial product or service reviews
criterion.definition: 表明是否存在负责审查产品和服务的董事会层面监督、管理层委员会监督或其他内部审查机构。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is board-level oversight, management-level committee oversight or another internal review body that is responsible for reviewing products and services.

criterion.title: 提供高风险贷款产品的证据
criterion.title_en: Evidence of offering high-risk lending products
criterion.definition: 表明是否有证据显示公司提供高风险贷款产品。高风险贷款产品包括但不限于发薪日贷款、典当贷款、上门贷款、产权贷款、车辆登记证贷款、退税预期贷款，以及具有掠夺性利率或费用的贷款。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether there is evidence the company offers high-risk lending products. High risk lending products includes, but is not limited to, payday, pawn, doorstep, title, logbook, tax refund anticipation, and loans with predatory interest rates or fees.

criterion.title: 投诉增长（三年滚动平均）
criterion.title_en: Complaints growth (three-year rolling average)
criterion.definition: 表明基于三年滚动平均，针对公司的客户投诉是在增加、稳定还是减少。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the customer complaints against the company are increasing, stable, or decreasing based on a three-year rolling average.

criterion.title: 担保债券发行人的消费者金融保护实践得分
criterion.title_en: Consumer financial protection practices score for covered bond issuers
criterion.definition: 表明与担保池中资产相关的消费者金融保护实践的强度，以公司注册国贷款发放机构的平均实践作为代理。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示实践有力。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the strength of consumer financial protection practices relevant to the assets in the cover pool, proxied by the average practices of loan originators in the country of domicile. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong practices.

criterion.title: 担保债券发行人的消费者金融保护绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Consumer financial protection performance score for covered bond issuers
criterion.definition: 表明与担保池中资产相关的消费者金融保护指标上的绩效，以公司注册国贷款发放机构的平均绩效作为代理。以 0–10 分表示，其中 10 表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates performance on consumer financial protection metrics relevant to the assets in the cover pool, proxied by the average performance of loan originators in the country of domicile. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: 隐私与数据安全员工培训的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of employee training on privacy and data security
criterion.definition: 隐私与数据安全培训在全体员工中的覆盖范围。最佳实践是向所有员工（包括承包商）提供培训。
criterion.definition_en: The coverage of privacy and data security training across the workforce. Best practice is for training to be provided to all employees, including contractors.

criterion.title: 隐私与数据安全的责任归属
criterion.title_en: Responsibility for privacy and data security
criterion.definition: 负责公司隐私与数据安全风险及战略的团队（董事会层面委员会、最高管理层或执行委员会，或特别工作组或风险官）。
criterion.definition_en: The group (board-level committee, C-suite or executive committee, or special task force or risk officer) responsible for the company’s privacy and data security risk and strategy.

criterion.title: 应对数据泄露的措施
criterion.title_en: Measures to address data breaches
criterion.definition: 公司已建立的数据泄露或事件响应计划的范围，包括该计划是主动型、被动型还是范围有限。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of the data breach or incident response plan the company has in place, including whether the plan is proactive, reactive or limited in scope.

criterion.title: 信息安全系统审核的频率
criterion.title_en: Frequency of audits of information security system
criterion.definition: 公司审核其信息安全政策与系统的频率。
criterion.definition_en: The frequency with which the company audits its information security policies and systems.

criterion.title: 就数据控制向消费者提供的权利
criterion.title_en: Rights provided to consumers regarding the control of their data
criterion.definition: 公司就个人数据的访问、更正和删除向个人提供的权利范围。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the rights provided by the company to individuals regarding the access, rectification and deletion of individuals’ data.

criterion.title: 数据保护政策的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of data protection policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司的数据保护政策是涵盖全部还是选定的业务线。数据保护政策必须至少包含以下基本条款：(1) 明确收集目的，(2) 明确公司收集数据的方式，(3) 明确第三方是否可以访问数据及其目的。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company’s data protection policy governs all or selected business lines. A data protection policy must contain at least the following basic provisions: (1) clarifying collection purposes, (2) clarifying the means by which the company collects data, and (3) clarifying whether third parties have access to data and for what purposes.

criterion.title: 信息安全管理体系认证的范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of information security management system certifications
criterion.definition: 公司信息安全管理体系按广泛认可标准进行认证的范围。最佳实践是大部分（超过 80%）自有运营通过广泛认可标准的认证，如 ISO 27001、TRUSTe、Privacy Mark 和 SSAE16 soc2。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of the company’s information security management system certification to widely recognized standards. Best practice is for most (over 80%) of owned operations to be certified to widely recognized standards, such as ISO 27001, TRUSTe, Privacy Mark and SSAE16 soc2.

criterion.title: 隐私增强技术与举措
criterion.title_en: Privacy enhancing technologies and initiatives
criterion.definition: 评估公司将隐私增强技术与举措整合进其产品或服务的实践。最佳实践包括在产品或服务开发过程中系统性地应用隐私设计（privacy-by-design）原则，并在推出新产品之前对现有产品进行隐私影响评估。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s practice on integrating privacy-enhancing technologies and initiatives into its products or services. Best practices include systematically applying the privacy-by-design principle during product or service development, and conducting privacy impact assessments on existing offerings before introducing new ones.

criterion.title: 将消费者数据用于次要目的的同意政策
criterion.title_en: Consent policy for use of consumer data for secondary purposes
criterion.definition: 评估公司关于为次要目的处理客户数据的政策或实践，以及向客户提供的同意选项，例如选择加入（opt-in）或选择退出（opt-out）机制。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s policy or practice regarding the processing customer data for secondary purposes and the consent options provided to customers, such as opt-in or opt-out mechanisms.

criterion.title: 涵盖供应商与业务伙伴的数据保护方案
criterion.title_en: Data protection programs covering suppliers and business partners
criterion.definition: 公司覆盖处理其数据或可访问其网络的供应商与业务伙伴的数据保护或隐私方案的范围。最佳实践是要求他们制定数据保护政策或遵守公司的政策，并进行检查以核实其合规情况。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s data protection or privacy programs covering suppliers and business partners that handle the company’s data or have access to the company’s network. Best practice is for them to be required to have data protection policies or abide by the company’s policy and for inspections to be conducted to verify their compliance.

criterion.title: 确保产品库存充足、可靠和安全的应急预案/减缓控制系统的存在
criterion.title_en: Existence of contingency plans/mitigation control systems to ensure that products are in stock, reliable and safe
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否制定应急预案/减缓控制系统，以确保产品库存充足、可靠和安全。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has contingency plans/mitigation control systems to ensure that products are in stock, reliable, and safe.

criterion.title: 衡量并报告与服务质量绩效或客户保护相关的定量指标
criterion.title_en: Measures and reports quantitative indicators related to service quality performance or customer protection
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否衡量并报告与服务质量绩效或客户保护相关的定量指标（例如临床质量报告、客户调查）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company measures and reports quantitative indicators related to service quality performance or customer protection (e.g., clinical quality reports, customer surveys).

criterion.title: 产品安全或质量标准认证
criterion.title_en: Certification to product safety or quality standard
criterion.definition: 表明公司产品是否获得国际公认的安全与质量标准认证。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示举措有力。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company's products are certified to internationally recognized safety and quality standards. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 广泛认可的产品安全与质量标准认证范围
criterion.title_en: Extent of certification to a widely accepted product safety/quality standard
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否为自有运营取得广泛认可的产品安全与质量标准认证，例如 HACCP、ISO 9001、ISO/TS 16949、ISO 13485 或同等标准。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company certifies its own operations with a widely accepted product safety/quality standard (e.g., HACCP, ISO 9001, ISO/TS 16949, ISO 13485 or equivalent).
criterion.parent: 产品安全或质量标准认证

criterion.title: 内部制定的产品安全与质量标准认证范围
criterion.title_en: Extent of certification to an internally developed product safety/quality standard
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否为自有运营取得内部制定的产品安全与质量标准认证。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company certifies its own operations with an internally developed product safety/quality standard.
criterion.parent: 产品安全或质量标准认证

criterion.title: 员工产品质量培训范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of employee training on product quality
criterion.definition: 公司员工产品安全与质量培训的范围。最佳实践为所有员工均接受产品质量标准培训。
criterion.definition_en: The scope of the company’s employee training on product safety and quality. Best practice is for all employees to receive training on product quality standards.

criterion.title: 产品检测能力的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of product testing capacity
criterion.definition: 公司产品检测能力的程度，例如第三方或内部检测。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s product testing capacity, e.g., third-party or in-house testing.

criterion.title: 负责任营销的审计/控制程序
criterion.title_en: Audit/control procedures on responsible marketing
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否开展审计或控制程序，以评估其对负责任营销政策的遵守情况。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company conducts audits or control procedures to assess compliance with its responsible marketing policies.

criterion.title: 负责任营销、广告与销售政策
criterion.title_en: Policy on responsible marketing, advertising and sales
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否明确制定了负责任营销、广告与销售政策。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has explicitly stated a policy on responsible marketing, advertising and sales.

criterion.title: 加入公认的供应链风险评估与减缓行业范围伙伴关系
criterion.title_en: Membership in recognized industry-wide partnership(s) on supply chain risk evaluation and mitigation
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否为评估供应链风险并开展相关减缓方案的行业倡议或伙伴关系的成员。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company is a member of industry initiatives or partnerships that evaluate supply chain risk and undertake relevant mitigation programs.

criterion.title: 供应商认证水平
criterion.title_en: Supplier certification level
criterion.definition: 评估各层级供应商（例如一级、二级、三级）是否具备相关的安全与质量认证。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示举措有力。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses whether suppliers at each level (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3) possess relevant safety, and quality certifications. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 供应商质量程序认证的一般性声明
criterion.title_en: General statement on supplier certification of quality procedures
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否对供应链质量认证或监督作出一般性声明，但未进一步提供供应链具体层级的认证详情。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company makes general statements regarding the certification or oversight of its supply chain quality, without providing further detail on certification at specific levels of its supply chain
criterion.parent: 供应商认证水平

criterion.title: 一级直接供应商设施与流程由企业员工或第三方审计人员认证
criterion.title_en: Tier 1 - Direct supplier facilities and processes certified by company employees or third-party auditors
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否通过第三方或企业员工开展认证或审计，监督直接供应商（一级供应商）设施与流程的质量程序。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its direct supplier (Tier 1) facilities and processes through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
criterion.parent: 供应商认证水平

criterion.title: 二级间接或次级供应商设施与流程由企业员工或第三方审计人员认证
criterion.title_en: Tier 2 - Indirect/sub supplier facilities and processes certified by company employees or third-party auditors
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否通过第三方或企业员工开展认证或审计，监督间接或次级供应商（二级供应商）设施与流程的质量程序。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its indirect/sub-supplier (Tier 2) facilities and processes through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
criterion.parent: 供应商认证水平

criterion.title: 三级配料或原材料的质量定期检查
criterion.title_en: Tier 3 - Ingredients/raw materials checked for quality on a regular basis
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否通过第三方或企业员工开展认证或审计，监督配料或原材料（三级供应商）的质量程序。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company oversees the quality processes of its ingredients/raw materials (Tier 3) through certification or audits by a third party or by company employees.
criterion.parent: 供应商认证水平

criterion.title: 供应商质量标准培训范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of supplier training on quality standards
criterion.definition: 公司就质量标准、要求和流程对供应商开展培训的程度。最佳实践为培训所有供应商。
criterion.definition_en: The extent to which the company trains suppliers on quality standards, requirements, and processes. Best practice is to train all suppliers.

criterion.title: 产品责任与诚信
criterion.title_en: Product responsibility & integrity
criterion.definition: 评估公司在设计、交付和推广其产品与服务方面的负责任与道德程度。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示举措有力。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses how responsibly and ethically a company designs, delivers and promotes its products and services. Expressed as a 0-10 score, with 10 indicating strong initiatives.

criterion.title: 医疗赔付率（MLR）绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) performance score
criterion.definition: 评估企业医疗赔付率，反映保费用于医疗服务与行政成本的比例。得分越高，表示在管理式医疗中更符合服务质量和监管期望。仅适用于管理式医疗行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s Medical Loss Ratio, reflecting the proportion of premiums spent on medical services versus administrative costs. Higher scores indicate stronger alignment with service quality and regulatory expectations in managed healthcare. Applicable to Managed Healthcare industry only.
criterion.parent: 产品责任与诚信

criterion.title: 教学人员得分
criterion.title_en: Teaching staff score
criterion.definition: 评估教学人员占员工总数的比例。仅适用于教育服务行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the proportion of teaching staff relative to the total workforce. Applicable to Education Services industry only.
criterion.parent: 产品责任与诚信

criterion.title: 教学与营销费用比率得分
criterion.title_en: Instruction to marketing expense ratio score
criterion.definition: 评估教学及学生服务费用与营销及招生费用的比例。仅适用于教育服务行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the proportion of instruction and student services expenses to marketing and recruitment expenses. Applicable to Education Services industry only.
criterion.parent: 产品责任与诚信

criterion.title: 营销及招生费用得分
criterion.title_en: Marketing and recruitment expenses score
criterion.definition: 评估营销费用占销售收入总额的比例。仅适用于教育服务行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the proportion of marketing expenses relative to the total sales revenue. Applicable to Education Services industry only.
criterion.parent: 产品责任与诚信

criterion.title: 负责任博彩政策与实践得分
criterion.title_en: Responsible gambling policy & practices score
criterion.definition: 评估企业实施负责任博彩标准、政策与玩家保护措施的情况。仅适用于赌场与博彩行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's implementation of responsible gambling standards, policies, and player protection measures. Applicable to Casinos & Gaming industry only.
criterion.parent: 产品责任与诚信

criterion.title: 抗生素使用政策得分
criterion.title_en: Antibiotics use policy score
criterion.definition: 评估企业肉类生产与水产养殖中抗生素使用的政策框架和认证。仅适用于餐饮行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's policy framework and certifications related to antibiotic use in meat production and aquaculture. Applicable to Restaurants industry only.
criterion.parent: 产品责任与诚信

criterion.title: 逐步停用抗生素目标
criterion.title_en: Antibiotics phaseout targets
criterion.definition: 评估发行人在肉类生产与水产养殖中逐步停用非治疗性或高风险抗生素的计划是否存在及其稳健程度。仅适用于餐饮行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the presence and robustness of issuer plans to phase out non-therapeutic or high-risk antibiotic use in meat production and aquaculture . Applicable to Restaurants industry only.
criterion.parent: 产品责任与诚信

criterion.title: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效
criterion.title_en: Regulatory warning performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对同业组的绩效，依据监管机构发出的监管警告数量（警告信和美国 FDA 483 表格（“Form 483”））及其强度（按销售额标准化）。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance based on number or regulatory warnings (warning letters and U.S. FDA form 483s (“Form 483”)) and their intensities (normalized by sales) issued by regulatory authorities, relative to peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: 警告信行业相对绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Industry relative warning letters performance score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业收到警告信总数三年平均值的表现，同时考虑绝对数量及以销售额为分母的数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on three-year average of total number of Warning Letters received (both absolute and sales normalized), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均收到警告信数量（绝对值）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average warning letters received (absolute)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业收到警告信数量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average number of warning letters received.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均收到警告信数量（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average warning letters received (sales normalized)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业以销售额为分母的收到警告信数量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three year average number of warning letters received, normalized by sales.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

criterion.title: Form 483 行业相对绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Industry relative Form 483 performance score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业收到 Form 483 总数三年平均值的表现，同时考虑绝对数量及以销售额为分母的数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on three-year average of total number of Form 483s received (both absolute and sales normalized), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均收到 Form 483 数量（绝对值）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average Form 483 received (absolute)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业收到 Form 483 绝对数量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute number of Form 483s received.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均收到 Form 483 数量（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average Form 483 received (sales normalized)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业以销售额为分母的收到 Form 483 数量的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three year average number of Form 483 received, normalized by sales.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的监管警告绩效

criterion.title: 相对同业组的保修绩效
criterion.title_en: Warranty performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对于行业同业的质保支付表现（按销售额归一化）及其趋势。原文接着写“以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示”，但句子未完；未补写其含义。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on warranty payments (normalized by sales) and its trend, relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates

criterion.title: 保修付款行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Warranty payments industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估企业保修付款强度。原文分母写为“每单位销售额或”，语句残缺；以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s warranty payments intensity (per unit of sales or), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的保修绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均保修付款（每百万收入）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average warranty payments (per million revenue)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业以收入为分母的保修付款的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average warranty payments normalized by revenue.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的保修绩效

criterion.title: 保修付款行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Warranty Payments Industry Relative Trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估企业保修付款强度（每单位销售额）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average of year-over-year warranty payments intensity trend (per unit of sales), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的保修绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均保修付款同比趋势（每百万收入）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average year-over-year warranty payments trend (per million revenue)
criterion.definition: 衡量企业以收入为分母的保修付款同比变化的三年平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year change in warranty payments normalized by revenue.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的保修绩效

criterion.title: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效
criterion.title_en: Product recall performance relative to peers
criterion.definition: 评估公司相对行业同业组的产品召回绩效。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示绩效强劲。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance with respect to product recalls, relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.

criterion.title: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）
criterion.title_en: Industry relative recalls performance score (absolute)
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估按严重、中度和轻微程度区分的召回总数表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the total number of recalls, disaggregated by severity (severe, moderate, and minor), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均绝对严重召回总数
criterion.title_en: Three-year average absolute total severe recalls
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内性质为严重的召回绝对总数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute total number of recalls that are severe in nature.
criterion.parent: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）

criterion.title: 三年平均绝对中等召回总数
criterion.title_en: Three-year average absolute total moderate recalls
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内性质为中等的召回绝对总数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute total number of recalls that are moderate in nature.
criterion.parent: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）

criterion.title: 三年平均绝对轻微召回总数
criterion.title_en: Three-year average absolute total minor recalls
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内性质为轻微的召回绝对总数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of absolute total number of recalls that are minor in nature.
criterion.parent: 召回行业相对绩效得分（绝对值）

criterion.title: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）
criterion.title_en: Industry relative recalls performance score (sales based)
criterion.definition: 相对于行业同业，评估以销售额为分母、并按严重、中度和轻微程度区分的召回强度表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on recall intensity normalized by sales, disaggregated by severity (severe, moderate, and minor), relative to industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均严重召回总数（基于销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average total severe recalls (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的性质为中等的召回总数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls that are moderate in nature normalized by sales.
criterion.parent: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）

criterion.title: 三年平均中等召回总数（基于销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average total moderate recalls (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的性质为中等的召回总数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls that are moderate in nature normalized by sales.
criterion.parent: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）

criterion.title: 三年平均轻微召回总数（基于销售额）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average total minor recalls (sales based)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的性质为轻微的召回总数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls that are minor in nature normalized by sales.
criterion.parent: 召回行业相对绩效得分（按销售额）

criterion.title: 汽车召回绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Automobile recalls performance score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业召回强度及其趋势指标（每辆生产或销售汽车对应的召回车辆数量）的综合表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于汽车行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s overall performance on recall intensity and trend metrics (vehicles recalled per vehicle manufactured or sold) relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to automobiles industry only.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

criterion.title: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Recalls per vehicle sales industry relative score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业车辆召回强度指标，即每辆销售汽车对应的召回车辆数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on vehicle-recall intensity metrics (vehicles recalled per vehicle sold), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均召回数（按已售汽车数量标准化）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average of recalls (normalized by number of vehicles sold)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内按已售汽车数量标准化的召回总数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of total number of recalls, normalized by number of vehicles sold.
criterion.parent: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对得分

criterion.title: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对趋势得分
criterion.title_en: Recalls per vehicle sales industry relative trend score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业车辆召回强度（每辆销售汽车对应的召回车辆数量）同比变化趋势的三年平均表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on the three-year average year-over-year trend in vehicle-recall intensity (vehicles recalled per vehicle sold), relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
criterion.parent: 相对同业组的产品召回绩效

criterion.title: 三年平均召回数同比趋势（按已售汽车数量标准化）
criterion.title_en: Three-year average of year-over-year trend in recalls (normalized by number of vehicles sold)
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内按已售汽车数量标准化的召回总数同比趋势的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-trend in total number of recalls, normalized by number of vehicles sold.
criterion.parent: 每辆销售汽车召回数量行业相对趋势得分

criterion.title: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Industry-specific Product Safety and Quality Performance score
criterion.definition: 评估公司在与产品安全与质量相关的行业专属指标上的绩效。以 0-10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's performance on industry-specific metrics related to product safety and quality. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 适航指令绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Airworthiness directives performance score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业三年期间遵守航空监管机构适航指令的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于航空航天与国防行业中具有飞机业务收入的企业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on compliance with airworthiness directives issued by aviation regulators over a three-year period relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to Aerospace & Defense companies with revenues in Aircrafts segments only.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 适航指令强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Industry Relative airworthiness directives intensity score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估企业适航指令强度指标，即每单位销售额对应的适航指令数量。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on airworthiness-directive intensity metrics (number of airworthiness directives per sales) relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 三年平均适航指令强度
criterion.title_en: Three-year average airworthiness directives intensity
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内按销售额标准化的适航指令数量的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average number of airworthiness directives normalized by sales.
criterion.parent: 适航指令强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 航空事故绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Air incidents performance score
criterion.definition: 评估企业航空事故造成的死亡和飞机损坏表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于客运航空行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on aviation incidents leading to fatalities and damage caused to the aircraft due to aviation incidents. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to Passenger airlines industry only.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 航空事故死亡得分
criterion.title_en: Aviation Incidents Fatality score
criterion.definition: 评估企业航空事故造成死亡人数的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on number of fatalities due to air incidents. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 三年平均死亡人数
criterion.title_en: Three-year average number of fatalities
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内因航空事故造成的死亡人数的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three year average number of fatalities caused due to aviation incidents.
criterion.parent: 航空事故死亡得分

criterion.title: 飞机损坏强度行业相对得分
criterion.title_en: Industry Relative Aircraft Damage intensity score
criterion.definition: 相对于同业，评估以销售额为分母的飞机损坏强度表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on damage caused to the aircraft intensity (normalized by sales), relative to peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 三年平均飞机损伤强度
criterion.title_en: Three-year average aircraft damage intensity
criterion.definition: 衡量公司三年内因航空事故造成的飞机损伤强度（按销售额标准化）的平均值。
criterion.definition_en: Measures the company’s three-year average of aircrafts damaged intensity (normalized by sales) due to aviation incidents.
criterion.parent: 飞机损坏强度行业相对得分

criterion.title: 管理式医疗绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Managed healthcare performance score
criterion.definition: 根据 CMS 星级评级或 IDSS 得分，评估企业医疗计划质量与安全指标的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示最高绩效水平。仅适用于管理式医疗行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on healthcare plan quality and safety metrics based on CMS Star Ratings or IDSS scores. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance. Applicable to managed healthcare industry only.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 水质标准得分
criterion.title_en: Water quality standards score
criterion.definition: 评估企业遵守饮用水质量标准和法规的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。仅适用于水务公用事业行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on compliance with drinking-water-quality standards and regulations. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. Applicable to water utilities industry only.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 标签或营销事件绩效得分
criterion.title_en: Labelling or marketing incidents performance score
criterion.definition: 评估企业遵守行业或监管标签与营销准则的表现。以 0–10 分表示，10 表示表现较强。仅适用于饮料行业。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s performance on compliance with industry or regulatory labeling and marketing codes. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance. Applicable to Beverages industry only.
criterion.parent: 行业专属产品安全与质量绩效得分

criterion.title: 负责在投资流程中分析 ESG 议题的专职 ESG 分析师
criterion.title_en: Dedicated ESG analysts responsible for analyzing ESG issues in investment process
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有专门的个人或团队负责在投资流程中分析 ESG 议题，或公司是否为投资分析师提供 ESG 议题培训。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a dedicated individual or team responsible for analyzing ESG issues in the investment process or if the company provides training on ESG issues to investment analysts.

criterion.title: 纳入 ESG 考量的负责任投资政策
criterion.title_en: Responsible investment policy to incorporate ESG considerations
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有将 ESG 考量纳入投资流程的政策和程序。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has policies and procedures to incorporate ESG considerations in the investment process.

criterion.title: 各资产类别投资流程中纳入 ESG 因素的最高程度
criterion.title_en: Highest level of ESG factors incorporation in investment process across asset classes
criterion.definition: 评估在六类资产类别（上市股票、公司固定收益、非公司固定收益、私募股权、房地产以及对冲基金/另类投资）的投资流程中所观察到的纳入 ESG 因素的最高程度。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示纳入程度最高。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the highest level of ESG factors incorporation observed across the investment process for six asset classes: listed equity, corporate fixed income, non-corporate fixed income, private equity, real estate, and hedge funds/alternative investments. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates highest level of incorporation.

criterion.title: 负责 ESG 参与事务的专职人员
criterion.title_en: Dedicated staff responsible for ESG engagement
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有专门的个人或团队负责监督和执行其 ESG 参与或代理投票政策。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a dedicated individual or team responsible for monitoring and implementing its ESG engagement or proxy voting policies.

criterion.title: 涉及环境、社会和治理议题的详细参与政策
criterion.title_en: Detailed engagement policy that addresses environmental, social and governance issues
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有涉及环境、社会和治理议题的参与或代理投票政策。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has an engagement or proxy voting policy that addresses environmental, social and governance issues.

criterion.title: 金融服务移动/线上分销渠道的创新
criterion.title_en: Innovation in mobile/online distribution channels for financial services
criterion.definition: 公司在移动/线上分销渠道方面的创新。最佳实践是针对服务不足人群的移动/线上分销领域的行业领先创新。仅适用于金融机构。
criterion.definition_en: The company's innovation in mobile/online distribution channels. Best practice is sector-leading innovation in mobile/online distribution targeting underserved demographics. Applies to financial institutions only.

criterion.title: 金融服务其他替代性无网点分销渠道的创新
criterion.title_en: Innovation in other alternative branchless distribution channels for financial services
criterion.definition: 公司在替代性无网点分销渠道（如代理机构、与零售商店/邮局的合作）方面的创新。仅适用于金融机构。
criterion.definition_en: The company’s innovation in alternative branchless distribution channels (e.g., correspondents, partnerships with retail stores/post offices). Applies to financial institutions only.

criterion.title: 面向无银行账户、银行服务不足或未得到充分服务群体的金融素养举措
criterion.title_en: Financial literacy initiatives for unbanked, underbanked, or underserved groups
criterion.definition: 评估公司旨在提升无银行账户、银行服务不足或未得到充分服务的客户及社区的金融素养的举措。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's initiatives aimed at improving financial literacy for unbanked, underbanked, or underserved customers and communities.

criterion.title: 面向无银行账户、银行服务不足或未得到充分服务客户的金融解决方案
criterion.title_en: Financial solutions targeting unbanked, underbanked, or underserved customers
criterion.definition: 评估公司旨在服务未得到充分服务的个人及中小企业（SMEs）的贷款解决方案。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's lending solutions designed to serve underserved individuals and small-and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).

criterion.title: 参与小额信贷/小额保险的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of involvement in microfinance/microinsurance
criterion.definition: 参与小额信贷或小额保险的类型。最佳实践是公司直接向客户提供小额信贷或小额保险产品。参与形式也可以是通过机构合作、投资工具或慈善捐赠。
criterion.definition_en: The type of involvement in microfinance or microinsurance. Best practice is for the company to directly provide microfinance or microinsurance products to customers. Involvement may also come in the form of institutional partnerships, investment vehicles, or charitable giving.

criterion.title: 中小企业贷款评估
criterion.title_en: Assessment of lending to small and medium-size enterprises
criterion.definition: 评估公司对中小企业的贷款占总贷款的比例，并与行业同业进行对比。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company's lending to small and medium-size enterprises as a percentage of total lending, relative to industry peers.

criterion.title: 中小企业贷款增长评估
criterion.title_en: Assessment of growth in lending to small and medium-size enterprises
criterion.definition: 评估中小企业贷款的同比增速，并与行业同业进行对比。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the year-over-year growth in lending to small and medium-size enterprises, relative to industry peers.

criterion.title: 公司已商业化产品所涵盖的相关疾病数量
criterion.title_en: Number of relevant diseases addressed by the company’s commercialized products
criterion.definition: 在本关键议题范围内、公司已有产品上市销售的疾病数量。
criterion.definition_en: The number of diseases within the scope of this key issue for which the company has commercialized products on the market.

criterion.title: 公司研发所涵盖的相关疾病数量
criterion.title_en: Number of relevant diseases addressed by the company’s research and development
criterion.definition: 在本关键议题范围内、公司正在开展研发的疾病数量。
criterion.definition_en: The number of diseases within the scope of this key issue for which the company has ongoing research and development.

criterion.title: 向低收入和中等收入国家扩张计划的覆盖范围
criterion.title_en: Scope of expansion plans to low-income and middle-income countries
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否明确表示计划将业务和市场扩展至世界银行定义的低收入和中等收入国家。适用于制药、生物技术和医疗器械的业务和市场。
