criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company explicitly states it plans to expand operations and markets to low-income and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. Applies to pharmaceutical, biotech and medical devices operations and markets.

criterion.title: 协助本地制造商达到国际药品生产质量
criterion.title_en: Assistance to local manufacturers to achieve international drug manufacturing quality standards in low- and middle-income countries
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否开展举措，以提升低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）本地制造商按国际质量标准（如世界卫生组织的《药品生产质量管理规范》）生产产品的能力。这些举措旨在与本地利益相关方合作满足本地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve the capacity of local manufacturers in low-and middle-income countries (as defined by the World Bank) to manufacture products to international quality standards such as the World Health Organization’s Good Manufacturing Practices. These initiatives aim to address local needs, in partnership with local stakeholders, and may have long-term sustainability aims.

criterion.title: 支持低收入和中等收入国家的药物警戒
criterion.title_en: Supports pharmacovigilance in low- and middle-income countries
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否支持在低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）开展能力建设举措，以提升药物警戒能力（即监测药品和疫苗售后的效果，以发现和评估不良反应或任何其他与药品或疫苗相关的问题）。这些举措通常与本地相关合作方共同开展，并与本地需求保持一致，其目标和成果通常会被衡量。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company supports initiatives to build capacity to improve pharmacovigilance capability (i.e., monitoring the effects of drugs and vaccines after sale to detect and assess adverse effects or any other medicine-or vaccine-related problem) in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives are typically carried out with local relevant partners and aligned with local needs, and their goals and outcomes are generally measured.

criterion.title: 培训低收入和中等收入国家的本地医护工作者
criterion.title_en: Trains local healthcare workers in low- and middle-income countries
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否开展举措，培训低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）的医护工作者，以加强现有卫生系统并建设本地能力。这些举措旨在与本地利益相关方合作满足本地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to train health care workers in low-and middle-income countries (as defined by the World Bank) to strengthen the existing health system and build local capacity. These initiatives aim to address local needs in partnership with local stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims.

criterion.title: 通过药品供应链举措改善患者获得产品的可及性
criterion.title_en: Improves availability of products to patients through pharmaceutical supply chain initiatives in low- and middle-income countries
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否在低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）开展举措，以改善其自身供应链之外的药品供应链。这些举措旨在与本地利益相关方合作满足本地需求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。示例包括改善基本药物最后一公里供应的举措。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve the pharmaceutical supply chain, beyond its own supply chain, in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs in partnership with local stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims. Examples include initiatives to improve the last-mile supply of essential medicines.

criterion.title: 参与旨在改善本地研发的公私合作
criterion.title_en: Involvement in public-private partnerships for improving local research and development capacity in low- and middle-income countries
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否开展公私合作，以增强低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）的本地研发能力。这些举措旨在与相关利益相关方合作满足本地需求和技术要求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company undertakes public-private partnerships to strengthen local research and development capability in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs and skill requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders, and may have long-term sustainability aims.

criterion.title: 低收入和中等收入国家公共卫生基础设施、信息或卫生项目的能力建设
criterion.title_en: Capacity building of public health infrastructure, information, or health programs in low- and middle-income countries
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否开展举措，从基础设施、信息或卫生项目方面改善低收入和中等收入国家（世界银行定义）的公共卫生系统。这些举措旨在与相关利益相关方合作满足本地需求和技术要求，并可能具有长期可持续发展目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company undertakes initiatives to improve public health systems in terms of infrastructure, information, or health programs in low-and middle-income countries as defined by the World Bank. These initiatives aim to address local needs and skill requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and may have long-term sustainability aims.

criterion.title: 已发出或已获得的非独占自愿许可数量
criterion.title_en: Number of non-exclusive voluntary licenses issued or received
criterion.definition: 专利权人已发出、或仿制药制造商已获得的非独占自愿许可（NEVL）数量，此类许可允许其他制造商生产和供应专利药品的仿制版本。
criterion.definition_en: The number of non-exclusive voluntary licenses (NEVLs) that a patent holder has issued or that a generic manufacturer has received to allow the manufacture and supply of generic versions of patented medicines by other manufacturers.

criterion.title: 基于可负担性的定价政策的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of pricing policies based on affordability
criterion.definition: 说明公司是否对其产品在国家之间、国家内部或两个层面实施分级定价（即根据当地支付能力调整价格）。适用于专利药品、仿制药、疫苗和医疗器械。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company implements tiered pricing (i.e., tailoring the price according to local ability to pay) for its products between countries, within countries or on both levels. Applies to patented drugs, generics, vaccines and medical devices.

criterion.title: 与药品专利池签署许可协议或订立生产合同
criterion.title_en: Signed licensing agreements or entered into manufacturing contracts with the Medicines Patent Pool (MPP)
criterion.definition: 公司与药品专利池（Medicines Patent Pool，MPP）之间许可协议或生产合同的程度。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of the company’s licensing agreements or manufacturing contracts with the Medicines Patent Pool (MPP).

criterion.title: 发达市场和发展中市场的定价透明度
criterion.title_en: Pricing transparency in developed and developing markets
criterion.definition: 描述公司就其产品定价所提供信息的详细程度。仅适用于医疗健康公司。
criterion.definition_en: Describes the level of detail provided by a company regarding its product pricing. Applies to healthcare companies only.

criterion.title: 是否开展解决抗生素耐药性的研发（例如内部研发或合作）
criterion.title_en: Is the company conducting R&D to address antibiotic resistance (e.g., in-house R&D, partnerships)?
criterion.definition: 说明企业是否参与抗生素管理举措，例如合作研发解决抗生素耐药性的方案，或与行业同业、学术机构及其他主体合作解决抗生素耐药性。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company engages in antibiotic stewardship initiatives, such as collaboration on research and development of solutions for antibiotic resistance, or partnerships with industry peers, academia, or other entities to address antibiotic resistance.

criterion.title: 开发更健康产品的内部创新能力
criterion.title_en: In-house innovation capacity to develop healthier products
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有专门用于开发更健康和更天然产品的资源。领先实践是设立专门的研究中心和人员来开发更健康的产品。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has resources dedicated to developing healthier and more natural products. Leading practice is to have dedicated research centers and staff to develop healthier products.

criterion.title: 开发天然和健康产品的战略
criterion.title_en: Strategy to develop natural and healthy products
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有进一步开发天然和健康产品的战略。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a strategy to further develop natural and healthy products.

criterion.title: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分
criterion.title_en: Food & beverage nutrition enhancement programs score
criterion.definition: 评估公司改善其食品饮料产品营养成分的努力。最高绩效体现为减少人工成分、脂肪、钠、糖和份量的综合方案，通过营养强化和使用天然成分提升产品。以 0–10 分表示，10 分表示绩效最高水平。
criterion.definition_en: Assesses the company’s efforts to improve the nutritional profile of its food and beverage products. Highest performance reflects comprehensive programs to reduce artificial ingredients, fat, sodium, sugar, and portion size, enhance products through fortification and use natural ingredients. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.

criterion.title: 减少食品中人工成分的计划覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to reduce artificial ingredients in food products
criterion.definition: 所含人工成分（例如防腐剂、色素、阿斯巴甜）更少或为零，或争议性成分（例如抗生素）更少或为零的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products that contain less or no artificial ingredients (e.g., preservatives, colorings, aspartame) or less or no controversial ingredients (e.g., antibiotics).
criterion.parent: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

criterion.title: 缩小产品份量的计划覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to reduce portion size
criterion.definition: 经重新配方或设计、缩小份量的产品所产生收入的估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of revenues generated from products reformulated with reduced portions.
criterion.parent: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

criterion.title: 减少食品中糖含量的计划覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to reduce sugar in food products
criterion.definition: 经重新配方、含糖量更低的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products reformulated with less sugar.
criterion.parent: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

criterion.title: 减少食品中脂肪含量的计划覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to reduce fat in food products
criterion.definition: 经重新配方、脂肪含量更低的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the estimated share of revenues generated from food/beverage products reformulated with less fat.
criterion.parent: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

criterion.title: 减少食品中钠含量的计划覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to reduce sodium in food products
criterion.definition: 经重新配方、含盐量更低的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the estimated share of revenues generated from food/beverage products reformulated with less salt.
criterion.parent: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

criterion.title: 针对营养素缺乏改善或强化产品的计划覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of programs to enhance or fortify products to address nutrient deficiencies
criterion.definition: 为减少营养素缺乏而强化营养（例如维生素 A、锌、碘、铁）的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the estimated share of revenues generated from food/beverage products fortified to reduce nutrient deficiencies (e.g. vitamin A, zinc, iodine, iron).
criterion.parent: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

criterion.title: 使用更多天然成分的举措覆盖程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of initiatives to use more natural ingredients
criterion.definition: 获得有机标准认证的食品及饮料产品所产生收入的估计占比。
criterion.definition_en: The estimated share of revenues generated from food and beverage products that are certified to organic standards.
criterion.parent: 食品饮料营养强化方案评分

criterion.title: 承诺不在保护区内运营
criterion.title_en: Commitment to refrain from operating in protected areas
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否已承诺避免在高保护价值区域（如世界遗产地或具有文化意义的区域）运营。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a company has made a commitment to avoid operating in high-conservation areas, such as World Heritage sites or areas of cultural significance.

criterion.title: 在新区域落户前开展社区影响评估
criterion.title_en: Conducts community impact assessment prior to settling in new areas
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否按照自由、事先和知情同意（FPIC）原则开展社区影响评估，或在开发新区域之前是否有任何社区参与的迹象。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a company conducts community impact assessments in line with the principles of Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) or whether there is any evidence of community engagement prior to developing in new areas.

criterion.title: 原住民政策
criterion.title_en: Indigenous people policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有政策以尽量减少对原住民及其传统生活方式的社区影响。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a policy to minimize community impacts on indigenous people and their traditional way of life.

criterion.title: 当地社区参与方式
criterion.title_en: Local community engagement approach
criterion.definition: 表明公司当地社区参与的方式是否包含主动举措，如申诉报告机制和正式的社区参与渠道。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a company’s approach to local community engagement includes proactive programs, such as grievance reporting mechanisms and formal community engagement channels.

criterion.title: 监测其人权政策的有效性
criterion.title_en: Monitors the effectiveness of its human rights policy
criterion.definition: 衡量人权政策有效性的监测程度，以及公司是否承诺目标或报告人权目标的进展。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of monitoring to measure the effectiveness of human rights policies, and whether the company commits to targets or reports progress against human rights targets.

criterion.title: 人权保护员工培训
criterion.title_en: Employee training on human rights protection
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有关于人权的员工培训方案。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has employee training programs on human rights.

criterion.title: 道德行为政策涵盖合同安保服务提供商
criterion.title_en: Ethical conduct policy covers contract security providers
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有适用于合同安保服务提供商的正式商业道德政策，以及该政策是否有审计支持以确保合规。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a company has a formal business ethics policy that applies to contract security providers and whether that policy is supported by auditing to ensure compliance.

criterion.title: 人权政策
criterion.title_en: Human rights policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否采用了正式的人权政策，以及该政策是否与《联合国人权宣言》一致。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a company has adopted a formal human rights policy and whether that policy is aligned with the United Nations Declaration of Human Rights.

criterion.title: 暴力与冲突政策
criterion.title_en: Violence and conflict policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有与暴力和冲突相关的正式政策或非正式承诺。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a formal policy or informal commitment related to violence and conflict.

criterion.title: 本地采购政策
criterion.title_en: Local procurement policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否有政策支持本地供应商，或优先进行支持当地社区的采购。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether a company has a policy to support local suppliers or prioritize purchases that support local communities.

criterion.title: 支持当地社区的方案
criterion.title_en: Programs to support local communities
criterion.definition: 公司在社区项目（包括当地基础设施、医院和教育）以及支持当地社区的公益方案方面的投资。
criterion.definition_en: A company’s investments in community projects (including local infrastructure, hospitals and education) and philanthropic programs to support local communities.

criterion.title: 确保遵守争议材料采购政策的努力程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of efforts to ensure compliance with controversial materials sourcing policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否开展举措以确保遵守其争议采购政策，或与利益相关方合作以促进供应链透明度和问责。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company carries out initiatives to ensure compliance with its controversial sourcing policy, or collaborates with stakeholders to promote supply chain transparency and accountability.

criterion.title: 确保遵守争议材料采购政策的目标
criterion.title_en: Targets for ensuring compliance with controversial materials sourcing policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否设有确保遵守其争议材料采购政策的目标。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has targets for ensuring compliance with its controversial materials sourcing policy.

criterion.title: 由外部机构使用最严格标准将供应商/材料认证为无冲突的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of supplier/material certification as conflict-free by external agencies using the most stringent criteria
criterion.definition: 使用最严格标准（因行业而异）获得外部无冲突认证的相关产品程度。示例：针对消费电子产品的负责任矿产保证流程（RMAP）。
criterion.definition_en: The extent of relevant products externally certified as conflict-free using the most stringent criteria, which may differ from industry to industry. Example: Responsible Minerals Assurance Process (RMAP) for Consumer Electronics.

criterion.title: 应对争议采购实践的承诺
criterion.title_en: Commitments to address controversial sourcing practices
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否制定政策，以应对可能来源于与侵犯人权、非法贸易和/或资助暴力相关地区的原材料的采购与使用。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has a policy to address sourcing and use of raw materials that may originate from areas associated with human rights violations, illicit trade and/or financing of violence.

criterion.title: 材料追溯至原产地的程度
criterion.title_en: Extent of material traceability to place of origin
criterion.definition: 表明可追溯原材料原产地的相关产品估计占比。可追溯原产地指矿石开采的地点，尽可能详细。描述至少需包含国家，但可提供更多细节，包括省/州、城市、矿区及矿山名称。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the estimated share of relevant products with traceable origin of raw materials. Traceable origin refers to the location where the ore was mined, to the best detail possible. At a minimum, the description must include the country, but more details may be provided including the province/state, city, mine site and mine name.

criterion.title: 道德议题监督
criterion.title_en: Oversight of Ethics Issues
criterion.definition: 表明公司负责监督商业道德与腐败议题的治理机构（例如董事会层面的委员会、高管层或执行委员会，或专项工作组或风险官）。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the company's governance body (e.g., board-level committee, C-suite or executive committee, or special task force or risk officer) responsible for oversight of business ethics and corruption issues.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Board level committee, C-suite or executive committee: 0.0. Special task force, or risk officer, or Corporate Social Responsibility / Sustainability team: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.

criterion.title: 贿赂与反腐败政策
criterion.title_en: Bribery and Anti-corruption Policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否已制定贿赂与反腐败政策以及该政策的范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates if the company has a policy on bribery and anti-corruption in place and the scope of that policy.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Detailed formal policy on bribery and anti-corruption: 0.0. General statements of commitment to address bribery and corruption: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.

criterion.title: 供应商反腐败政策
criterion.title_en: Anti-Corruption Policy for Suppliers
criterion.definition: 表明针对供应商实施的贿赂与反腐败政策的范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the scope of the bribery and anti-corruption policy in place for suppliers.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: All suppliers are required to have anti-corruption policies and programs to verify compliance: 0.0. All suppliers are required to have anti-corruption policies: -0.7. Policy covers selected suppliers: -1.0. No evidence: -1.4.

criterion.title: 举报人保护
criterion.title_en: Whistleblower Protection
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否披露了为举报人提供免受报复保护的举报人政策。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates whether the company has disclosed a whistleblower policy that provides whistleblowers with protection from retaliation.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Policy provides whistleblowers with protection from retaliation: 0.0. No evidence: -1.4.

criterion.title: 员工道德标准培训
criterion.title_en: Employee Training on Ethical Standards
criterion.definition: 表明反腐败和商业道德标准方面的员工培训范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the scope of employee training on anti-corruption and business ethics standards.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Programs covering all employees (including part-time) and contractors: 0.0. Programs covering all permanent employees (excluding part-time and contractors): -0.7. General statements on employee training on ethical standards: -1.0. No evidence: -1.4.

criterion.title: 道德标准定期审计
criterion.title_en: Regular Audits of Ethical Standards
criterion.definition: 表明与反腐败和商业道德相关的审计频率和范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the frequency and scope of audits related to anti-corruption and business ethics.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Audits of all operations at least once every three years: 0.0. Audits of selected operations at least once every three years: -0.7. Evidence of audits but no specific details / audits conducted but not on a regular schedule: -0.7. No evidence: -1.4.

criterion.title: 反洗钱（AML）政策
criterion.title_en: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Policy
criterion.definition: 表明公司反洗钱与了解你的客户政策的范围。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the scope of a company's policy on anti-money laundering and know your customer.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on disclosure of management practice: Policy and implementation strategy articulated: 0.0. Evidence of policy but no disclosure of implementation: -0.7. Not disclosed: -1.4.

criterion.title: 腐败风险敞口与争议
criterion.title_en: Corruption Risk Exposure & Controversies
criterion.definition: 表明公司对腐败发生率较高的商业活动或地区的敞口，以及是否卷入正在进行的腐败相关争议。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the company’s exposure to business activities or geographies facing a higher incidence of corruption and involvement in ongoing corruption-related controversies.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of operations in medium-and high-risk geographies, high-risk business segments, government ownership (percentage) and controversy type & assessment. Range: 0 to -7.0 Refer to the Corruption Risk Exposure Deduction Key, below, for details on corruption risk exposure deduction. Refer to the Corporate Behavior Controversy Deduction Key, below, for details on corruption-related controversy deduction.

criterion.title: 商业道德争议
criterion.title_en: Business Ethics Controversies
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否卷入反竞争和商业道德争议。与董事会关键议题相关的两项关键指标——证券违规和高管不当行为（详情请参阅《MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Board Key Issue》文件）——相关的案件将在商业道德争议关键指标的评估中予以考虑。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the company’s involvement in anticompetitive and business ethics controversies. Cases related to the two Board Key Issue-related Key Metrics Securities Violations and Executive Misconduct (See the “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Board Key Issue” document for details) will be taken into consideration in the assessment of the Business Ethics Controversies Key Metric.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on Severity, Status (Ongoing, Partially Concluded, or Concluded), and the company’s Role (Direct vs. Indirect Involvement) in the controversy. Range: 0 to -7.0 Refer to the Corporate Behavior Controversy Deduction Key, below.

criterion.title: 税务争议
criterion.title_en: Tax Controversies
criterion.definition: 表明公司是否涉及正在进行的税务相关争议。
criterion.definition_en: Indicates the company’s involvement in ongoing tax-related controversies.
criterion.scoring_rule: Typical Scoring Contribution: The scoring contribution is variable, based on the type and assessment of ongoing controversies. Scoring range: 0 to -2.0. For details about the deduction, refer to the Tax Controversy Deduction Key, below.

criterion.title: 会计调查
criterion.title_en: Accounting Investigations
criterion.definition: 公司是否宣布对其会计进行内部调查、受到监管机构调查，或因会计实践相关问题而被罚款、和解或定罪？或者公司的审计机构是否因与公司审计工作相关的问题而受到调查？若是，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company announced an internal investigation into its accounting, come under investigation from a regulatory body, or been subject to fine, settlement, or conviction for issues related to its accounting practices? Or has the company’s auditor come under investigation for issues related to its work on the audit of the company? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 审计报告关注事项
criterion.title_en: Auditor Report Concerns
criterion.definition: 公司的独立审计机构是否发表保留意见、否定意见或无法表示意见，或通过强调事项段表达关注？是否已识别出与审计机构能否提出独立意见相关的关注事项，或审计机构发生变更的方式可能引发投资者担忧？若在过去一年内为是，则被标记。该指标基于年度财务报表中披露的外部审计机构报告，并突出显示任何保留审计意见或审计机构在强调事项段中提出的关注。纯属信息性的强调事项段不予标记。该指标还基于新闻报道或监管文件进行评估，包括与审计机构提出关注的、中期或季度财务报表相关的报道或文件。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company’s independent auditor expressed a qualified, adverse, or disclaimer of opinion, expressed concerns via an emphasis of matter paragraph? Have concerns been identified in respect of the auditor’s ability to present an independent opinion, or has the auditor been changed in a manner that may raise concerns for investors? Flagged if yes within the past year. This metric is based on the report of the external auditor disclosed in the annual financial statements and highlights any qualified auditor opinion or concerns raised in an emphasis of matter inserted by the auditor. Purely informational emphasis of matter paragraphs are not flagged. This metric is also evaluated on the basis of news reports or regulatory filings, including those that relate to interim or quarterly financial statements in which the auditors have raised concerns.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on type of auditor opinion/emphasis of matter and whether there are consecutive years of concerns. Range: 0.5 to 3.0

criterion.title: 内部控制
criterion.title_en: Internal Controls
criterion.definition: 是否有证据表明公司的内部控制体系存在重大缺陷？若有，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。用于生成该标记的事件标签或类别包括内部控制的重大缺陷或 SOX 404 违规。在美国以外，该指标基于审计委员会对内部控制有效性的评估进行评估。
criterion.definition_en: Has there been evidence of material weakness in the company’s internal control systems? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. The event tags or categories used to create this flag include material weakness in internal controls or SOX 404 violations. Outside of the U.S., this metric is evaluated based on the audit committee’s assessment of the effectiveness of internal control.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.1, Severe 0.2, Very Severe 0.4

criterion.title: 重述或特别费用
criterion.title_en: Restatements or Special Charges
criterion.definition: 公司是否因欺诈、错误或会计准则的误用而不得不重述此前公布的财务报表？公司是否宣布或报告了可能对董事会对公司的管理提出质疑的特别费用或核销？若有，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company had to restate previously published financial statements due to fraud, error, or the misapplication of accounting standards? Has the company announced or reported special charges or write-offs that might raise questions as to the stewardship of the company by the board? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 延迟申报
criterion.title_en: Late Filings
criterion.definition: 公司目前是否延迟提交其季度、半年度（或中期）或年度报告，或其年度委托书/股东大会通知？若是，则被标记。一旦该事项被评估为已结案，该标记将被移除。
criterion.definition_en: Is the company currently late in filing its quarterly, half-year (or interim), or annual reports, or its annual proxy/notice of annual meeting of shareholders? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring Deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 审计机构独立性
criterion.title_en: Auditor Independence
criterion.definition: 在上一个财年，公司为其外部审计机构支付的审计及审计相关服务费用是否低于其他服务费用？若是，则被标记。该指标使用审计机构费用明细表来标记此类独立性可能已受损的公司。
criterion.definition_en: Did the company pay its external audit firm less for audit and audit-related services than for other services in the last fiscal year? Flagged if yes. This metric uses auditor fees schedules to flag companies where such independence may have been compromised.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 审计机构任期
criterion.title_en: Auditor Tenure
criterion.definition: 是否有证据表明外部审计机构已服务超过 20 年？若有，则被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Is there evidence that the external audit firm has served in excess of 20 years? Flagged if yes.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable based on tenure: 0.3 if > 50 years 0.2 if > 20 years 0.1 if not disclosed

criterion.title: 董事长独立性
criterion.title_en: Independent Chair
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，董事长是否被归类为不独立于管理层或不独立于其他利益（与员工、政府或主要股东的联系）？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Is the chair classified as not independent of management or not independent of other interests (links to employees, government or major owners), based on MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 首席执行官与董事长兼任
criterion.title_en: Combined CEO/Chair
criterion.definition: 公司是否存在首席执行官与董事长由同一人担任的情况？若是则被标记。尽管在董事会中兼任首席执行官与董事长职务的做法较为普遍，使其作为单独指标的重要性降低，但与其他关键指标结合时，这种做法可能预示潜在的治理薄弱。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company have a combined CEO/chair? Flagged if yes. While the practice of combining the CEO and chair positions on the board of directors is common enough to minimize its significance as a standalone metric, when combined with other key indicators this practice may be an indicator of potential governance weakness.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 领导层问题
criterion.title_en: Leadership Concerns
criterion.definition: 是否存在某位领导者拥有过度影响力的问题，包括但不限于以下情形：• 执行董事长与首席执行官同时任职。• 前首席执行官作为非执行董事留任董事会。• 非执行董事长曾任首席财务官。• 某集团公司的一名执行董事长在另一集团公司担任非执行董事。• 创始人或联合创始人留任董事会但并非董事长或首席执行官。• 未登记的董事提供领导方向。若是则被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Are there concerns that there is a leader with excessive influence, including, but not limited to, instances such as: • An executive chair is serving alongside a CEO. • A former CEO remaining on the board as a non-executive director. • The non-executive chair is a former CFO. • An executive chair at one group company serves as a non-executive director at another group company. • A founder or co-founder remains on the board but not as chair or CEO. • Unregistered directors providing leadership direction. Flagged if yes.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.3

criterion.title: 董事长不独立且无独立首席董事
criterion.title_en: Chair Not Independent & No Independent Lead Director
criterion.definition: 对于董事长不独立的公司，公司是否未能指派一位具名的非执行首席董事或独立副董事长，且该人根据 MSCI S&C 标准同时被归类为独立于管理层和独立于其他利益（与员工、政府或主要股东的联系）？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。就评估本指标而言，MSCI S&C 排除任何未被公司单独指名为首席董事的人士。此标准明确排除基于轮值委员会主席指派或类似做法而产生的首席董事任命，此类做法可能削弱该角色的作用并实质上背离其预期目的。
criterion.definition_en: For companies with a non-independent chair, has the company failed to designate an individually named non-executive lead director or independent deputy chair who is classified as both independent of management and independent of other interests (links to employees, government or major owners), based on MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria. For purposes of evaluating this metric, MSCI S&C excludes any lead directors who have not been individually designated as such by the company. This standard explicitly excludes lead director assignments based on rotating committee chair assignments or similar practices that may weaken the role and effectively counter its intended purpose.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 董事会多数成员独立于管理层
criterion.title_en: Board Majority Independent of Management
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，独立于管理层的董事是否不足多数？若是则被标记。当董事会中独立于管理层的成员不足 51% 时，本指标会标记发行人。关于独立于管理层的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于双层董事会结构的发行人，本关键指标评估监事会。
criterion.definition_en: Are less than a majority of directors independent of management, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. This metric flags issuers when less than 51% of the board is independent of management. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definition of independence from management. For issuers with a two-tier board structure, this Key Metric assesses the supervisory board.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent (of management) directors and whether the company is controlled: Range: 0.2 to 1.0

criterion.title: 董事会多数成员独立于其他利益
criterion.title_en: Board Majority Independent of Other Interest
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，独立于其他利益的董事是否不足多数？若是则被标记。本指标评估与可能背离少数股东利益之利益方（管理层利益方除外）有关联的董事所占百分比。当董事会中独立于其他利益的成员不足 51% 时，发行人会被标记。关于独立于其他利益的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于双层董事会结构的发行人，本关键指标评估监事会。
criterion.definition_en: Are less than a majority of directors independent of other interests, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. This metric assesses what percentage of directors are affiliated with interests (other than those of management) that may diverge from the interests of minority investors. Issuers are flagged when less than 51% of the board is independent of other interests. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definition of independence from other interests. For issuers with a two-tier board structure, this Key Metric assesses the supervisory board.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent (of other interests) directors: Range: 0.3 to 1.0.

criterion.title: 董事会中的高管
criterion.title_en: Executives on Board
criterion.definition: 董事会中执行董事是否占 30% 或以上，或管理委员会是否包含八名或以上执行董事？若是则被标记。会审阅所有董事会成员的个人简介以确定其现任职务和职位。
criterion.definition_en: Does 30% or more of the board of directors comprise executive directors or does the management board include eight or more executive directors? Flagged if yes. All board member bios are reviewed to determine current titles and positions.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive directors (or number of executives on a management board): Range: 0.2 to 0.5.

criterion.title: 无独立董事
criterion.title_en: No Independent Directors
criterion.definition: 董事会是否完全由不符合 MSCI S&C 独立于管理层标准的董事组成？若是则被标记。本指标用于检验以下极端情形：董事会或监事会中没有任何一名成员可被视为独立于管理层。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Is the board composed entirely of directors who do not meet the MSCI S&C criteria for independence from management? Flagged if yes. This metric tests for those extreme cases where there is not a single member of the board of directors or supervisory board who can be considered independent of management. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 关联方交易
criterion.title_en: Related-Party Transactions
criterion.definition: 在最近报告的两个财务年度中的任一年度，是否存在任何已披露的关联方交易（RPT）？若是则被标记。见下文“关联方交易”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Have there been any disclosed related-party transactions (RPTs) in either of the two most recently reported financial years? Flagged if yes. See the section Related-Party Transactions, below.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on transaction size, type of related-party and (for higher-risk cases) qualitative criteria. Partial disclosure: 0.5 or (if controlled) 1.0 If non-disclosure market & no company disclosure: 1.0 (scored but not flagged) Range: 0.05 to 3.4

criterion.title: 董事会中被标记董事
criterion.title_en: Flagged Directors on Board
criterion.definition: 是否有任何董事会成员属于 MSCI S&C 定义的被标记董事？若是则被标记。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。对于双层董事会结构的发行人，监事会或管理委员会的成员均可能被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Are any of the board members Flagged Directors, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria. For issuers with two-tier board structures, members of either the supervisory board or the management board may be flagged.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on number of flagged directors on the board and number of flagged-director instances for each director. Range: 0.2 to 1.0

criterion.title: 兼任过多董事职务的非执行董事
criterion.title_en: Overboarded Non-Exec Directors
criterion.definition: 公司是否有任何非执行董事会成员在 MSCI S&C 公司治理研究范围（无论作为股权或债券发行人纳入）内的四家或以上发行人董事会任职？若是则被标记。董事会任职计数指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Do any of the company’s non-executive board members serve on the boards of four or more issuers in MSCI S&C’s corporate governance research universe (whether included as an equity or debt issuer)? Flagged if yes. Board membership counts reference the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 兼任过多董事职务的执行董事
criterion.title_en: Overboarded Exec Directors
criterion.definition: 公司是否有任何执行董事会成员在 MSCI S&C 公司治理研究范围（无论作为股权或债券发行人纳入）内的三家或以上发行人董事会任职？若是则被标记。就公司首席执行官而言，这一点尤为重要。董事会任职计数指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Do any of the company’s executive board members serve on the boards of three or more issuers in MSCI S&C’s corporate governance research universe (whether included as an equity or debt issuer)? Flagged if yes. This is of particular significance in the case of the company’s CEO. Board membership counts reference the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) the supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 反对董事的重大投票
criterion.title_en: Significant Votes Against Directors
criterion.definition: 在最近报告的选举中，是否有一名或多名董事会成员获得超过 10% 的反对票或拒绝投票？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会和管理委员会。在多数公司中，针对某位特定董事哪怕 5% 的反对票都表明反对票异常之高。在最近报告的选举中（或在某些市场针对董事的免责表决中），只要有超过 10% 的反对票针对任何董事，本指标即被触发。“反对票”包括任何反对票、拒绝投票或弃权票。
criterion.definition_en: Are there one or more directors on the board who received a negative or withheld shareholder vote in excess of 10% in the most recently reported election? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board and the management board. Even a negative vote of 5% indicates an unusually high vote against a particular individual director at most companies. This metric is triggered by a negative vote of over 10% against any directors in the most recently reported election (or in certain markets on the discharge of the directors). A “negative vote” includes any against, withhold or abstain votes.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on number of directors, the size of against/abstain/withhold votes and whether there is a controlling shareholder. Range: 0.25 to 2.0

criterion.title: 董事会规模过大
criterion.title_en: Oversized Board
criterion.definition: 董事会或监事会是否包含数量过多、可能对有效监督和决策构成障碍的董事？若是则被标记。目前设定为 20 名董事，指董事会或监事会。如此规模的董事会可能更难对问题进行必要的深入讨论，或更难以适时作出决策。
criterion.definition_en: Does the board of directors or the supervisory board include a high number of directors that suggests obstacles to effective oversight and decision-making? Flagged if yes. This is currently set at 20 directors and refers to either the board of directors or supervisory board. Boards of this size may find it harder to discuss issues in the necessary detail or take decisions in a timely manner.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 董事会规模过小
criterion.title_en: Undersized Board
criterion.definition: 董事会或监事会中是否有四名或更少的董事？若是则被标记。由如此少数个人组成的董事会可能缺乏对多数上市公司进行有效监督所需的观点和经验多样性，尤其是在向董事会各常设委员会任命成员时。本指标指董事会或监事会。
criterion.definition_en: Are there four or fewer directors on the board of directors or supervisory board? Flagged if yes. Boards comprising so few individuals may lack the diversity of view and experience needed to provide effective oversight over most public companies, particularly when it comes to appointing members to the board’s standing committees. This metric refers to either the board of directors or supervisory board.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 1.0

criterion.title: 董事出席率不达标
criterion.title_en: Board Attendance Failures
criterion.definition: 在最近报告的期间内，是否有任何董事会成员未能出席所有董事会及委员会会议的至少 75%？若是则被标记。本指标指董事会，或（在双层董事会结构中）指监事会和管理委员会。董事出席率的严重不达标与其他较不明显的董事会问题或薄弱环节有关联。
criterion.definition_en: Did any members of the board fail to attend at least 75% of all board and committee meetings held during the last reported period? Flagged if yes. This metric refers to the board of directors or (in a two-tier board structure) to the supervisory board and the management board. Excessive board attendance failures have been linked to other, less visible board problems or weaknesses.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 董事会固化
criterion.title_en: Entrenched Board
criterion.definition: 长期任职及年长董事所占百分比是否表明存在董事会固化的迹象？若是则被标记。本指标基于对多重因素的评估，包括以下组合中的董事年龄和任期：• 超过 35% 的董事会成员任期为 15 年或以上；• 超过 22% 的董事会成员任期为 15 年或以上，且超过 15% 的董事年龄为 70 岁或以上；• 有四名以上董事任期为 15 年或以上；或 • 有四名以上董事年龄为 70 岁或以上。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。在近期绩效持续落后于同业组的公司，本指标作为潜在治理问题迹象的效力会大大增强。
criterion.definition_en: Does the percentage of long-tenured, aging directors suggest a problem with board entrenchment? Flagged if yes. This metric is based on an assessment of multiple factors, including director age and tenure in the following combinations: • More than 35% of the board has a tenure of 15 years or greater; • More than 22% of the board has a tenure of 15 years or greater and more than 15% of the directors are aged 70 or over; • There are more than four directors who have a tenure of 15 years or greater; or • There are more than four directors who are aged 70 or over. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board. The strength of this metric as an indicator of potential governance problems is greatly increased at companies whose recent performance has consistently lagged their peers.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on CEO tenure & board refreshment rate. Range: 0.6 to 1.5

criterion.title: 董事会中的首席执行官
criterion.title_en: CEOs on Board
criterion.definition: 董事会中是否有超过 30% 由来自其他公司的现任在职首席执行官组成？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。要纳入此类别，该人士必须是另一家上市公司的现任在职首席执行官；被评级的公司自身的首席执行官被排除在外。依据每个人个人简介中的信息，或其在 MSCI S&C 董事数据库中作为现任公司首席执行官的标注。
criterion.definition_en: Is more than 30% of the board composed of currently active corporate CEOs from other companies? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board. To be included in this category, the individual must be a currently active CEO at another publicly traded company; the CEO of the company being rated is excluded. Based on information contained in each individual’s bio or on his or her designation as a current company CEO in the MSCI S&C director database.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 无女性董事
criterion.title_en: No Female Directors
criterion.definition: 董事会的构成中是否没有任何女性董事？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。
criterion.definition_en: Does the composition of the board fail to include any female directors? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 女性董事不足 30%
criterion.title_en: Not 30% Female Directors
criterion.definition: 董事会的构成中是否未包含至少 30% 的女性董事？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。
criterion.definition_en: Does the composition of the board fail to include at least 30% female directors? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 风险管理专长
criterion.title_en: Risk Management Expertise
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，董事会是否缺少至少一名具备风险管理一般专长的非执行董事成员？若是则被标记。本指标适用于董事会和监事会。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Does the board lack at least one non-executive member of the board who has general expertise in risk management, based on MSCI S&C standards? Flagged if yes. This metric extends to the board of directors and supervisory board. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 审计委员会/审计董事会独立性
criterion.title_en: Audit Board/Committee Independence
criterion.definition: 公司是否未能设立仅由符合 MSCI S&C 独立于管理层标准的董事组成的审计委员会或审计董事会？若是则被标记。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company failed to establish an audit committee or audit board comprising only directors who are independent of management based on MSCI S&C’s criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on whether committee exists & percentage of independent members. Range: 0.1 to 0.8

criterion.title: 审计委员会/审计董事会中的高管
criterion.title_en: Executives on Audit Board/Committee
criterion.definition: 是否有公司高管在审计委员会或审计董事会任职？若是则被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Are there company executives serving on the audit committee or audit board? Flagged if yes.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive members. Range: 0.2 to 0.5

criterion.title: 审计委员会财务专家
criterion.title_en: Audit Committee Financial Expert
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，审计委员会或审计董事会是否缺少至少一名具备会计或财务管理一般专长的非执行成员？若是则被标记。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Does the audit committee or audit board lack at least one non-executive member with general expertise in accounting or financial management, based on the MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 审计委员会行业专家
criterion.title_en: Audit Committee Industry Expert
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 标准，审计委员会或审计董事会是否缺少至少一名具备深厚行业知识的非执行成员？若是则被标记。评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Does the audit committee or audit board lack at least one non-executive member who has substantial industry knowledge, based on the MSCI S&C criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 兼任过多董事职务的审计委员会成员
criterion.title_en: Overboarded Audit Committee Members
criterion.definition: 审计委员会是否有任何独立成员在 MSCI S&C 公司治理研究范围（无论作为股权或债券发行人纳入）内的四家或以上发行人董事会任职？或审计委员会是否有任何非独立成员在三家或以上发行人董事会任职？若是则被标记。本指标通过检验该委员会中是否存在此类情形，进一步强调董事兼任过多与董事会有效性之间的关联。
criterion.definition_en: Do any of the independent members of the audit committee serve on the boards of four or more issuers in MSCI S&C’s corporate governance research universe (whether included as an equity or debt issuer)? Or do any of the non-independent members of the audit committee serve on the boards of three or more issuers? Flagged if yes. This metric further emphasizes the link between overboarding and board effectiveness by testing for its presence on this committee.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 薪酬委员会独立性
criterion.title_en: Pay Committee Independence
criterion.definition: 在公司已设立薪酬委员会的情况下，委员会中是否有不符合 MSCI S&C 独立于管理层标准的董事任职？若是则被标记。独立性评估标准的详情见下文“评估董事”章节。
criterion.definition_en: Where the company has established a pay committee, are there directors serving on the committee who are not independent of management based on MSCI S&C’s criteria? Flagged if yes. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for details of the independence evaluation criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of independent members. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

criterion.title: 薪酬委员会中的高管
criterion.title_en: Executives on Pay Committee
criterion.definition: 是否有公司高管在薪酬委员会任职？若是则被标记。除评估其非执行成员的独立性外，MSCI S&C 还会考虑公司现任高管在该常设委员会中的存在情况。
criterion.definition_en: Are there company executives serving on the pay committee? Flagged if yes. In addition to evaluating the independence of its non-executive members, MSCI S&C also takes into consideration the presence of current company executives on this standing committee.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of executive members. Range: 0.1 to 0.2

criterion.title: 无薪酬委员会且董事会中有高管
criterion.title_en: No Pay Committee & Execs on Board
criterion.definition: 公司是否缺少常设薪酬委员会，且其董事会中有现任公司高管任职？若是则被标记。对于缺少正式命名的薪酬委员会、但其成员中包含一名或多名现任公司高管（包括首席执行官）的董事会，本指标会被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company lack a standing pay committee, and are current company executives serving on its board? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged for boards that lack a formally named pay committee yet include among its members one or more current company executives, including the CEO.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.6

criterion.title: 薪酬委员会问题
criterion.title_en: Pay Committee Concerns
criterion.definition: 薪酬委员会的构成是否因委员会中存在在职首席执行官，或与薪酬委员会主席以往记录相关而引发担忧？若是则被标记。本指标的触发情形包括：薪酬委员会的多数成员或委员会主席为在职首席执行官；薪酬委员会主席同时担任其他薪酬委员会主席且最近的年度薪酬表决（say-on-pay）未获通过；或薪酬委员会主席曾任上市公司首席执行官且在其首席执行官任期内薪酬表决未获通过。
criterion.definition_en: Does the composition of the pay committee raise concerns about the presence of active CEOs on the committee or in relation to the past record of the pay committee chair? Flagged if yes. This metric is triggered by the majority of pay committee or the committee chair being active CEOs, where the pay committee chair also chairs other pay committees and the latest annual say-on-pay vote was defeated, or where the pay committee chair is a former listed-company CEO and during his CEO tenure the say-on-pay vote was defeated.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.3 (if one test is met) 0.5 (if Pay Committee is 100% active CEOs) 0.6 (if two or more tests are met)

criterion.title: 无提名委员会
criterion.title_en: No Nomination Committee
criterion.definition: 公司是否缺少常设提名委员会？若是则被标记。本指标会标记未披露正式提名委员会的发行人。负责提名董事参加董事会选举的委员会，不论其名称或其他职能如何，通常会被视为提名委员会。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company lack a standing nomination committee? Flagged if yes. This metric flags issuers that have not disclosed a formal nomination committee. A committee with the responsibility to nominate directors for election to the board will generally be considered a nomination committee, regardless of its name or other roles.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.3

criterion.title: 提名委员会主席独立性
criterion.title_en: Nomination Committee Chair Independence
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，提名委员会主席是否不独立于管理层或其他利益？若是则被标记。MSCI S&C 认为关键委员会由独立于管理层的成员领导是最佳实践，且在某些市场，提名委员会可能包含高比例的利益相关方代表，其利益可能背离少数股东的利益。因此，本指标评估委员会主席独立于管理层和其他利益两者的程度。关于独立性的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于缺少提名委员会的公司，不评估本指标。
criterion.definition_en: Is the nomination committee chair not independent of management or other interests, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. MSCI S&C consider it a best practice for key committees to be led by members who are independent of management, and, in some markets, nomination committees may include a high proportion of stakeholder representatives whose interests may diverge from those of minority investors. Therefore, this metric assesses the committee chair’s independence from both management and other interests. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definitions of independence. This metric is not evaluated for companies that lack a nomination committee.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 提名委员会独立性
criterion.title_en: Nomination Committee Independence
criterion.definition: 根据 MSCI S&C 的定义，独立于管理层和其他利益的提名委员会成员是否不足多数？若是则被标记。MSCI S&C 认为关键委员会独立于管理层是最佳实践，且在某些市场，提名委员会可能包含高比例的利益相关方代表，其利益可能背离少数股东的利益。因此，本指标评估委员会中独立于管理层和其他利益两者的成员所占百分比。关于独立性的定义，见下文“评估董事”章节。对于缺少提名委员会的公司，不评估本指标。
criterion.definition_en: Are less than a majority of nomination committee members independent of management and other interests, as defined by MSCI S&C? Flagged if yes. MSCI S&C consider it a best practice for key committees to be independent of management, and, in some markets, nomination committees may include a high proportion of stakeholder representatives whose interests may diverge from those of minority investors. Therefore, this metric assesses what percentage of the committee is independent of both management and other interests. See the section Evaluating Directors, below, for our definitions of independence. This metric is not evaluated for companies that lack a nomination committee.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 破产或清算
criterion.title_en: Bankruptcy or Liquidation
criterion.definition: 公司或重大子公司目前是否处于破产接管、破产保护之下，或面临清算？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。本关键指标关注负面信用事件，包括破产保护、破产管理、破产接管、财产监管和清算。
criterion.definition_en: Is the company, or a material subsidiary, currently in receivership, under bankruptcy protection, or facing liquidation? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded. This Key Metric focuses on negative credit events including bankruptcy protection, administration, receivership, curatorship and liquidation.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.8, Severe 1.5, Very Severe 3.0

criterion.title: 债务契约问题
criterion.title_en: Debt Covenant Concerns
criterion.definition: 公司或重大子公司最近是否违反了其债务契约条款、其债务契约条款的检验被推迟或豁免，或被报告面临违反债务契约的风险？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。本关键指标关注负面信用事件，包括未能偿还（或推迟偿还）债务本金或利息、违反条款（或豁免或推迟检验）债务契约（如超出借款限额或违反技术性条款）。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company, or a material subsidiary, recently breached the terms of its debt covenants, had a test of its debt covenant terms deferred or waived, or been reported to be in danger of breaching its debt covenants? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded. This Key Metric focuses on negative credit events including failure to repay (or defer paying) capital or interest on the debt, breaching terms (or waiving or deferring the testing) of the debt covenants such as exceeding borrowing limits or breaches of technical provisions.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 融资困难
criterion.title_en: Financing Difficulties
criterion.definition: 董事会是否已发现与持续经营假设相关的问题，或媒体已报道此类问题，或有其他证据表明公司或重大子公司可能面临融资困难？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。本关键指标旨在识别存在负面信用事件风险的情形。成功的结果（如股权融资或重新协商信贷条款）可能化解此问题，并构成严重程度评估标准的一部分。
criterion.definition_en: Have concerns been identified by the board or been reported in the press in relation to the going-concern assumption, or is there other evidence that the company, or a material subsidiary, may be facing financing difficulties? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded. This Key Metric seeks to identify where there is a risk of a negative credit event. A successful outcome, such as an equity-raising or renegotiated credit terms, may resolve this concern, and forms part of the severity assessment criteria.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 资本管理问题
criterion.title_en: Capital Management Concerns
criterion.definition: 在资本的募集和/或返还方面，是否有人就证券持有人的待遇提出担忧？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。可能被标记的情形包括：投资者因新股发行而面临高度潜在股权稀释；现有投资者在资本募集中被不公平对待；或与股份回购活动相关的担忧。
criterion.definition_en: Have concerns been raised as to the treatment of security holders in relation to the raising and/or return of capital? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. Circumstances that may be flagged include situations where investors face high potential equity dilution through new share issuances, where existing investors have been treated unfairly in capital raisings, or where there are concerns related to share buyback activity.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 证券违规
criterion.title_en: Securities Violations
criterion.definition: 公司是否面临指控，称投资者未能在发行新证券的过程中或发行之后获得有关公司的某些基本事实？或公司是否面临实质性指控，称其违反了投资者保护要求（包括与向第三方提出的要约相关的要求）？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。与会计和审计问题具体相关的项目在“会计”关键议题下涵盖。证券违规关键指标对“董事会”关键议题有贡献，但不通过公司治理主题评分贡献于公司的 ESG 评级。其影响将改为在公司行为主题下的商业道德关键议题中，通过商业道德争议关键指标的评估予以反映。（详情见《MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue》文件）
criterion.definition_en: Has the company faced allegations that investors have not been given access to certain basic facts about the company, whether in the process of issuing new securities or following issuance? Or has the company faced substantive allegations of breaches of investor protection requirements (including in relation to offers it makes for third parties)? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. Items that relate specifically to accounting and audit issues are covered under the Accounting Key Issue. The Securities Violations Key Metric contributes to the Board Key Issue, but does not contribute to a company’s ESG Ratings via the Corporate Governance Theme Score. The impact will instead be reflected in the Corporate Behavior Theme under the Business Ethics Key Issue in the assessment of the Business Ethics Controversies Key Metric. (See the “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue” document for details)
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 退市威胁
criterion.title_en: Threat of Delisting
criterion.definition: 发行人目前是否违反了适用于其证券上市的持续义务，从而可能威胁这些证券的继续上市或交易？若是则被标记。一旦该案件被评估为已了结，标记即会移除。
criterion.definition_en: Is the issuer currently in breach of its continuing obligations that apply to the listing of its securities, which may threaten the continued listing or trading of those securities? Flagged if yes. The flag will be removed once the case is assessed as concluded.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 高管不当行为
criterion.title_en: Executive Misconduct
criterion.definition: 公司现任或近期的董事会成员或高级高管（且在其于本公司任职期间）是否被指控未能以诚实和诚信行事、从事违背公司及其股东利益的行为、违反信任或信赖、从事犯罪行为，或从事损害公司声誉的行为？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。本指标指董事会、管理委员会（双层结构下）和执行委员会的现任或前任成员。高管不当行为关键指标对“董事会”关键议题有贡献，但不通过公司治理主题评分贡献于公司的 ESG 评级。其影响将改为在公司行为主题下的商业道德关键议题中，通过商业道德争议关键指标的评估予以反映。（详情见《MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue》文件。）
criterion.definition_en: Has a current or recent member of the board or a senior executive of the company (and while serving at this company) allegedly failed to act with honesty and integrity, engaged in actions contrary to the interests of the company and its shareholders, breached trust or confidence, engaged in criminal actions or engaged in actions that caused damage to the company’s reputation? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. This metric refers to current or former members of the board of directors, management board (in a two-tier structure) and executive committee. The Executive Misconduct Key Metric contributes to the Board Key Issue, but does not contribute to a company’s ESG Ratings via the Corporate Governance Theme Score. The impact will instead be reflected in the Corporate Behavior Theme under the Business Ethics Key Issue in the assessment of the Business Ethics Controversies Key Metric. (See the “MSCI ESG Ratings Methodology: Business Ethics Key Issue” document for details.)
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 其他高影响治理事件
criterion.title_en: Other High-Impact Governance Events
criterion.definition: 公司是否面临可能使董事会无法专注于业务运营和战略事项的情形；是否有人就过往董事会决策的质量提出重大质疑；或是否存在公司治理失灵的迹象？若是则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company faced situations that may distract the board from focusing on business operations and strategic matters; have major questions been raised as to the quality of past board decisions; or is there evidence of governance failures at the company? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.5, Severe 1.0, Very Severe 2.0 Evaluating directors Independence Director independence is assessed along two dimensions — independence from management and independence from other interests (links to employees, government or major owners). The Board Leadership Key Metrics require independence from both management and other interests, however, assessments of the board as a whole and of the various board committees (excluding the nomination committee) are based on the independent of management criteria only. Lengthy tenure is not evaluated as part of the independence assessments but forms part of the Entrenched Board Key Metric evaluation criteria. Independent of management Per MSCI S&C’s definition of independence from management, a director will be considered not independent of management if they meet one or more of the following criteria in Exhibit 2.

criterion.title: 控股股东
criterion.title_en: Controlling Shareholder
criterion.definition: 是否有任何股东或股东集团控制超过 30% 的有表决权股份，或能够选出超过 50% 的公司董事会成员？若为是则被标记。当治理参考实体并非股权发行人时，该评估基于最终所有者。
criterion.definition_en: Does any shareholder or shareholder bloc control more than 30% of the voting shares, or are they able to elect more than 50% of the company’s board? Flagged if yes. Where the Governance Reference Entity is not an equity issuer, this evaluation is based on the ultimate owner.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0

criterion.title: 控股股东问题
criterion.title_en: Controlling Shareholder Concerns
criterion.definition: 公司是否存在可能给少数公众股东带来风险的所有权结构或治理安排？若为是则被标记。可由一项或多项标准触发，包括：• 以下任一关键指标也被标记：无独立董事；领导层问题；董事会规模不足；交叉持股；或毒丸计划。• 或存在以下任一情形：发行人已发行黄金股；发行人通过股权金字塔控制；发行人注册为股份有限公司合伙企业（Partnership Limited by Shares）；或最大股东持有超过 75% 的全部表决权。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company have ownership structures or governance arrangements that may present risks for minority public shareholders? Flagged if yes. This can be triggered by the presence of one or more criteria, including where: • Any of the following Key Metrics are also flagged:  No Independent Directors; Leadership Concerns; Undersized Board; Cross Shareholdings; or Poison Pill. • Or any of the following apply:  The issuer has issued golden shares;  The issuer is controlled via a stock pyramid;  The issuer is incorporated as a Partnership Limited by Shares; or  The largest shareholder holds more than 75% of the total voting rights.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 1.0

criterion.title: 分散持股问题
criterion.title_en: Dispersed Ownership Concerns
criterion.definition: 公司是否持股如此分散，以致没有主要股东或其他大额持股方？若是则被标记。该测试排除家族或创始人企业、拥有表决权超过 10% 的主要股东的公司，以及所有至少持有 5% 股份的股东合计持股超过 30% 的公司。本指标旨在识别所有权与管理层脱节的公司。若缺少知情且积极参与的股东群体所形成的约束，CEO 和董事会可能行使通常见于受控公司的权力与权威，风险更大。
criterion.definition_en: Is the company so widely held that there are no principal shareholders or other large-bloc holders? Flagged if yes. This test eliminates family or founder firms, companies with a principal shareholder with more than 10% of voting rights, and companies where the aggregate 5%+ holdings exceed 30%. This metric is intended to capture companies where there is a disconnect between ownership and management. In the absence of the constraining influence of an informed and involved bloc of shareholders, there is a greater risk of the CEO and board asserting a degree of power and authority more commonly associated with controlled companies.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 交叉持股
criterion.title_en: Cross-Shareholdings
criterion.definition: 公司是否与其他（关联或非关联）公司存在一系列交叉持股？若为是则被标记。该指标识别出于非投资目的的交叉持股。就本关键指标而言，交叉持股包括直接、间接（通过子公司）、循环或更复杂的交叉持股网络。
criterion.definition_en: Is the company involved in a series of cross-shareholdings with other (related or unrelated) companies? Flagged if yes. This metric identifies cross-shareholdings intended for non-investment purposes. Cross-shareholdings for the purpose of this Key Metric include direct, indirect (via subsidiary companies), circular, or more complex cross-shareholding networks.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on size of cross-shareholdings: Range: 0.2 to 3.2

criterion.title: 追踪股票
criterion.title_en: Tracking Stock
criterion.definition: 公司是否以追踪股票或类似的基于交易的实体形式交易？若为是则被标记。追踪股票被视为潜在治理弱点的指标。
criterion.definition_en: Is the company being traded as a tracking stock or similar trading-based entity? Flagged if yes. Tracking stocks are treated as an indicator of potential governance weakness.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 可变利益实体
criterion.title_en: Variable Interest Entities
criterion.definition: 集团是否有至少 5% 的收入来自公司持有不足 10% 表决权的 VIE？若为是则被标记。可变利益实体（VIE）是一种特殊目的载体，发行人在其中对一家经营公司持有控制性权益，但该控制并非基于多数表决权。通过结构化合同，发行人通常是该 VIE 的主要受益人。
criterion.definition_en: Does at least 5% of the group's revenue come from VIEs where the company holds less than 10% voting rights? Flagged if yes. A variable interest entity (VIE) is a special purpose vehicle in which the issuer holds a controlling interest in an operating company that is not based on a majority of the voting rights. Via structured contracts, the issuer is typically the primary beneficiary of the VIE.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 具有不同表决权的多重股权类别
criterion.title_en: Multiple Equity Classes with Different Voting Rights
criterion.definition: 公司是否发行了多于一个类别的股权股份，且这些类别具有不等的表决权？若为是则被标记。表决权的不平等可能表现为每股表决票不同、每单位面值表决票不同，或仅可就特定事项、特定董事选举进行表决，或授予特殊权利（如提名董事的专属权利）。当被称为“优先”“优先股”或类似名称的股份类别，依据会计准则在年度账目中被归类为权益证券而非负债时，就本指标而言将被视为一个股权类别。不附带特殊权利但具有不等表决权的股份类别，若发行数量不重大，可能不被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company issued more than one class of equity shares and do these classes carry unequal voting rights? Flagged if yes. The inequality in the voting rights may be manifested via different votes per share, different votes per unit of nominal value, through the ability to vote only on certain matters, on the election of certain directors, or grant special rights (such as the exclusive right of nominating directors). When a share class termed as “preference,” “preferred,” or similar, is classified in the annual accounts under accounting standards as an equity security rather than a liability, then it will be considered as an equity class for the purposes of this metric. Share classes that do not carry special rights but have unequal voting rights may not be flagged if the number issued is not significant.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on size of voting rights differential & percentage of votes held by largest owner: Range: 0.2 to 0.6

criterion.title: 具有不同表决权的单一股权类别
criterion.title_en: Single Equity Class with Different Voting Rights
criterion.definition: 资本结构是否包含单一股份类别，其表决权根据持股时间长短而变化（或通过“忠诚股”授予额外表决权）？若为是则被标记。在某些文献中，这些也可称为附期限表决股份（tenured voting shares）。
criterion.definition_en: Does the capital structure include a single share class where the voting rights vary based on the duration of ownership (or extra voting rights are granted via “loyalty shares”)? Flagged if yes. In some literature these may also be referred to as tenured voting shares.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on length of required holding period and percentage of votes held by largest owner. Range: 0.2 to 0.55

criterion.title: 表决权限制持股数量
criterion.title_en: Voting Rights Limits Shares Held
criterion.definition: 无论投资者持有多少股份，表决权是否被限制在某一百分比？若为是则被标记。这可能指“持股上限”或“表决权上限”，即对部分或全部股东适用持股和/或表决权限制。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
criterion.definition_en: Are voting rights capped at a certain percentage, no matter how many shares the investor owns? Flagged if yes. This may refer to either an “ownership ceiling” or a “voting rights ceiling,” in which ownership and/or voting rights limits are applied to some or all shareholders. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on ownership or voting-limit percentage. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

criterion.title: 表决权限制居住地
criterion.title_en: Voting Rights Limits Residency
criterion.definition: 外国或非居民股东的表决权是否不同？若为是则被标记。该条款限制外国或非居民一方就公司事项进行表决的能力，无论其持有的股份数量或类型如何，并包括禁止外国股东表决的情形。这可能指对具有某一国籍的股东所持股份或表决权的合计限制，或基于某股东国籍对其持股的限制。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
criterion.definition_en: Are voting rights different for foreign or non-resident shareholders? Flagged if yes. This provision sets limits on the ability of foreign or non-resident parties to vote on corporate matters, regardless of the number or type of shares held, and includes cases in which foreign shareholders are prohibited from voting. This may refer either to an aggregate limit on shares or voting rights held by shareholders of a stated nationality or to a limit on holdings of one shareholder based on that shareholder’s nationality. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on ownership or voting-limit percentage. Range: 0.15 to 0.3

criterion.title: 政府干预问题
criterion.title_en: Government Intervention Concerns
criterion.definition: 公司的资本和所有权结构是否包含“黄金股”条款、国家或州法律中是否存在同等条款，或董事会中是否有政府代表？若为是则被标记。“黄金股”条款允许单一股东（通常是国家政府）在某些决策上否决所有其他股东的表决权。
criterion.definition_en: Do the company’s capital and ownership structures include a “golden share” provision, are there equivalent provisions in national or state laws, or is there a government representative on the board? Flagged if yes. A “golden share” provision allows a single shareholder, usually a national government, to override all other shareholder voting rights on certain decisions.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 毒丸计划
criterion.title_en: Poison Pill
criterion.definition: 公司是否采用了收购防御措施，如毒丸计划、股东权益计划或同等条款？若为是则被标记。收购防御可能使管理层和董事会免受问责（董事会固守）。收购防御可包括正式的股东权益计划、毒丸计划、保护性优先股或同等条款。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company adopted a takeover defense such as a poison pill, shareholder rights plan, or equivalent provision? Flagged if yes. A takeover defense may shield management and the board from accountability (board entrenchment). Takeover defenses may include a formal shareholder’s rights plan, poison pill, protective preference shares, or equivalent provision.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.5

criterion.title: 细则修订
criterion.title_en: Bylaws Amendments
criterion.definition: 董事会是否拥有未经股东批准单方面修订公司细则/公司章程的权力？若为是则被标记。多数美国公司赋予董事会对细则的单方面控制权，并据此被标记，但在其他地区，这仍是治理力度的有用指标。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
criterion.definition_en: Does the board have the unilateral right to amend the company’s bylaws/Articles of Association without shareholder approval? Flagged if yes. Most U.S. companies grant the board unilateral control over the bylaws, and are flagged accordingly, but in other regions this remains a helpful indicator of governance strength. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 股东召集会议权利
criterion.title_en: Shareholder Rights to Convene Meeting
criterion.definition: 股东是否缺乏要求召开临时股东大会（EGM）的权利，或要求召开 EGM 所需门槛超过 10% 的表决权？若为是则被标记。部分公司可能对在现有会议议程中追加决议适用不同门槛——参见股东权利问题关键指标。
criterion.definition_en: Do shareholders lack the right to requisition an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) or does the threshold required to request an EGM exceed 10% of the voting rights? Flagged if yes. Some companies may apply a different threshold to append a resolution to the agenda of an existing meeting – see Shareholder Rights Concerns Key Metric.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on voting-rights threshold required to requisition a meeting. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

criterion.title: 股东权利问题
criterion.title_en: Shareholder Rights Concerns
criterion.definition: 由于治理文件条款的性质，股东在公司进行变革的能力是否受到限制？若为是则被标记。治理文件的变更是否需要超过全部资本 67% 的赞成票或超过已投票数 75% 的赞成票？股东是否既无法以多数票通过书面同意行事，又在年度股东大会（AGM）上请求列入股东提案所需的门槛超过 1%（或不被允许）？
criterion.definition_en: Are shareholders limited in their ability to make changes at the company due to the nature of provisions in the governing documents? Flagged if yes. Does a change to the governing documents require a vote in favor of more than 67% of the total capital or more than 75% of the votes cast? Are shareholders both unable to act by written consent in a majority vote AND does the threshold required to request inclusion of a shareholder proposal at the annual general meeting (AGM) exceed 1% (or is not permitted)?
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 薪酬话语权政策
criterion.title_en: Say-on-Pay Policy
criterion.definition: 公司是否未能实施定期的薪酬话语权（say-on-pay）表决？若为是则被标记。应赋予股东就政策本身、依据这些政策支付的金额，或薪酬委员会列明上述事项的报告进行表决的权利（即，这应是对政策或薪酬总额的广泛表决，而不仅仅是对薪酬某一组成部分的政策或总额进行表决）。薪酬话语权表决的范围必须包括董事会中的任何执行董事，若董事会中没有执行董事，则包括最高级别的管理人员。该表决可针对所有执行董事集体进行，或对每位执行董事单独表决。表决应定期举行，间隔不超过三年。若无高管（如投资信托），则该关键指标不会被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company failed to implement regular say-on-pay votes? Flagged if yes. Shareholders should be granted a vote on either the policies themselves, the amounts paid pursuant to these policies, or on the report of the pay committee that sets out these items( i.e., this should be a broad-based vote on policy or total pay, and not just a vote on the policy or total amount of one component of pay). The scope of the say-on-pay vote must include any executive directors on the board of directors, or the most senior executive, if there is no executive director on the board. The vote may be in respect of all the executive directors collectively or by separate votes for each executive director individually. Votes should be held on a regular basis, at intervals of no more than three years. The Key Metric will not be flagged if there are no executives (e.g., for investment trusts).
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 保密投票
criterion.title_en: Confidential Voting
criterion.definition: 公司是否未能实施保密投票（在合理例外情形之外）？若为是则被标记。保密投票旨在保护那些希望投票反对管理层或反对某位特定董事、但可能担心遭到报复的股东的匿名性。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。对于美国和加拿大，除非能确认保密投票已存在的必要证据，否则该指标会被标记。对于其他市场，仅当发现表明不存在保密投票的具体证据时，该指标才会被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company failed to implement confidential voting, barring reasonable exceptions? Flagged if yes. Confidential voting is intended to protect the anonymity of shareholders who wish to vote against management, or against a particular director, but who may be concerned about the possibility of redress. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations. For the U.S. and Canada, this metric is flagged unless the required evidence is identified to confirm confidential voting is in place. For other markets, this metric is only flagged if specific evidence is identified to indicate the absence of confidential voting.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 代理提名权
criterion.title_en: Proxy Access
criterion.definition: 公司是否不允许合格股东提名董事在年度股东大会上参选，且将此类被提名人纳入公司向股东分发的会议议程？若为是则被标记。代理提名权是衡量股东影响公司董事会构成能力的指标。该指标源自公司的公司章程和细则，或基于适用的公司法规。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company not allow qualified shareholders to nominate directors for election at the annual general meeting, such nominees to be included in the meeting agenda circulated by the company to its shareholders? Flagged if yes. Proxy access is a measure of shareholder’s ability to influence the composition of the company’s board. This metric is derived from a company’s corporate charter and bylaws, or on the basis of applicable corporate regulations.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 年度董事选举
criterion.title_en: Annual Director Elections
criterion.definition: 是否有任何由股东选举的董事的连任间隔超过一年？若为是则被标记。该指标既涵盖董事连任交错进行的分类董事会，也涵盖所有董事同时连任但频率低于每年一次的董事会。在较长时间内进行去分类化的董事会，在此过程完成之前（即直到所有董事会成员每年均连任）被视为分类董事会。该指标不涉及员工任命的董事，仅涉及由股东选举的董事。
criterion.definition_en: Do any shareholder-elected directors stand for re-election at intervals greater than one year? Flagged if yes. This metric captures both classified boards, where director re-election is staggered, and boards where all directors stand simultaneously for re-election albeit less often than annually. Boards undergoing declassification over an extended period are treated as classified until this process has been completed (i.e., until all the board members are re-elected annually). The metric does not refer to employee-appointed directors, only those elected by shareholders.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on percentage of board subject to re-election and frequency of re-election: Range: 0.1 to 0.2

criterion.title: 强分类董事会组合
criterion.title_en: Strong Classified Board Combination
criterion.definition: 公司是否设有分类或交错董事会，同时存在其他股东权利限制，进一步限制股东影响董事会构成的能力？若是则被标记。在已有分类董事会的基础上，下列任一组合成立时即符合本指标：①“仅可因故罢免董事”为 Yes，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且细则表决比例等于 0% 或大于 51%；②“仅可因故罢免董事”为 Yes，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且“有效分类董事会”为 Yes；③无因罢免董事所需表决比例大于 51%，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且细则表决比例等于 0% 或大于 51%；④无因罢免董事所需表决比例大于 51%，“股东可填补董事会空缺”为 No，且“有效分类董事会”为 Yes。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company have a classified or staggered board, in combination with other limitations on shareholder rights that further limit shareholders ability to affect the make-up of the board? Flagged if yes. A company has a strong classified board combination if, in addition to having a Classified Board, any of the following are true: • Director Removal for Cause Only is Yes, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No and the Bylaw Vote Percent is = 0% or > 51%; • Director Removal for Cause Only is Yes, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No and the Effective Classified Board is Yes; • Director Removal without Cause Vote % > 51%, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No and Bylaw Vote Percent is = 0% or > 51%; or • Director Removal Without Cause Vote % > 51%, and Shareholder Can Fill Board Vacancies is No, and Effective Classified Board is Yes.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 多数投票制
criterion.title_en: Majority Voting
criterion.definition: 公司是否未在董事选举中使用或采用有约束力的多数投票制（若董事未获得已投票数的多数，则立即辞职）？若为是则被标记。MSCI S&C 对该指标采用严格的多数标准，对相对多数（plurality）、相对多数加辞职、多数加辞职标准均予以标记。若某董事未获得已投票数的多数，该标准要求该董事立即离职（除非公司董事会人数将低于法定最低人数，此情况下其仅短暂留任直至新任命）。实施多数投票制是衡量股东影响董事会构成能力的指标。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company failed to use or adopt binding majority voting in the election of directors (with immediate resignation, if the director does not receive a majority of the votes cast)? Flagged if yes. MSCI S&C uses a strict majority standard for this metric, flagging plurality, plurality plus resignation, and majority plus resignation standards. Where a director fails to achieve a majority of the votes cast, this standard requires the director to immediately depart (unless the company would have below the legal minimum number of directors, in which case they remain only briefly pending a new appointment).
