Implementation of majority voting is a measure of the shareholder’s ability to influence the composition of the board.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on voting standard and whether director vote is binding. Range: 0.1 to 0.3

criterion.title: 累积投票
criterion.title_en: Cumulative Voting
criterion.definition: 拥有控股股东的公司，是否在董事选举中采用相对多数投票标准，且不允许累积投票（无论作为默认选举标准还是应股东要求）？若为是则被标记。累积投票是一种董事会选举方法，股东可投出的董事票数等于其持有的股份数乘以应选董事人数。累积投票的目的是促进少数股东在董事会中的代表性。股东可将其全部票投给选票上的一名或多名（但非全部）董事，从而促进小股东的代表性。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company, which has a controlling shareholder, use a plurality vote standard for director elections, without permitting cumulative voting (whether as the default election standard or at the request of shareholders)? Flagged if yes. Cumulative voting is a method of election of the board of directors whereby a stockholder may cast as many votes for directors as he or she has shares of stock, multiplied by the number of directors to be elected. The purpose of cumulative voting is to facilitate the representation of minority stockholders on the board. The stockholder may cast all his or her votes for one or more, but not all, directors on the ballot, which therefore promotes representation of small shareholders.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 无因罢免董事
criterion.title_en: Director Removal Without Cause
criterion.definition: 股东是否缺乏无因罢免个别董事的权利？若为是则被标记。若允许无因罢免董事，对现任管理层怀有敌意的收购方可能寻求罢免现有董事并用其提名人取而代之。若从国家或证券交易所法规或公司文件中均无该权利的证据，则该关键指标会被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Do shareholders lack the right to remove individual directors without cause? Flagged if yes. If director removal without cause is permitted, a bidder that is hostile to current management may seek to remove existing directors and replace them with the bidder’s nominees. Where there is no evidence of this right, from either national or stock exchange regulation or from the company’s documents, the Key Metric will be flagged.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 利益相关方条款
criterion.title_en: Constituency Provision
criterion.definition: 公司是否设有利益相关方条款，或是否受适用法律下利益相关方保护条款的约束？若为是则被标记。利益相关方条款允许董事会在作出公司决策（包括有关控制权变更的决策）时考虑股东以外的利益。典型的其他利益相关方包括员工、社区、客户、供应商和环境。若从国家或证券交易所法规或公司的组织文件中发现该条款的明确证据，该关键指标会被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company have a constituency provision or is it subject to constituency protection under applicable law? Flagged if yes. Constituency provisions allow a board to consider interests other than those of shareholders in making corporate decisions, including decisions about changes of control. Typical other constituencies would include employees, communities, customers, suppliers and the environment. The Key Metric will be flagged where there is explicit evidence of this provision from either national or stock exchange regulation or from the company’s constitutional documents.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 企业合并条款
criterion.title_en: Business Combination Provision
criterion.definition: 公司是否设有企业合并条款，或是否受适用法律下企业合并保护条款的约束？若为是则被标记。企业合并条款要求公司在某股东超过一定持股比例（通常称为“利益相关股东”）后的一段时间内不得与该股东进行交易，或要求此类交易须经高于通常比例的股份批准。企业合并的另一种变体也可能规定批准合并须达到高于通常比例的股份，但未规定禁止合并的期限。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company have a business combination provision in place or is it subject to business combination protection under applicable law? Flagged if yes. A business combination provision requires that a company not engage in a transaction with a shareholder holding a certain percentage (usually dubbed an “interested shareholder”) for a period of time after the shareholder exceeded this threshold, or that such a transaction be approved by a higher-than-usual percentage of shares. A different variation of a “business combination” may also list a higher-than-usual percentage of shares for approving a merger but not list a time period during which a merger would be prohibited.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 公平收购待遇条款
criterion.title_en: Fair Bid Treatment Provisions
criterion.definition: 公司是否未设立公平价格条款（附有不超过 33.3% 的强制收购要约要求），或是否不受适用法律下公平价格保护条款的约束？若为是则被标记。这些条款通常涉及所有股东有权就其股份获得相同价格、该价格处于要约前一段时间内平均市场价格的某一区间内、要约须在最短时间内保持开放，以及类似的保护措施。在美国，这通常作为企业合并条款的禁止或更高表决要求的例外情形呈现，适用于收购要约包含某些旨在确保公平并消除股东感到被胁迫而同意要约的可能性的条款时。
criterion.definition_en: Does the company not have a fair price provision (with a mandatory bid requirement which does not exceed 33.3%) in place or is it not subject to fair price protection under applicable law? Flagged if yes. These terms generally involve all shareholders being entitled to receive the same price for their shares, the price being within some range of the average market price over some period of time prior to the offer, the offer remaining open for a minimum amount of time, and similar protections. In the U.S., this is generally presented as an exception to the business combination provision’s prohibition or higher vote requirement that applies when an acquisition offer contains certain terms designed to ensure fairness and eliminate the possibility that shareholders will feel coerced to agree to the offer.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1 Ownership Structure Assessment The ownership structure of a company is evaluated along three axes. The first dimension of ownership assessment is the level of control asserted by the largest owner. Principal-agent concerns are primarily applicable to widely held companies with highly dispersed ownership. For closely held companies, however, governance risk is primarily a function of the identity and degree of control wielded by a company’s dominant shareholder. Where stock pyramids are present or in the case of private companies, our assessment focuses on the ultimate owner.

criterion.title: CEO 股权政策
criterion.title_en: CEO Equity Policy
criterion.definition: 如果 CEO 并未持有大量股份，公司是否未能为 CEO 采纳有效的持股指引或股权保留政策？若是，则被标记。大量股份的定义为：价值至少为基本薪酬 5 倍或 500 万美元的股份，或占已发行股份 1% 的股份。有效的持股指引包括要求持有价值至少为基本薪酬 5 倍的股份。有效的股权保留要求包括要求保留至少 50% 的已归属股权。
criterion.definition_en: If the CEO does not hold a significant number of shares, has the company failed to adopt effective stock ownership guidelines or an equity retention policy for the CEO? Flagged if yes. A significant number of shares is defined as either shares worth at least 5 times base salary or USD 5 million or shares representing 1% of outstanding shares. Effective stock ownership guidelines include requirements to hold shares worth at least 5 times base salary. Effective equity retention requirements include requirements to hold at least 50% of vested equity.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: CEO 股权变动
criterion.title_en: CEO Equity Changes
criterion.definition: CEO 持有的股份数量（经任何公司行动调整后）是否同比减少 10% 或以上？若是，则被标记。该指标不包括任期不足两年的 CEO。
criterion.definition_en: Has the number of shares held by the CEO (after adjustment for any corporate actions) decreased year over year by 10% or more? Flagged if yes. This metric excludes CEOs with less than two years’ tenure.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 长期薪酬绩效
criterion.title_en: Long-Term Pay Performance
criterion.definition: CEO 的股权薪酬是否未能反映公司过去三年和五年的股东总回报（TSR）绩效？若是，则被标记。若在公司 3 年和 5 年 TSR 为负的年份，报告的公司 CEO 任何已归属股票和期权收益大于零，则该指标被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Does the CEO’s equity pay fail to reflect the company’s total shareholder return (TSR) performance over the last three and five years? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if any vested stock and option gains reported for the company’s CEO are greater than zero during a year when the company is showing negative 3-year and 5-year TSR.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 长期薪酬绩效与同业对比
criterion.title_en: Long-Term Pay Performance Versus Peers
criterion.definition: 相对于其薪酬同业组，CEO 的股权薪酬是否未能反映公司过去三年和五年的 TSR 绩效？若是，则被标记。若在公司 3 年和 5 年 TSR 低于其薪酬同业组中位数的年份，报告的公司 CEO 任何已归属股票和期权收益大于零，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。
criterion.definition_en: Does the CEO’s equity pay fail to reflect the company’s TSR performance over the last three and five years relative to its Pay Peer Group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if any vested stock and option gains reported for the company’s CEO are greater than zero during a year when the company’s 3-year and 5-year TSR fall below the median for its Pay Peer Group (see Pay Peer Groups, below).
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 短期薪酬绩效
criterion.title_en: Short-Term Pay Performance
criterion.definition: 在最近报告期，CEO 的年度激励是否未能随年度绩效同步升降？若是，则被标记。所使用的四项测试指标为净利润、基本正常化每股收益（EPS）、总收入和总资产。若出现以下情形，则该指标被标记：• CEO 报告的短期激励总额大于零，且上述四项测试指标中有三项或以上同比减少；或 • 短期激励总额未同比减少，上一年度激励大于零，且两项或以上的指标同比减少。就本关键指标而言，短期激励总额包括任何奖金（在美国包括非股权激励薪酬），无论其以现金、股份、在释放前设有持有期的股份、放弃并转入养老金的奖金或其他交付形式提供。
criterion.definition_en: Did the CEO’s annual incentives fail to rise or fall in line with annual performance for the last reported period? Flagged if yes. The four test metrics used are net income, basic normalized earnings per share (EPS), total revenue and total assets. This metric is flagged if: • CEO’s reported total short-term incentives are greater than zero and three or more of the four test metrics listed above have decreased year-on-year; or • Total short-term incentives did not decrease year-on-year, prior year incentives were greater than zero, and two or more metrics decreased year-on-year. “Total short-term incentives” for the purpose of this Key Metric include any bonus (in the U.S. including “Non-Equity Incentive Compensation”), whether delivered in the form of cash, shares, shares subject to a holding period prior to release, bonus waived into pension or other form of delivery.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 薪酬与可持续性挂钩
criterion.title_en: Pay Linked to Sustainability
criterion.definition: 公司是否未在其当前的高管薪酬政策中纳入与可持续性绩效的挂钩？若是，则被标记。该指标完全基于公司自身的报告。它考量是否使用一项或多项可持续性指标来确定年度和/或长期激励薪酬政策，而不考量这些指标的有效性。该指标针对 CEO 和/或其他执行董事进行评估。未发放任何激励薪酬的公司也将在本关键指标下被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company failed to incorporate links to sustainability performance in its current executive pay policies? Flagged if yes. This metric is based entirely on the company’s own reporting. It considers whether one or more sustainability metrics are used to determine annual and/or long-term incentive pay policy and does not consider the effectiveness of those metrics. This metric is evaluated for the CEO and/or other executive directors. Companies that do not issue any incentive pay will also be flagged under this Key Metric.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers other than externally managed companies. Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 追回与减扣
criterion.title_en: Clawbacks & Malus
criterion.definition: 在公司提供可变或激励薪酬的情况下，公司是否未能采纳适用于年度和长期激励的追回政策，以根据后续重述的账目收回激励薪酬？若是，则被标记。在高级高管基于欺诈性或错误数据获得激励奖励的情况下，缺乏正式的追回政策可能会削弱董事会的法律地位。
criterion.definition_en: Where the company offers variable or incentive pay, has the company failed to adopt a clawback policy, applicable to both the annual and long-term incentives, that would recoup incentive pay based on accounts that were restated at a later date? Flagged if yes. The absence of a formal clawback policy may weaken the board’s legal standing in cases where senior executives have been granted incentive awards on the basis of fraudulent or erroneous data.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 高额入职奖金
criterion.title_en: Golden Hellos
criterion.definition: 是否存在利益相关方对该公司向其 CEO 或其他高级高管提供的入职奖金（golden hellos）的公开批评？若是，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。入职奖金指在正常情况下向外聘人员提供的超过一年总薪酬的任何首年薪酬奖励，无论其形式如何。本关键指标的范围涵盖任何 CEO；双层董事会结构中的任何管理董事会成员；单层董事会结构或设有董事会/监事会结构的公司中的任何执行董事；或排名前五的高管中的任何一位（美国——具名高管）。
criterion.definition_en: Has there been public criticism from stakeholders of golden hellos provided by the company to its CEO or other senior executives? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment. A golden hello is considered to be any first-year pay award for external hires in excess of one year’s total remuneration in normal circumstances, regardless of form. The scope of this Key Metric extends to any CEO; any member of the management board in a two-tier board structure; any executive member of the board of directors in a unitary board structure or where a board of directors/board of auditors structure is in place; or any of the top five executives (U.S. – named executive officers).
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.3, Severe 0.5, Very Severe 1.0

criterion.title: 薪酬争议
criterion.title_en: Pay Controversy
criterion.definition: 公司的薪酬政策或实践是否招致利益相关方（包括股东、政府、监管机构等）的负面公开评论？若是，则被标记。标记的持续时间取决于严重程度评估。
criterion.definition_en: Have the company’s pay policies or practices attracted adverse public comment from stakeholders (including shareholders, government, regulators, etc.)? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical Scoring Deduction: Variable, based on event severity: Minor 0.0, Moderate 0.5, Severe 1.0, Very Severe 2.0

criterion.title: 对薪酬实践的重大反对票
criterion.title_en: Significant Vote Against Pay Practices
criterion.definition: 在最近报告期，公司是否就其薪酬政策与实践收到超过 10% 的反对票，或相关提案被撤回或推迟？若是，则被标记。该指标旨在衡量股东对公司高管薪酬实践的不满。反对票包括任何反对票、保留票或弃权票。
criterion.definition_en: For the most recently reported period, did the company receive a negative vote in excess of 10% on its pay policies and practices, or were relevant proposals withdrawn or adjourned? Flagged if yes. This metric is intended to measure shareholder dissatisfaction with the company’s executive pay practices. A “negative vote” includes any of against, withhold or abstain votes.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on resolution outcome, vote data and consecutive years: Range: 0.05 to 0.5

criterion.title: 高管薪酬披露
criterion.title_en: Executive Pay Disclosure
criterion.definition: 公司是否未能披露其高管（包括 CEO）的具体薪酬总额？若是，则被标记。这是该领域最基本的测试，因此一旦触发便具有相当大的权重，因为它必须替代该领域通常适用的若干其他指标。披露至少必须包括董事会（或双层董事会结构公司的管理董事会）所有执行成员的薪酬，且按个人逐一披露；若没有执行成员，则包括 CEO 的薪酬。个人化披露应包含以下各项金额的单独信息（在提供该组成部分的情况下）：基本薪酬、短期激励、长期激励、养老金、福利和一次性付款（如招聘或留任奖励）。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company failed to disclose specific pay totals for its top executives, including the CEO? Flagged if yes. This is the most basic test in this area, and as such, carries considerable weight when invoked, as it must serve in the place of several of the other metrics normally applied in this area. Disclosure must include, at a minimum, pay for all executive members of the board of directors (or management board for companies with a two-tier board structure) on an individualized basis or in cases where there are no executive members, the CEO. The individualized disclosure should include separate information on the amount of each of the following (where such a component is provided): salary, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, pensions, benefits and one-off payments (such as recruitment or retention awards).
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: Variable, based on executive pay disclosure: CEO pay not disclosed 1.2; CEO pay disclosed and other executive pay not disclosed 0.1

criterion.title: CEO 已实现薪酬总额
criterion.title_en: CEO Pay Total Realized
criterion.definition: 最近报告的 CEO 已实现薪酬总额是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组处于极端区间？ 若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的已实现薪酬总额落入公司薪酬同业组 CEO 已实现薪酬值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
criterion.definition_en: Does the most recently reported total realized CEO pay figure fall into an extreme range relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s total realized pay falls within the top decile of CEO realized pay values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: CEO 授予薪酬总额
criterion.title_en: CEO Pay Total Awarded
criterion.definition: 最近报告的 CEO 授予薪酬总额是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组处于极端区间？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的授予薪酬总额落入公司薪酬同业组 CEO 授予薪酬总额值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
criterion.definition_en: Does the most recently reported total awarded CEO pay figure fall into an extreme range relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s total awarded pay falls within the top decile of CEO total awarded pay values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: CEO 固定薪酬总额
criterion.title_en: CEO Pay Total Fixed
criterion.definition: 最近报告的 CEO 固定薪酬总额是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组处于极端区间？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的固定薪酬总额落入公司薪酬同业组 CEO 固定薪酬总额值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
criterion.definition_en: Does the most recently reported total fixed CEO pay figure fall into an extreme range relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s total fixed pay falls within the top decile of CEO total fixed pay values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: CEO 津贴及其他薪酬
criterion.title_en: CEO Pay Perks & Other Pay
criterion.definition: 最近报告的 CEO 津贴（perks）及其他薪酬金额是否超过规定的 MSCI S&C 门槛值？若是，则被标记。若报告的津贴超过以下数值，则该指标被标记：• 市值超过 1000 亿美元的公司：200,000 美元。• 市值在 100 亿至 1000 亿美元之间的公司：150,000 美元。• 市值在 40 亿至 100 亿美元之间的公司：120,000 美元。• 市值在 3.4 亿至 40 亿美元之间的公司：90,000 美元。• 市值低于 3.4 亿美元的公司：75,000 美元。
criterion.definition_en: Does the most recently reported CEO perquisites (perks) and other pay figure exceed the stated MSCI S&C thresholds? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the perks reported exceed: • USD 200,000 for companies with market cap exceeding USD 100 billion. • USD 150,000 for companies with market cap between USD 10 billion and USD 100 billion. • USD 120,000 for companies with market cap between USD 4 billion and USD 10 billion. • USD 90,000 for companies with market cap between USD 340 million and USD 4 billion. • USD 75,000 for companies with market cap below USD 340 million.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: CEO 非合格递延薪酬（NQDC）
criterion.title_en: CEO Pay NQDC
criterion.definition: 公司代表 CEO 支付的养老金缴款率（定额缴款金额 [CEO NQDC] 除以基本薪酬）是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组过高？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的养老金缴款率落入公司薪酬同业组所有此类值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
criterion.definition_en: Is the pension contribution rate (defined contribution amount [CEO NQDC] divided by salary) made by the company on behalf of the CEO excessive relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s pension contribution rate falls within the top decile of all such values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: CEO 养老金薪酬
criterion.title_en: CEO Pay Pension
criterion.definition: 最近报告的 CEO 累计养老金金额（除以可计养老金的服务年限）是否相对于公司的薪酬同业组过高？若是，则被标记。若 CEO 的（累计养老金总额除以服务年限）数值落入公司薪酬同业组所有此类值的最高十分位，则该指标被标记（见下文薪酬同业组）。由于各公司在一年中的不同时间提交其委托书，某公司可能会因同业组报告数据的变化而看到该指标发生变化。
criterion.definition_en: Is the most recently reported CEO accumulated pension figure (divided by the number of years of pensionable service) excessive relative to the company’s pay peer group? Flagged if yes. This metric is flagged if the CEO’s (total accumulated pension divided by number of years served) figure falls within the top decile of all such values for the company’s pay peer group (see Pay Peer Groups, below). Because companies file their proxy statements at different times throughout the year, a company could see this metric change due to changes in reported figures for its peers.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 内部薪酬公平性
criterion.title_en: Internal Pay Equity
criterion.definition: 在最近报告期，CEO 的授予薪酬总额是否超过其他具名高管薪酬中位数的三倍以上？若是，则被标记。作为薪酬一致性和有效性的另一项粗略衡量，该指标用于识别整体高管薪酬实践中可能存在、有利于 CEO 而不利于公司其他高级管理团队的异常情况。
criterion.definition_en: Does the CEO’s total awarded pay for the last reported period exceed the median pay for the other named executive officers by more than three times? Flagged if yes. Another coarse measure of pay alignment and effectiveness, this metric is used to identify any anomalies in overall executive pay practices that might favor the CEO over the rest of the company's senior management team.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 黄金降落伞
criterion.title_en: Golden Parachutes
criterion.definition: CEO 的潜在现金离职补偿是否超过其年度薪酬的五倍？若是，则被标记。
criterion.definition_en: Does the CEO’s potential cash severance pay exceed five times their annual pay? Flagged if yes.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.3

criterion.title: 离职补偿归属
criterion.title_en: Severance Vesting
criterion.definition: 当 CEO 的雇佣关系终止时，未归属的股权奖励是否仍符合归属条件？若是，则被标记。该指标旨在帮助评估董事会在使 CEO 和其他高级高管的利益与公司投资者利益保持一致方面的有效性。
criterion.definition_en: Are unvested equity awards still eligible for vesting when the CEO's employment is terminated? Flagged if yes. This metric is designed to help in evaluating the board’s effectiveness in aligning the interests of the CEO and other senior executives with those of the company’s investors.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 稀释问题
criterion.title_en: Dilution Concerns
criterion.definition: 公司已发行股份的潜在稀释是否达到 10% 或以上？若是，则被标记。稀释定义为董事会预留用于授予激励奖励的公司股份百分比。无论公司规模如何，均采用 10% 的稀释门槛。
criterion.definition_en: Is the potential dilution in the company’s traded shares 10% or greater? Flagged if yes. Dilution is defined as the percentage of company shares the board has set aside for use in granting incentive awards. The 10% dilution threshold is used regardless of company size.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1

criterion.title: 消耗率问题
criterion.title_en: Run Rate Concerns
criterion.definition: 公司的当前消耗率（run rate）是否达到 2% 或以上？若是，则被标记。消耗率定义为在最近报告期实际授予作为激励奖励的公司股份百分比。无论公司规模如何，均采用 2% 的消耗率门槛。
criterion.definition_en: Is the company’s current run rate 2% or more? Flagged if yes. Run rate is defined as the percentage of company shares actually granted as incentive awards during the most recently reported period. The 2% run rate threshold is used regardless of company size.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: All issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.2

criterion.title: 董事股权政策
criterion.title_en: Director Equity Policy
criterion.definition: 公司是否未能为非执行董事采纳具体的持股指引？若是，则被标记。作为另一项相对粗略但有效的指标，该指标不评估此类标准的有效性，而仅考量公司是否已正式宣布该领域的政策。
criterion.definition_en: Has the company failed to adopt specific stock ownership guidelines for non-executive directors? Flagged if yes. Another relatively coarse but effective indicator, this metric does not evaluate the effectiveness of such standards, but simply whether the company has formally announced a policy in this area.
criterion.scoring_rule: Scope: Equity issuers Typical scoring deduction: 0.1 Total Pay Components
